  • Cardioneurology and neurocardiology are two sides of the same problem
    Pharmacokinetics and Pharmacodynamics · 2026-10-16
    本文为叙述性综述，阐述心脑双向轴中卒中相关心脏改变与心源性脑血管风险，强调跨学科整合对双器官保护的意义。
  • KDM-Net: a large-kernel and bi-mamba integrated network for 12-lead atrial arrhythmia classification.
    Physiol Meas · 2026-10-16
    KDM-Net模型在12导联心电图上区分房颤与房扑，独立患者测试集准确率96.41%、F1 88.31%，外部测试集准确率91.14%。
  • Splenic infarction associated with persistent atrial fibrillation: A case report
    World Journal of Cardiology · 2026-10-16
    56岁男性持续性房颤抗凝不足患者，以急性左上腹痛为首发表现，确诊脾梗死，治疗性抗凝后症状迅速缓解。
  • CARDIORENAL RISK IN PATIENTS WITH ATRIAL FIBRILLATION AND CHRONIC KIDNEY DISEASE IN ARID REGIONS
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-10-16
    综述指出房颤与慢性肾病应作为相互依赖的疾病管理，热暴露在干旱地区可能增加风险但证据不足，AI预测模型需透明且外部验证。
  • Trends and Disparities in Respiratory Failure Mortality with Co-Listed Atrial Fibrillation and Flutter Among U.S. Adults Aged ≥ 65 Years, 1999 to 2024, with AAMR Forecasts Through 2035: A CDC Wonder Analysis
    medRxiv · 2026-10-16
    美国≥65岁成人中，呼吸衰竭与房颤/房扑共列死亡年龄调整死亡率从1999年12.8升至2024年66.7/10万，预计2035年达122.96/10万，存在性别、种族、地区和城乡差异。

室性心律失常（14）

  • Recurrent Supraventricular Tachycardia Triggered by Tea Consumption in a Postoperative Adolescent Female: A Case Report
    Clin Case Rep · 2026-10-16
    一例16岁术后女性饮茶后反复发作室上性心动过速（心率170次/分），静脉腺苷复律成功，提示膳食咖啡因可作为SVT诱因。
  • Angry Purkinje Syndrome: A Review of Short-Coupled Polymorphic Ventricular Tachycardia with Quinidine Treatment.
    Heart Lung Circ · 2026-10-16
    急性心梗血运重建后2-8天出现的短联律间期多形性室速（Angry Purkinje综合征）对常规抗心律失常药无效，奎尼丁可有效抑制。
  • Practical Approaches to Coronary Venous Ethanol Ablation for Refractory Ventricular Arrhythmias: Technique Selection and Clinical Outcomes.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-16
    对心内膜射频消融无效的难治性室性心律失常患者，冠状静脉乙醇消融急性成功率高，长期随访约半数有效，无致命并发症。
  • Sparse-EWI: Towards an automated and real time focal arrhythmia mapping technique - in silico to clinical validation.
    IEEE Trans Ultrason · 2026-10-16
    稀疏EWI仅需每视图15个种子点即可自动估计激活时间，在仿真、犬和PVC患者中保持与常规EWI相当的定位精度，处理速度提升约5倍。
  • Arrhythmias in patients with transthyretin cardiac amyloidosis and the impact of contemporary disease-modifying therapies.
    J Cardiovasc Med (Hagerstown) · 2026-10-16
    本综述系统梳理转甲状腺素蛋白心脏淀粉样变（ATTR-CM）相关心律失常的机制、流行病学与管理，并探讨新型疾病修饰治疗对心律失常负荷的潜在影响。
  • Predictive Value of the Electrical Risk Score for Ventricular Arrhythmias in Heart Failure Patients with Primary Prevention Implantable Cardioverter Defibrillators.
    J Clin Med · 2026-10-16
    在91例心衰一级预防ICD患者中，电风险评分（ERS）≥3分与室性心律失常相关ICD电击独立相关，AUC达0.882，优于多数传统心电图指标。
  • Global Advances in Ventricular Tachycardia Ablation
    J Innov Card Rhythm Manag · 2026-10-16
  • Seizures Secondary to Aconitum Plant Poisoning: a case report
    J Med Case Rep · 2026-10-16
    一例53岁男性饮用草乌酒后先出现室速/室颤致心源性晕厥，后经脑电图证实出现真正癫痫发作，提示乌头碱中毒存在从心脏毒性到中枢神经毒性的动态演变。
  • Successful Guidewire-Guided Ethanol Ablation for PVCs Originating From Epicardial Anterior Interventricular Groove Adjacent to LAD.
    JACC Case Rep · 2026-10-16
    30岁男性高负荷起源于心外膜前室间沟邻近LAD的PVC，经导丝辅助无水乙醇消融成功，术后无冠脉损伤，2个月随访无复发。
  • Tachycardia Initiation by Dual-Mode PVC on Ambulatory ECG: Pattern Discovery and Invasive Electrophysiological Characteristics.
    JACC Case Rep · 2026-10-16
    57岁男性动态心电图显示同一形态PVC触发800阵长RP心动过速，两种起始模式经电生理检查证实为慢-慢型房室结折返性心动过速，消融成功。
  • Oscillatory Epicardial Delayed Potentials and Associated Unipolar Voltage Gradients in Brugada Syndrome.
    JACC Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-16
  • Intravenous verapamil as salvage therapy for reperfusion-related refractory electrical storm following acute inferior myocardial infarction: a case report
    Journal of Cardiothoracic Surgery · 2026-10-16
    一例52岁急性下壁心梗PCI术后反复电风暴患者，常规治疗无效，静脉维拉帕米5mg成功转复并维持窦律。
  • Prevalence and clinical predictors of myocardial injury in patients with acute supraventricular tachycardia
    Journal of Cardiothoracic Surgery · 2026-10-16
    急性室上性心动过速患者中约半数出现高敏肌钙蛋白T升高，血清肌酐、初始心率和SVT发作至就诊时间是独立预测因素。
  • Forensic cause-of-death determination of myocardial infarction-related sudden cardiac death in histopathologically similar cases using computational pathology.
    Leg Med (Tokyo) · 2026-10-16
    计算病理学框架（UNI-CLAM）在组织学高度相似的心肌标本中区分心梗相关心源性猝死与其他死因，外部验证AUC 0.829，并识别出特征性心肌损伤模式。

器械治疗（7）

  • Correlative and Live-Cell Imaging of S100B-Promoter-Associated Interstitial Cells from the Cardiac Sinoatrial Node and Valves.
    Cells · 2026-10-16
    对S100B-EGFP报告小鼠窦房结和房室瓣间质细胞的探索性成像显示，EGFP+细胞形态异质，NAD(P)H自发荧光更高而TMRM信号更低，并观察到线粒体样结构经细胞间桥转移等候选事件。
  • Evolution of Tined Leadless Pacemaker Implantation: Patient Selection, Implant Volume, Center Characteristics, and Safety Trends.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-16
    在46,698例Medicare患者中，带齿无导线起搏器植入的心脏穿孔率随时间下降，且高植入量术者穿孔率更低，结局变异更多归因于术者而非机构。
  • Functional Mitral Regurgitation Trajectories in CRT-Treated HFrEF During Medical Therapy Optimization: Association with Reverse Remodeling.
    J Clin Med · 2026-10-16
    在接受CRT的HFrEF患者中启动沙库巴曲缬沙坦后，62%的患者功能性二尖瓣反流改善，且与左室射血分数提升、左室舒张末期容积和左房容积缩小相关。
  • First-in-Human Permanent Totally Leadless Left Ventricular Septal Endocardial Pacing With Atrioventricular Synchrony.
    JACC Case Rep · 2026-10-16
    首例人体完全无导线双腔起搏联合超声介导左室间隔心内膜起搏，通过心房起搏脉冲触发左室起搏实现房室顺序同步，QRS 142 ms。
  • First-in-Human Axillary Vein Implantation of a Leadless Pacemaker: Breaking the Access Barrier.
    JACC Case Rep · 2026-10-16
    首例经腋静脉植入无导线起搏器：78岁女性在股静脉与颈内静脉入路均不可用时，经左腋静脉成功植入，提示腋静脉可作为补救入路。
  • A misleading wide-complex rhythm in an implantable cardioverter-defibrillator recipient
    Neth Heart J · 2026-10-16
    一例ICD受者出现宽QRS波心律，经十二导联心电图识别为ICD治疗（ATP）的表面记录，而非自发性室速。
  • Magnetically gated millimeter-scale capsule power system for leadless electrotherapy.
    Sci Adv · 2026-10-16
    一种磁控毫米级胶囊电源系统通过脉冲磁场无线激活，在大动物中实现稳健心脏起搏，并初步验证闭环起搏可行性。

影像与标测（1）

  • Prosthetic Aortic Valve Infective Endocarditis Complicated With Malignant Arrhythmias: Diagnostic and Management Challenges
    Cureus · 2026-10-16
    59岁机械主动脉瓣置换术后患者发生人工瓣膜感染性心内膜炎，并发瓣周漏、主动脉根部脓肿及恶性心律失常，虽经急诊手术和VA-ECMO支持仍未能存活。

遗传与基础（8）

  • Atrial Cardiomyopathy Through the Pathologist's Lens: From Tissue Remodeling to Clinical Expression.
    Cardiovasc Pathol · 2026-10-16
    综述从病理学视角阐述心房心肌病（ACM）的组织学谱系与区域异质性，强调其与AF互为因果，但当前尚不能作为特定治疗指征。
  • Multimodality Imaging in Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy: From Phenotyping to Precision Clinical Management.
    Diagnostics (Basel) · 2026-10-16
    多模态心血管影像（超声心动图、CMR、CT、核素）整合临床与遗传信息，可提升肥厚型心肌病的精准诊断、危险分层与治疗规划。
  • Cellular consequences of non-ablative radiotherapy, a novel approach to ventricular tachycardias.
    Europace · 2026-10-16
    小鼠在体单次放疗（25 Gy）可增强心肌细胞钠电流（尤其持续成分）并延长动作电位时程，从而可能通过提高传导速度抑制室速，但亦增加EADs并抑制钙处理，提示致心律失常与收缩功能受损风险。
  • ASSOCIATION BETWEEN ENERGY DRINK CONSUMPTION AND CARDIAC RHYTHM DISTURBANCES IN YOUNG ADULTS
    GSC Biological and Pharmaceutical Sciences · 2026-10-16
    系统综述显示，能量饮料急性大量摄入可使健康年轻人QTc平均最大延长18-20 ms，并与32例心律失常/缺血事件相关（20例为室上性或室性心律失常，3例死亡），遗传性离子通道病患者风险最高。
  • Myocardial Fibrosis as an Arrhythmogenic Substrate: Integrating Genetics, Imaging and Invasive Electrophysiology for Sudden Death Risk Stratification.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-16
  • Postmortem genetic testing after sudden unexplained death: a proposed medico-legal implementation framework for familial risk.
    J Forensic Leg Med · 2026-10-16
    本文提出一个适用于法医学与临床遗传学衔接的死后基因检测实施框架，包含基于表型/情境的家系临床转诊和变异特异性披露/级联检测两条路径，旨在避免家庭风险信息被忽视。
  • Delayed Diagnosis of Hereditary Transthyretin Cardiac Amyloidosis Presenting with Autonomic Neuropathy: A Case Report
    Journal of Cardiovascular Development and Disease · 2026-10-16
    一例携带罕见转甲状腺素蛋白p.Gly67Val突变的64岁男性，以自主神经病表现为首发症状，诊断延迟至心力衰竭和传导异常阶段，提示需提高对心脏外表现的认识。
  • A guideline-based lead prior for robust 12-lead ECG classification when leads are missing: development on PTB-XL and external validation on CODE-15%
    Open Science Framework · 2026-10-16
    在12导联心电图中，基于指南的导联注意力先验（M2）在导联缺失时对AF、一度房室阻滞及左右束支阻滞的AUROC较随机导联掩码（M1）平均提升，但提升幅度及置信区间需待封存测试集验证。

其他（7）

  • Sex Differences in QT Interval and Beat-to-Beat Temporal QT Variability at Rest and After Submaximal Exercise in Young Adults With and Without Obesity: A Cross-Sectional Study
    Cureus · 2026-10-16
    在年轻肥胖成人中，女性静息和次极量运动后逐搏QT变异性均高于男性，且肥胖女性BMI与运动后QTc呈正相关，提示性别特异的复极不稳定。
  • Occult Neoplasms in Sudden Unexpected Death in Infancy: A Scoping Review of Post-Mortem Findings.
    Diagnostics (Basel) · 2026-10-16
    在32例婴儿猝死综合征病例中，尸检发现25例存在未诊断肿瘤，其中50%被归类为直接死因，提示全面尸检对明确死因至关重要。
  • Coexistance of Carotid Sinus Hypersensitivity and Orthostatic Hypotension in Patients with Unexplained Syncope.
    Europace · 2026-10-16
    在1908例不明原因晕厥患者中，颈动脉窦高敏（CSH）与体位性低血压（OH）常共存，OH患者CSH发生率更高（24.1% vs 13.3%），且OH患者更易出现心脏抑制型CSM反应。
  • Development of an efficient deep learning model for arrhythmia detection from consumer smartwatches
    Front Artif Intell · 2026-10-16
  • Psychosocial Vulnerability and Immediate Emotional Triggers Preceding Sudden Cardiac Arrest.
    JACC Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-16
  • Electrophysiological Manifestations of Suspected Bachmann's Bundle Infarction Due to Occlusion of the Right Sinus Node Artery.
    JACC Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-16
  • Polymicrogyria and Cardiac Arrhythmia in a Neonate With Biallelic Stop-Gain Variant in TMEM161B: Expanding the Phenotype.
    Prenat Diagn · 2026-10-16

item.title: 2026-10-15 心脏电生理日报（56 篇）
item.description:
共 56 篇。在日报页面阅读完整解读 →

房颤与消融（30）

  • Effects of RhBNP combined with immune modulation on immune function and short-term clinical outcomes in patients with atrial fibrillation and heart failure
    American Heart Journal Plus Cardiology Research and Practice · 2026-10-15
  • [Percutaneous left atrial appendage closure: Towards enlargement of implantations in centres without on-site cardiac surgery].
    Ann Cardiol Angeiol (Paris) · 2026-10-15
    本文支持在法国无心脏外科现场的成熟中心开展经皮左心耳封堵，认为基于专项技术经验与快速外科转诊路径的组织模式可安全替代现场心脏外科支持。
  • Active Helicobacter pylori Infection and Atrial Fibrillation in Patients Hospitalized With Acute Myocardial Infarction
    Ann Noninvasive Electrocardiol · 2026-10-15
    在310例急性心肌梗死住院患者中，幽门螺杆菌呼气试验阳性率20.0%，阳性者房颤记录比例6.7%低于阴性者12.5%，校正后无统计学显著关联（OR 0.54，95%CI 0.16-1.46）。
  • Development of a Cost-Effective Single-Lead ECG Data Acquisition Pipeline for Monitoring of Arrhythmia
    Apple Academic Press eBooks · 2026-10-15
    本研究开发了一种基于Arduino UNO和AD8232的低成本单导联心电采集系统，结合CNN-GRU模型在MIT-BIH数据集上实现五分类心律失常识别准确率98.46%，并用ResNet在PhysioNet 2017数据集上检测房颤F1分数0.81。
  • SGLT2 Inhibitor Therapy and Risk of Incident Atrial Fibrillation in Patients With HFpEF and Type 2 Diabetes.
    Cardiology · 2026-10-15
    在HFpEF合并2型糖尿病患者中，SGLT2抑制剂治疗与房颤/房扑发生率降低相关（17.8% vs 19.2%，HR 0.84），并降低全因死亡、缺血性卒中和复合MACE风险。
  • Graph neural network for predicting reentrant drivers in atrial digital twins.
    Comput Methods Programs Biomed · 2026-10-15
    图神经网络基于31个持续性房颤数字孪生体训练，可预测折返驱动区域，前瞻性验证中引导消融使新发折返减少70%以上，并将达到不可诱发的模拟轮次减少66%。
  • Machine-learning versus traditional scoring methods for prediction of atrial fibrillation recurrence after catheter ablation: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
    Curr Probl Cardiol · 2026-10-15
    在预测房颤消融术后复发方面，机器学习模型的汇总区分度（AUC 0.80）显著优于传统风险评分（AUC 0.58），但方法学局限和缺乏外部验证限制其临床直接应用。
  • Large-scale plasma metabolic profiling identifies signatures and biomarkers associated with air pollution and arrhythmias: A prospective cohort study from UK Biobank.
    Ecotoxicol Environ Saf · 2026-10-15
    在UK Biobank 44.9万无基线心律失常人群中，四种空气污染物均与心律失常风险升高相关，代谢组学特征部分介导该关联（介导比例5.19%-11.19%），脂质、酮体和氨基酸代谢是核心通路。
  • Unplanned contacts managed by an advanced nurse practitioner after atrial fibrillation ablation.
    Enferm Clin (Engl Ed) · 2026-10-15
    房颤消融术后约三分之一患者会通过电话或邮件向高级执业护士发起非计划性咨询，主要原因为房颤复发、检查需求及术后并发症。
  • Cardiometabolic therapy for rhythm control: a case report of refractory atrial fibrillation resolving after initiation of semaglutide for obesity.
    Eur Heart J Case Rep · 2026-10-15
    一例肥胖合并难治性持续性房颤患者，在四次肺静脉隔离后仍反复发作，起始司美格鲁肽后房颤发作立即停止且随访未复发。
  • Risk of atrial fibrillation according to electrocardiographic risk factors: a nationwide cohort study of 1.5 million patients.
    Eur Heart J Open · 2026-10-15
    在143万接受心电图检查的患者中，五项心电图风险因素呈剂量依赖性增加新发房颤和卒中风险，全部五项阳性者5年房颤累积发生率8.3%、卒中7.3%，风险分别为无风险因素者的2.57倍和2.11倍。
  • Adverse pregnancy outcomes as early indicators of long-term maternal atrial fibrillation: a systematic review and meta-analysis
    Eur J Obstet Gynecol Reprod Biol · 2026-10-15
    不良妊娠结局（尤其妊娠期高血压疾病和子痫前期）与母亲远期房颤风险升高相关，提示其可作为心律失常易感性的早期标志。
  • Suspected atrioesophageal fistula complicated by coronary air embolism after catheter ablation for atrial fibrillation: direct angiographic visualization and catheter aspiration in a case report
    Frontiers in Cardiovascular Medicine · 2026-10-15
    84岁女性房颤射频消融及左心耳封堵术后1个月突发意识障碍、发热及下壁ST段抬高，冠脉造影直接显示右冠气体并抽吸，多部位血管内气体及菌血症支持房食管瘘诊断，患者27小时内死亡。
  • The Prevalence and Clinical Characteristics of Atrial Fibrillation and Reflux Esophagitis Among Individuals Undergoing Health Checkups
    Intern Med · 2026-10-15
    在5205例健康体检者中，房颤患病率0.7%，房颤者反流性食管炎更常见（39.1% vs 22.0%），但多因素校正后二者无独立关联。
  • Small Discrete Pre-Potential-Like Electrogram Recorded by a Lattice-Tip Catheter at the Initiation of Atrial Fibrillation.
    J Arrhythm · 2026-10-15
    在非肺静脉触发灶起源处，使用网格头端导管记录到一小的离散前电位样电图，较前一位点电位提前56 ms。
  • Totally Thoracoscopic Atrial Fibrillation Ablation With the Gemini S Bipolar Clamp: A Single-Center Descriptive Cohort Study of 1-Year Rhythm, Safety, and Quality-of-Life Outcomes
    J Arrhythm · 2026-10-15
    全胸腔镜下使用Gemini S双极钳行心外膜盒式隔离联合左心耳排除，1年窦性心律维持率87.0%，但开胸中转率13.0%需关注。
  • Accelerated 3D Late Gadolinium Enhancement Pulse Sequence with Isotropic Spatial Resolution, Self-Navigation of Respiratory Motion, and Arrhythmia Rejection for Quantification of Left Atrial Fibrosis in Patients with Atrial Fibrillation.
    J Cardiovasc Magn Reson · 2026-10-15
    新型3D LGE序列在1.5T下对房颤患者左房成像质量达临床可接受水平，重复消融者左房纤维化负担显著高于对照组。
  • Global Advances in Ventricular Tachycardia Ablation.
    J Innov Card Rhythm Manag · 2026-10-15
    综述系统梳理了室速消融从早期外科/直流电消融到射频消融、脉冲场消融、神经调控与立体定向放疗的多模态演进，强调个体化策略仍是优化室速管理核心。
  • Safety, Efficacy, and Effectiveness of Pulsed Field Ablation with Farapulse™ to Treat Atrial Fibrillation: A Prospective Single-center Study.
    J Innov Card Rhythm Manag · 2026-10-15
    Farapulse脉冲场消融治疗症状性房颤，6个月无抗心律失常药物下82%无复发，无重大不良事件，急性肺静脉隔离率96%。
  • Transient Ischemic Attack Due to Delamination of a Steerable Guiding Sheath: A Potential Complication During Atrial Fibrillation Ablation.
    J Innov Card Rhythm Manag · 2026-10-15
    1例房颤消融术中因可调弯导引鞘（CARTO VIZIGO）鞘管分层脱落导致血栓栓塞性短暂性脑缺血发作，提示该器械结构完整性缺陷。
  • Left Atrial Appendage Closure: Past, Present, and Future.
    J Innov Card Rhythm Manag · 2026-10-15
    左心耳封堵（LAAC）是非瓣膜性房颤患者卒中预防的重要替代策略，在长期抗凝禁忌或不耐受时适用，随机和观察性数据显示不劣于华法林，与直接口服抗凝药的不劣性也在评估中，适应证正从高出血风险人群扩展至房颤消融患者和中等血栓栓塞风险但抗凝不耐受者。
  • Repeat Ablation for Persistent Atrial Fibrillation: CFA/DOA-Guided Substrate Ablation Versus Re-PVI Alone in the Prematurely Terminated Randomized AF-CAM Trial
    Journal of Clinical Medicine · 2026-10-15
    在提前终止的AF-CAM随机试验中，持续性房颤二次消融时，在Re-PVI基础上加做CFA/DOA引导的基质消融，与单纯Re-PVI相比未能改善无房性心律失常生存率（HR 1.07，95%CI 0.50-2.33，P=0.85）。
  • Atrial cardiomyopathy: from knowledge gaps to clinical impact : The role of the EmbRACE Network
    Neth Heart J · 2026-10-15
    EmbRACE网络旨在通过整合基础、计算与临床研究，定义心房心肌病的诊断阈值并验证靶向治疗能否改善心血管结局。
  • Real-time ambulance to primary care notification of atrial fibrillation and atrial flutter: Protocol for the evaluation of a novel digital solution
    Newcastle University ePrints (Newcastle Univesity) · 2026-10-15
    该研究方案拟评估一种实时通知系统，将救护车中检出的房颤/房扑信息传递至初级保健，以加速诊断与抗凝管理。
  • Open-Irrigated Versus Non-Irrigated Catheters in SVT Ablation: Substrate-Specific Outcomes in AVRT and AVNRT.
    Pacing Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-15
    在SVT射频消融中，开放灌注导管较非灌注导管提高急性消融成功率并降低复发，获益主要见于AVRT而非AVNRT。
  • Pulsed Field Versus Radiofrequency Ablation of Atrial Fibrillation: Esophageal Lesions and Suspected Gastroparesis.
    Pacing Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-15
    单中心队列显示，PFA较RFA显著降低疑似胃轻瘫发生率（0% vs 34.9%），且PFA组无内镜下食管病变，手术时间更短，365天心律失常复发率相当。
  • Transplacental Flecainide and/or Digoxin for Fetal Tachyarrhythmias: Therapeutic Efficacy and Clinical Experience.
    Prenat Diagn · 2026-10-15
    在索他洛尔不可及时，经胎盘氟卡尼治疗胎儿室上速完全转复率100%，房扑以心率控制为主，母体不良反应轻微。
  • Catheter Cryoballoon Ablation for Atrial Fibrillation: Focus on Men and Women with Chronic Heart Failure and Preserved Ejection Fraction
    Russian Medicine · 2026-10-15
    房颤合并射血分数保留的心衰患者接受冷冻球囊肺静脉隔离后3个月，女性生活质量、运动能力和NT-proBNP改善，男性运动耐量和舒张功能改善。
  • Rivaroxaban versus Warfarin in Coronary Heart Disease with Atrial Fibrillation: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-10-15
  • Reproducibility Materials: Early Multibiomarker Machine-Learning Prediction of In-Hospital Mortality in Critically Ill Patients With Heart Failure and Atrial Fibrillation
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-10-15
    该研究发布了一套可复现分析材料，用于心衰合并房颤危重患者院内死亡的多生物标志物机器学习预测，但摘要未报告具体预测性能。

室性心律失常（4）

  • Risk factors and clinical implications of QTc prolongation in methadone maintenance therapy: a systematic review
    BMC Pharmacology and Toxicology · 2026-10-15
    系统综述显示美沙酮维持治疗与QTc延长持续相关，效应呈剂量依赖性，女性及合用苯二氮䓬类者更明显，部分研究在较低剂量下亦见QTc延长。
  • First use of empagliflozin to treat a patient with congenital long QT syndrome type III.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-15
  • FOLFOX-Associated Ventricular Fibrillation Arrest in a Patient With Colon Cancer.
    JACC Case Rep · 2026-10-15
    一例无心脏病史的43岁结肠癌患者，首周期FOLFOX化疗后72小时发生院外室颤心脏骤停，冠脉造影无阻塞，提示氟尿嘧啶类心脏毒性可早期致恶性室性心律失常。
  • Social Determinants of Health and Risk of Sudden Cardiac Death in Athletes: A Scoping Review
    OSF Preprints (OSF Preprints) · 2026-10-15
    该范围综述系统梳理了运动员健康社会决定因素与心血管风险及心源性猝死关系的证据，发现研究覆盖多类运动人群但定义与测量异质，证据存在明显缺口。

器械治疗（11）

  • Complete Heart Block Following Right Ventricular Mass Excision and Tricuspid Valve Replacement Requiring Permanent Pacemaker Implantation: A Rare Surgical Complication
    2026-10-15
  • Conservative Management of a Dislodged Leadless Pacemaker Wedged in the Pulmonary Artery Assessed by Pulmonary Perfusion Scintigraphy: A Case Report
    European Heart Journal - Case Reports · 2026-10-15
    84岁高龄患者无导线起搏器脱位栓塞至肺动脉后稳定嵌顿，保守治疗并系列肺灌注显像随访3年，肺灌注分布稳定、无症状。
  • Transjugular implantation of a leadless pacemaker in a 97-year-old patient with severe kyphosis and tortuous femoral veins: a case report
    Frontiers in Cardiovascular Medicine · 2026-10-15
    97岁严重后凸畸形合并股静脉迂曲的高级别房室传导阻滞患者，经右颈内静脉成功植入无导线起搏器，围术期无并发症，随访参数稳定。
  • Continuous Monitoring in Implantable Cardiac Devices: Electro-Quasistatic Human Body Communication - Challenges and Opportunities.
    IEEE Open J Eng Med Biol · 2026-10-15
    基于能量平衡模型，传统射频链路无法满足起搏器约130 J/年的连续监测通信预算，而电准静态人体通信（EQS-HBC）在理论上可支持1 kSps、16位等效连续数据流，能效比射频高约100倍，并维持约10年电池寿命。
  • Myocardial scar burden independently predicts response to cardiac resynchronization therapy
    International Journal of Drug Delivery Technology · 2026-10-15
    心肌瘢痕负荷≥22.9%可独立预测CRT无应答，敏感性70%、特异性92.9%，且非缺血性心肌病应答率显著高于缺血性。
  • Safety and Outcomes of Percutaneous Vegetation Aspiration During Transvenous Lead Extraction: A Multicenter Experience.
    J Cardiovasc Electrophysiol · 2026-10-15
    在经静脉导线拔除术中联合经皮赘生物抽吸可行且较安全，但装置感染拔除后死亡率仍高（随访139天达19%）。
  • Prognostic Value of the C-Reactive Protein-to-Albumin Ratio in Patients Hospitalized with Atrioventricular Block: Association with In-Hospital Mortality and Temporary Pacemaker Requirement
    Medicina · 2026-10-15
    在698例住院二度及以上房室传导阻滞患者中，C反应蛋白/白蛋白比值（CAR）与院内死亡和临时起搏器需求独立相关，但预测增益有限。
  • Use of the wearable cardioverter-defibrillator in Spain: the first 300 patients.
    Rev Esp Cardiol (Engl Ed) · 2026-10-15
  • Advances in Biodegradable Supercapacitors for Implantable Bioelectronics: Materials, Energy Storage, Degradation, and Clinical Translation
    Small · 2026-10-15
    本综述系统评估可生物降解超级电容器在临时植入器械中的材料、储能与降解特性，指出其可免于二次手术取出，但能量密度、机械稳定性与降解动力学仍是临床转化的主要瓶颈。
  • Step-By-Step Left Bundle Branch Area Pacing: A Practical Technical Guide.
    Turk Kardiyol Dern Ars · 2026-10-15
    本技术综述系统阐述了左束支区域起搏（LBBAP）的标准化植入流程与电生理验证标准，强调规范操作可提高手术成功率和临床结局。
  • Adjuvant Radiotherapy for Early Breast Cancer in a Patient with a Cardiac Pacemaker Near the Radiation Field: A Case Report
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-10-15
    76岁左乳腺癌伴左侧心脏起搏器患者，通过严格放疗计划使起搏器最大剂量200.8 cGy、平均44.2 cGy，安全完成保乳术后同步整合推量放疗。

影像与标测（1）

  • Fluoroless Ablation of a Coronary Sinus-related Accessory Pathway Without Coronary Sinus Angiogram in a Patient with Multiple Prior Failed Ablations.
    J Innov Card Rhythm Manag · 2026-10-15
    一例多次消融失败的冠状静脉窦相关心外膜旁路患者，仅用三维电解剖标测无透视无静脉造影成功消融，1年随访无复发。

遗传与基础（8）

  • Atrial fibrillation in allogeneic and autologous hematopoietic stem cell transplant recipients: incidence and clinical implications
    Cardio-Oncology · 2026-10-15
    在无既往心律失常、心脏病或瓣膜病的成人移植受者中，异基因HCT后90天内AF累积发生率高于自体HCT（6.3% vs 4.3%，P<0.001），高龄、低KPS及肥胖为危险因素。
  • Proteostatic regulation of hERG1 isoforms and LQT2 mutants by MKRN1
    Cell Communication and Signaling · 2026-10-15
    E3泛素连接酶MKRN1通过促进内质网相关降解下调hERG1蛋白及电流，并介导LQT2突变体A561V和G601S的转运缺陷；MKRN1抑制剂依巴斯汀可 rescue 突变体前向转运和电流。
  • Temporal association between adjunctive repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation and seizure reduction in a pediatric patient with DNM1L-associated EMPF1: a case report.
    Front Pediatr · 2026-10-15
    1例DNM1L相关EMPF1患儿在标准抗癫痫与代谢治疗基础上加用1Hz rTMS后，发作频率由约20次/日降至0-1次/日，但仅为时间关联，不能归因于rTMS。
  • Advances and challenges in personalized cardiac modeling and simulation for predicting the risk of sudden death from malignant arrhythmias in post-myocardial infarction
    Frontiers in Cardiovascular Medicine · 2026-10-15
    针对心肌梗死后恶性室性心律失常的猝死风险，基于个体化多模态影像和多尺度计算的心脏建模仿真，可无创动态评估致心律失常易感性，弥补LVEF单一指标预测不足。
  • Clinical and Genetic Characteristics of Hereditary Arrhythmias and Cardiomyopathies in the Middle East.
    Mayo Clin Proc Innov Qual Outcomes · 2026-10-15
    中东地区遗传性心律失常与心肌病以近亲结婚导致的常染色体隐性遗传富集为特征，纯合基因型致早发侵袭表型，但意义不明变异负担高。
  • "I Don't Think It Is Fair…There Should be a Solution to Every Problem": Experiences of Individuals with Sudden Arrhythmia Death Syndromes Who Attempt to Obtain Life Insurance.
    Public Health Genomics · 2026-10-15
    遗传性突发心律失常死亡综合征患者及高危者申请寿险多失败，归因于保险业对疾病理解不足与基因信息使用不公。
  • A clinical case of procainamide‑induced Brugada pattern type 1
    Yakut Medical Journal · 2026-10-15
    一例53岁男性因消化道症状就诊时偶然发现2型Brugada样心电图，经普鲁卡因胺激发试验诱发出1型Brugada模式，提示药物激发试验在隐匿型Brugada综合征诊断中的价值。
  • Stable truncating mutations in plakophilin-2 induce arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy-like phenotypes in adult zebrafish
    iScience · 2026-10-15
    研究利用CRISPR-Cas9构建pkp2截短突变斑马鱼，再现ACM表型如收缩力下降、心律失常和运动诱导猝死，支持其作为PKP2相关ACM的补充模型。

其他（2）

  • Twenty Years at the Crossroads: Is Clinical Cardiac Electrophysiology Science, Procedure, or Both?
    JACC Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-15
  • Federated learning with adaptive reliability aware aggregation for privacy preserving healthcare IoT systems
    Scientific Reports · 2026-10-15
    在模拟医疗物联网环境中，RAAA联邦学习框架在心律失常检测中达到91.7%准确率，优于FedAvg等基线，且收敛更快、参与率更高。

item.title: 2026-10-14 心脏电生理日报（43 篇）
item.description:
共 43 篇。在日报页面阅读完整解读 →

房颤与消融（26）

  • Pulsed field ablation for persistent atrial fibrillation with atrioventricular reentrant tachycardia under tubeless general anesthesia: a case report.
    AME Case Rep · 2026-10-14
    一例36岁持续性房颤合并左侧旁路AVRT患者，在无气管插管全麻下接受PFA+LAAC一站式手术，术中AVRT发作后经旁路消融成功，3个月随访窦律维持且心脏重构改善。
  • Association between lactate-to-albumin ratio and mortality in obese patients with atrial fibrillation
    BMC Cardiovascular Disorders · 2026-10-14
    在肥胖合并房颤的ICU患者中，乳酸/白蛋白比值（LAR）升高与28天死亡率独立相关，但作为单一生物标志物的区分能力有限（AUC=0.653）。
  • Association of blood glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase activity with atrial fibrillation and post-ablation recurrence: a single-center retrospective study
    BMC Cardiovascular Disorders · 2026-10-14
    单中心回顾性研究显示，房颤患者血G6PD活性显著低于对照，且与房颤独立相关；G6PD活性对房颤有中等判别能力，加入临床模型可提升判别，但对抗消融后复发的增量预后价值不确定。
  • Comparative efficacy of esophageal protection strategies during radiofrequency atrial fibrillation ablation: a systematic review and network meta-analysis of randomized trials
    BMC Cardiovascular Disorders · 2026-10-14
    在房颤射频消融中，机械食管偏移联合食管腔内温度监测在降低内镜下食管病变方面排名最优，但证据置信度受样本量小和替代终点限制。
  • SGLT2 Inhibitor Therapy and Risk of Incident Atrial Fibrillation in Patients With HFpEF and Type 2 Diabetes
    Cardiology · 2026-10-14
    在HFpEF合并2型糖尿病患者中，SGLT2抑制剂治疗与房颤/房扑发生率降低相关（17.8% vs 19.2%，HR 0.84），并降低全因死亡、缺血性卒中和复合MACE风险。
  • A predictive model for heart failure in patients with hypertension and persistent atrial fibrillation: A retrospective single-center study.
    Chin Med Sci J · 2026-10-14
    在395例高血压合并持续性房颤患者中，基于9项预测变量构建的心力衰竭风险列线图显示出良好的区分度（AUC=0.77）和校准度，可用于个体化风险分层。
  • Association of Iron Homeostasis With One-Year All-Cause Mortality Among Intensive Care Unit Patients with Atrial Fibrillation: A Retrospective Study.
    Clin Cardiol · 2026-10-14
    在重症房颤患者中，高铁蛋白水平与1年全因死亡风险增加独立相关，而高转铁蛋白和总铁结合力水平与死亡风险降低相关，血清铁无显著关联。
  • Association Between Left Atrial Volume Index (LAVI) and Glycemic Control (HbA1c) in Patients With Atrial Fibrillation and Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus.
    Cureus · 2026-10-14
    在合并2型糖尿病的房颤患者中，HbA1c每升高1%，左房容积指数增加1.678 mL/m²，左房扩大风险增加70%。
  • Oral Obesity Medicines in the Era of Cardiovascular-Kidney-Metabolic Syndrome (CKM): Beyond Weight Loss Toward Disease Modification.
    Drug Des Devel Ther · 2026-10-14
    本综述指出口服减重药物正从单纯减重转向CKM综合管理，口服司美格鲁肽证据最强（SOUL试验显示高危2型糖尿病患者MACE下降），房颤与心衰获益仍属探索性。
  • Ongoing atrial fibroblast activation after catheter ablation for atrial fibrillation: insights from [68Ga]Ga-FAPI-04 PET/CMR
    EJNMMI Research · 2026-10-14
    房颤消融后稳定期74%患者左房存在持续成纤维细胞活化，且与结构功能重构及复发相关。
  • From wrist to heart: clinical validation and real-world translation of wearable and portable AI-enhanced electrocardiography.
    Eur Heart J Digit Health · 2026-10-14
    可穿戴与便携式AI-ECG证据以房颤检测最成熟，但多为回顾性研究，尚缺乏改善患者结局与卫生系统效率的前瞻性验证。
  • Pulsed Field Ablation as First-Line Therapy for the Treatment of Atrial Fibrillation: a FARADISE Sub-Analysis.
    Europace · 2026-10-14
  • Electrocardiographic Predictors of Early Atrial Fibrillation After Transcatheter Atrial Septal Defect Closure: The Roles of P-Wave Dispersion and P-Terminal Force in V1
    Forbes Journal of Medicine · 2026-10-14
    术前P波离散度和V1导联P波终末电势可独立预测房间隔缺损封堵术后48小时内新发房颤，有助于风险分层。
  • Optimization of direct oral anticoagulant prescribing in primary care: a pharmacotherapeutic review in real-world clinical practice and therapeutic efficiency
    Frontiers in Pharmacology · 2026-10-14
    西班牙初级保健药师主导的多学科干预使66.6%的DOAC患者被评估为可优化治疗（建议阿哌沙班换用达比加群），2025年预计节省约10.7万欧元，出血率未升高。
  • The Prevalence and Clinical Characteristics of Atrial Fibrillation and Reflux Esophagitis Among Individuals Undergoing Health Checkups.
    Intern Med · 2026-10-14
    在5205名健康体检者中，房颤患病率0.7%，未用抑酸药者房颤组反流性食管炎更常见（39.1% vs 22.0%，P=0.049），但多因素校正后二者无独立关联。
  • Small Discrete Pre-Potential-Like Electrogram Recorded by a Lattice-Tip Catheter at the Initiation of Atrial Fibrillation
    J Arrhythm · 2026-10-14
    使用 lattice-tip 导管在非肺静脉触发灶起源处记录到一小的离散前电位样电图，较原部位电位提前 56 ms，提示该导管可精细定位房颤触发灶。
  • High-Frequency Low-Tidal Volume Ventilation and Procedural Efficiency in Atrial Fibrillation Catheter Ablation: A Single-Center Retrospective Study.
    J Cardiothorac Vasc Anesth · 2026-10-14
    单中心回顾性队列显示，房颤射频消融全麻中采用高频低潮气量通气较标准通气缩短手术时间（110 vs 128分钟）与消融时间（23 vs 28分钟），且不损害气体交换。
  • Temporal dynamics of left atrial reverse remodeling predicts atrial fibrillation ablation outcome: A 3-year longitudinal study.
    J Geriatr Cardiol · 2026-10-14
    房颤射频消融术后左房重构指标呈动态变化，术后3个月斜率平缓及18个月起指标恶化提示复发风险高，36个月左房射血分数预测价值最高。
  • Global research trends in postoperative atrial fibrillation after cardiac surgery: a bibliometric and visual analytics study based on the Web of Science Core Collection
    Journal of Cardiothoracic Surgery · 2026-10-14
    基于Web of Science 1995-2025年1910篇文献的计量分析显示，心脏术后房颤研究以11%年增长率持续增长，美国居核心地位，研究热点从药物预防转向非药物和神经调控策略。
  • Recurrence Rates and Outcomes After First Detected Atrial Fibrillation Episode in a Contemporary Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy Center
    Journal of Cardiovascular Development and Disease · 2026-10-14
    在肥厚型心肌病患者中，首次发现房颤后复发率高，无论是否进行节律控制或使用抗心律失常药物；导管消融与较低的复发率相关。
  • SAP: Food Environment, Healthcare Access, and Atrial Fibrillation/Atrial Flutter Mortality — US Counties, 2018–2024
    Open Science Framework · 2026-10-14
    该研究为美国县级生态学事后分析计划，拟评估食品环境与医疗可及性与房颤/房扑死亡率的关系，但摘要未报告任何结果。
  • Pulsed Field Versus Radiofrequency Ablation of Atrial Fibrillation: Esophageal Lesions and Suspected Gastroparesis
    Pacing Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-14
    单中心队列显示，PFA较RFA显著降低疑似胃轻瘫发生率（0% vs 34.9%），且PFA组无内镜检出食管病变，手术时间更短，365天心律失常复发率相当。
  • Open-Irrigated Versus Non-Irrigated Catheters in SVT Ablation: Substrate-Specific Outcomes in AVRT and AVNRT
    Pacing Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-14
    在首次SVT消融中，开放灌注导管较非灌注导管急性成功率高、复发率低，获益主要见于AVRT而非AVNRT。
  • What are the treatment options for atrial fibrillation with rapid ventricular rate (AF with RVR)?
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-10-14
    房颤伴快速心室率可采用心率与节律控制联合策略，药物不足时导管消融是重要选择。
  • Data and code for "The procedural threshold in atrial fibrillation care: social gradients in treatment escalation and missing Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander evidence"
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-10-14
    该系统综述数据包汇总了37篇报告中365项消融接受率估计，揭示房颤治疗升级存在社会梯度，且缺乏原住民与托雷斯海峡岛民证据。
  • Association of preserved ratio impaired spirometry and restrictive spirometric pattern with incident atrial fibrillation: a cohort study
    npj Primary Care Respiratory Medicine · 2026-10-14
    在无气流受限的成人中，保留比值受损肺功能（PRISm）和限制性肺功能模式（RSP）均与房颤新发风险升高相关，其中PRISm+RSP共存时关联最强（aOR=2.62）。

室性心律失常（9）

  • Dysregulation of TTN Gene Expression, Titin Protein Levels, and Circulating ncRNAs (miR-200a, lncRNA FOXD2-AS1, and snoRNA-42) in Dilated Cardiomyopathy: A Pilot Study
    ACTA MEDICA IRANICA · 2026-10-14
    在扩张型心肌病患者中，TTN基因表达和titin蛋白水平显著升高，且miR-200a和snoRNA-42上调、lncRNA FOXD2-AS1下调，TTN和miR-200a展现出作为无创生物标志物的潜力，并存在性别差异。
  • Vasospastic Angina and Cardiac Arrest
    Circulation Reports · 2026-10-14
    冠状动脉痉挛性心绞痛是院外心脏骤停可治病因之一，约占不明原因病例2-10%，确诊后钙通道阻滞剂为主要治疗，但部分幸存者仍需评估ICD植入。
  • Developing a case management program and clinical practice for high-risk sudden cardiac death patients through the lens of family systems theory
    Frontiers in Cardiovascular Medicine · 2026-10-14
    基于家庭系统理论的个案管理方案可改善SCD高危患者的疾病认知、焦虑抑郁、运动恐惧与家庭功能，并降低MACE发生率。
  • Cardiac screening in the armed forces: bridging policy and practice through expert consensus
    Frontiers in Cardiovascular Medicine · 2026-10-14
    EAPC发布首个军队人员分层心脏筛查共识，建议所有新兵行静息12导联心电图筛查，>40岁者结合心血管风险评估及缺血/冠脉解剖检查。
  • GCTRNet: global context-gated temporal refinement for short-window ECG-based premature ventricular contraction detection
    Frontiers in Physiology · 2026-10-14
    GCTRNet在短窗心电图上实现患者无关的室性早搏检测，MIT-BIH数据库准确率99.65%、敏感度96.82%，跨库CPSC2021准确率97.83%。
  • [Supraventricular tachycardia in advanced age].
    Herzschrittmacherther Elektrophysiol · 2026-10-14
  • Acute lymphocytic myocarditis complicated by bidirectional ventricular tachycardia treated with early steroid use.
    Indian Pacing Electrophysiol J · 2026-10-14
    34岁女性急性淋巴细胞性心肌炎并发双向性室速，常规治疗难治，早期糖皮质激素治疗后心律失常显著抑制、LVEF快速恢复。
  • Frontiers in the Risk Stratification and Prevention of Sudden Cardiac Arrest and Death in Athletes
    Journal of Clinical Medicine · 2026-10-14
    本文为叙述性综述，系统梳理运动员心脏骤停/心源性猝死的流行病学、病因、筛查与新兴技术，强调多模态个体化评估与纵向随访是当前风险分层核心。
  • Hidden and Atypical Presentations of Myocarditis in Sudden Cardiac Death: A Narrative Review.
    Med J Islam Repub Iran · 2026-10-14
    叙述性综述提示，无症状或仅表现为胃肠道等非典型症状的心肌炎在年轻人中可导致猝死，许多貌似健康者的猝死实为漏诊心肌炎。

器械治疗（3）

  • Coronary stent fixation of left ventricular lead during CRT-D implantation: a case series of three patients
    Frontiers in Cardiovascular Medicine · 2026-10-14
    对3例CRT-D植入中因冠状静脉解剖不佳导致左室导线脱位的患者，采用西罗莫司洗脱支架固定导线，短期随访参数稳定，但LVEF无改善。
  • Circadian timing does not modulate human temporal contrast sensitivity.
    J Vis · 2026-10-14
    在40小时强制去同步方案下，12名健康年轻人的褪黑素节律稳健，但2 Hz与8 Hz的亮度及色觉时间对比敏感度均未显示近日节律调制。
  • Leadless Pacemakers After Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement: A Meta-analysis With Time-to-Event Analysis.
    Pacing Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-14
    TAVR后无导线起搏器植入成功率98%，与经静脉起搏器相比住院更短、心衰住院风险更低，生存率相当。

遗传与基础（4）

  • Pathogenesis, screening, and diagnosis of hypertrophic cardiomyopathy.
    BMJ Med · 2026-10-14
    肥厚型心肌病为常染色体显性遗传且具等位基因异质性与不完全外显，诊疗需结合病史、影像与基因检测，预后评估聚焦猝死、心衰与房颤卒中风险。
  • Nox4 Mediates Diastolic Function in a Genetic Model of Pitx2 Haploinsufficiency.
    Can J Physiol Pharmacol · 2026-10-14
    在 Pitx2 单倍剂量不足小鼠中，血管紧张素 II 可诱发更明显的 HFpEF 样重构与舒张功能障碍，Nox4 抑制剂 GKT136901 可部分逆转结构与舒张功能异常。
  • A scalable segment-based in vivo platform for precision modeling of dilated and hypertrophic cardiomyopathies in Drosophila
    Cell & Bioscience · 2026-10-14
    研究在果蝇中建立基于心节的SCOPE平台，鉴定A3节段为最佳功能评估位点，并通过LamC和bt敲低分别成功模拟扩张型和肥厚型心肌病的关键结构与功能特征。
  • Bone Morphogenetic Protein-10 as a Predictor of Atrial Fibrillation Recurrence After Catheter Ablation: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
    J Clin Med Res · 2026-10-14
    本荟萃分析纳入3项前瞻性队列研究，发现循环BMP10水平升高与导管消融后AF复发风险增加相关（未校正合并HR 1.53，95%CI 1.13-2.07），但证据受研究数量少和异质性限制。

其他（1）

  • The internal-to-external validation gap in AI-ECG diagnostic models: protocol and amendments of a systematic review and meta-analysis
    Open Science Framework · 2026-10-14
    该系统评价与荟萃分析方案旨在量化AI-ECG诊断模型内部与外部验证间区分度的配对差异，主要推断量为该差距的95%预测区间。

item.title: 2026-10-13 心脏电生理日报（57 篇）
item.description:
共 57 篇。在日报页面阅读完整解读 →

房颤与消融（26）

  • Prevalence, causes, and predictors of 30-day readmissions after acute myocardial infarction with ventricular arrhythmias: a cohort study using the 2016-2017 national readmissions database.
    Ann Med Surg (Lond) · 2026-10-13
    在因急性心肌梗死合并室性心律失常住院的患者中，30天再入院率为8.7%，主要预测因素包括终末期肾病、卒中、住院超过4天及COPD等合并症。
  • Management of Post-heart Transplant Atrial Fibrillation.
    Arrhythm Electrophysiol Rev · 2026-10-13
    心脏移植后房颤常见，早期多为一过性，晚期提示移植物功能障碍或排斥，管理需个体化并多学科协作。
  • Hybrid high-power short-duration ablation for atrial fibrillation: a meta-analysis
    BMC Cardiovascular Disorders · 2026-10-13
    混合消融策略（后壁vHPSD+前壁AI引导）与单纯vHPSD或单纯AI引导相比，12个月无房性心律失常率及并发症率相当，无任何终点显示优效。
  • Regional E/e′ index on echocardiography predicts atrial fibrillation recurrence following catheter ablation
    BMC Cardiovascular Disorders · 2026-10-13
    在784例非瓣膜性房颤消融患者中，侧壁E/e′比值≥10.8可独立预测术后房颤复发，其判别效能优于室间隔E/e′。
  • Efficacy and safety of perioperative colchicine for prevention of postoperative atrial fibrillation after thoracic cardiac and non-cardiac surgery: an updated systematic review and meta-analysis
    BMC Cardiovascular Disorders · 2026-10-13
    围术期秋水仙碱未能显著降低整体术后房颤风险（RR 0.80，95%CI 0.63–1.02），仅CABG亚组显示获益，但胃肠道不良反应和停药风险明显增加。
  • LAA occluder device impeding pulsed field ablation of an anterior mitral line: a case report about the role of a dual energy source.
    Eur Heart J Case Rep · 2026-10-13
    85岁持续性房颤患者，LAAC装置植入3年后行PFA消融时因阻抗无效反复中止，改用双能量导管射频能量完成二尖瓣前线性消融并实现双向阻滞。
  • Pulsed Field Ablation as First-Line Therapy for the Treatment of Atrial Fibrillation: a FARADISE Sub-Analysis
    Europace · 2026-10-13
    在FARADISE注册研究中，脉冲场消融作为房颤一线治疗安全有效，急性肺静脉隔离成功率高，短期随访房性心律失常复发率低。
  • Social Determinants of Health and Atrial Fibrillation
    Figshare · 2026-10-13
    本文为叙述性综述，探讨健康社会决定因素与房颤的关系，但摘要未报告具体研究数据或结论。
  • Development of an efficient deep learning model for arrhythmia detection from consumer smartwatches.
    Front Artif Intell · 2026-10-13
    在Pulsewatch试验的真实智能手表PPG和加速度数据中，随机森林对NSR、AF和PAC/PVC三分类的总体准确率最高（91.22%），而CNN-BiLSTM对心律失常类的召回率最高（87.37%）。
  • Factors associated with short- and long-term maintenance of sinus rhythm after successful elective electrical cardioversion
    Frontiers in Cardiovascular Medicine · 2026-10-13
    择期电复律成功恢复窦性心律后，1个月维持率89.7%，1年降至40.3%；早期复律、非吸烟、低CHA2DS2-VASc、小左房及抗心律失常治疗与维持窦律相关。
  • Prognostic associations of left atrial strain with major adverse cardiovascular events and atrial fibrillation: Data from the Akershus Cardiac Examination (ACE) 1950 Study.
    Int J Cardiol · 2026-10-13
    在一般人群中，左房僵硬指数（LASI）与主要不良心血管事件（MACE）独立相关，而左房储器应变（LASr）、收缩应变（LASct）和机械离散度（LA MD）与房颤发生独立相关。
  • Characterization of Patients with Atrial Fibrillation Treated Inadequately with Anticoagulants: Why Hospitalization Is Not an Opportunity to Correct Errors.
    Isr Med Assoc J · 2026-10-13
    回顾性队列显示，222例房颤住院患者出院时仍有88例被错误地未接受DOAC治疗，且高龄患者接受的治疗更不规范。
  • Elevated lithium levels in drinking water are associated with higher prevalence of Wolff-Parkinson-White diagnoses.
    J Clin Invest · 2026-10-13
    饮用水锂水平≥75百分位与儿童WPW诊断风险增加71%相关（OR 1.71），提示环境锂暴露可能是旁路形成的可干预危险因素。
  • Ionizing radiation-induced remodelling of the heart: Cellular pathways and crosstalk relevant to stereotactic arrhythmia radioablation (STAR).
    J Physiol · 2026-10-13
    STAR 的早期抗心律失常作用可能源于功能性适应而非结构性重构，但具体细胞机制尚不明确，需进一步研究。
  • Association of the triglyceride-glucose index and triglyceride-glucose-body mass index with postoperative atrial fibrillation in patients undergoing off-pump coronary artery bypass grafting: a retrospective cohort study.
    J Thorac Dis · 2026-10-13
    在非体外循环冠脉搭桥（OPCABG）患者中，术前TyG指数和TyG-BMI升高与术后房颤（POAF）独立相关，每升高1个标准差OR约1.55-1.60，但增量预测价值有限。
  • Echocardiography-based multimodal models for thromboembolic risk prediction in atrial fibrillation: a narrative review.
    J Thorac Dis · 2026-10-13
    整合超声心动图参数的多模态模型可提高房颤血栓栓塞风险预测准确性，但尚不能替代指南抗凝决策。
  • Orai3 deficiency drives atrial remodeling and fibrillation susceptibility via Orai channel remodeling and SOCE hyperactivation.
    Life Sci · 2026-10-13
    Orai3缺失通过Orai通道重塑和SOCE过度激活加剧心房纤维化与电重构，增加房颤易感性，提示Orai3是潜在治疗靶点。
  • Impact of atrial fibrillation catheter ablation o'n tricuspid regurgitation severity: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
    Open Heart · 2026-10-13
    房颤导管消融与中重度及以上三尖瓣反流患病率降低相关（风险差-0.21），维持窦性心律者改善更明显。
  • Association Between Baseline Cognitive Impairment and Atrial Fibrillation Recurrence After Catheter Ablation.
    Pacing Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-13
    在2692例接受导管消融的非瓣膜性房颤患者中，基线轻度认知障碍（MoCA≤26）与消融后房颤复发风险独立相关（aHR 1.48），但复合硬终点无差异。
  • Timing of Catheter Ablation After Heart Failure Diagnosis for Atrial Fibrillation: A Propensity-Score-Matched Analysis.
    Pacing Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-13
    在AF合并HF患者中，HF诊断后3个月内行导管消融较91天后消融可减少电复律和HF加重事件，但全因死亡率无差异。
  • Calibration and selective prediction dominate the cross-dataset gap in atrial fibrillation detection — reproducibility package
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-10-13
    该可重复性包支持一项四数据库留一数据库交叉验证的房颤检测研究，表明校准和选择性预测是跨数据集性能差距的主要来源。
  • How do different rate-controlling agents compare in terms of safety and efficacy for patients with atrial fibrillation in the emergency department?
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-10-13
    急诊房颤急性心率控制中，β受体阻滞剂与非二氢吡啶类钙通道阻滞剂是现有证据支持的主要选择，地高辛仅在心衰等特定亚组有优势且需密切监测。
  • What is the comparative incidence of atrial fibrillation/flutter (any grade and grade ≥ 3) among patients treated with covalent versus non-covalent BTK inhibitors?
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-10-13
    与第一代BTK抑制剂伊布替尼相比，共价及非共价新型BTK抑制剂的心房颤动/心房扑动发生率更低。
  • Temporal Trends and Demographic Disparities in Percutaneous Left Atrial Appendage Occlusion Utilization in the United States, 2016–2022
    medRxiv · 2026-10-13
    2016-2022年美国经皮左心耳封堵术量增长12倍，年龄标化率从34.19升至379.87/10万，住院死亡率仅0.1%，但女性及少数族裔使用率持续偏低。
  • GLP-1 Receptor Agonists and Thromboembolic Risk in Patients With Atrial Fibrillation or Flutter and Type 2 Diabetes: A Propensity Score-Matched Cohort Study.
    Diabetes Obes Metab · 2026-10-12
  • Left pulmonary vein re-isolation and unexpected extensive posterior wall isolation with vein of Marshall ethanol infusion after cryoballoon pulmonary vein isolation and roof-line ablation.
    Indian Pacing Electrophysiol J · 2026-10-12

室性心律失常（10）

  • Life-Threatening Ventricular Tachycardia and Transient Brugada-Like Electrocardiographic Abnormalities Caused by Severe Hyperkalemia Due to Urinary Retention in a 55-Year-Old Man.
    Am J Case Rep · 2026-10-13
    55岁男性因尿潴留致严重高钾血症，表现为持续性室速和短暂Brugada样心电图改变，纠正高钾后心律失常完全消失。
  • Partial pericardial agenesis presenting with positional palpitations
    BMC Cardiovascular Disorders · 2026-10-13
    40岁男性因左侧卧位加重的间歇性心悸就诊，经心脏磁共振确诊为部分性心包缺如（累及右室游离壁心尖三分之一及左室心尖区），保守随访期间症状轻微且影像学无进展。
  • Clinical Outcomes of Anomalous Aortic Origin of Right Coronary Artery from the Left Coronary Sinus.
    Cardiology · 2026-10-13
    在10134例接受冠脉CTA的成人中，偶然发现的右冠状动脉异常起源于左冠窦（AAORCA）患者中期随访心脏死亡率与冠脉解剖正常者无差异（0% vs 0.2%，log-rank P=0.685）。
  • Thirty years of percutaneous epicardial access: reflections on the evolution of ventricular tachycardia substrate mapping and ablation.
    Europace · 2026-10-13
  • The role of vascular resistance on coronary perfusion: differences between healthy and anomalous coronary origin under rest and exercise conditions
    Frontiers in Cardiovascular Medicine · 2026-10-13
    在体外模型中，降低远端冠脉阻力可增加血流但轻度降低主动脉压，而运动时冠脉血流对压力下降更敏感，提示AOLRS在运动时存在血流动力学脆弱性。
  • Fibro-Inflammatory Signaling, Fibrosis, and Microvascular Ischemia as Convergent Translational Substrates of Sudden Cardiac Death in Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy: A Systematic Review.
    J Cardiovasc Transl Res · 2026-10-13
    系统综述提示，在肥厚型心肌病中，纤维化、微血管缺血与促纤维炎症信号通路可能共同构成室性心律失常与心源性猝死的基质，但尚缺乏前瞻性结局验证。
  • Identifying the High-Risk Arrhythmic Mitral Valve Prolapse Phenotype by Imaging.
    JACC Cardiovasc Imaging · 2026-10-13
    综述指出，致心律失常性二尖瓣脱垂（AMVP）中的恶性表型多见于年轻女性，需结合超声、心脏磁共振及机器学习识别高危特征以进行个体化风险分层。
  • Refractory Ventricular Tachycardia-Induced Severe Cardiomyopathy in a Child: Successful Radiofrequency Ablation With ECMO Support.
    JACC Case Rep · 2026-10-13
    7岁女孩因右室调节束附近局灶性室速致严重心肌病，药物及电复律无效，在ECMO支持下射频消融成功，双心室功能恢复正常。
  • Going around phase defects: Addressing a fundamental flaw of phase singularity detection
    PLoS Computational Biology · 2026-10-13
    扩展相位标测通过显式检测相位缺陷，在模拟、实验和临床数据中消除旋转驱动子的误检和漏检，实现更一致的旋转动态表征。
  • Intraprocedural Cardiac Arrest in Patients Undergoing Percutaneous Coronary Interventions in the United States: An Analysis of the NCDR CathPCI Registry.
    JACC Cardiovasc Interv · 2026-10-12
    美国NCDR CathPCI注册研究显示，2018-2023年经皮冠状动脉介入治疗（PCI）术中心脏骤停（IPCA）发生率为0.93%，且随时间上升，但风险校正后院内死亡率略有下降。

器械治疗（5）

  • Left ventricular ejection fraction recovery under contemporary quadruple guideline-directed therapy and the need for ICD/CRT-D implantation in HFrEF: a retrospective single-center cohort study
    Expert Rev Cardiovasc Ther · 2026-10-13
    在当代四联GDMT下，HFrEF患者约3个月LVEF显著恢复，44.6%植入ICD/CRT-D，基线左室舒张末径较大与恢复较差及植入风险相关。
  • Turning the tide in heart failure: A case report of one-year improvement in a CRT-P super-responder with HFrEF and LBBB
    Heart Science Journal · 2026-10-13
    76岁HFrEF合并LBBB女性植入CRT-P后6个月无应答，经超声指导的AV/VV间期优化，1年时LVEF从28%升至67%，NYHA I-II级，呈超应答。
  • Successful Bailout Retrieval of an Active-Fixation Atrial Leadless Pacemaker Following Suspected Tissue Entrapment During Repositioning.
    J Arrhythm · 2026-10-13
    一例81岁女性在AVEIR AR无导线起搏器重新定位时疑似心肌嵌顿，通过推进保护套完全包裹装置实现安全回收。
  • Intraoperative Application of the PRAETORIAN Score to Predict Optimal Subcutaneous Implantable Cardioverter-Defibrillator Placement.
    J Arrhythm · 2026-10-13
    在124例接受S-ICD植入的日本患者中，术中仰卧位PRAETORIAN评分与常规站立位评分高度一致，仅2例发生临床风险类别重分类，BMI升高与评分不一致相关。
  • Conduction System Versus Right Ventricular Pacing in Patients Undergoing TAVR: A Multicenter Propensity-Matched Study.
    JACC Cardiovasc Interv · 2026-10-12
    TAVR术后需起搏患者中，心脏生理性起搏较右室起搏降低主要终点（心血管死亡或心衰住院）风险，主要由心衰住院减少驱动。

影像与标测（2）

  • Progression of Tricuspid Regurgitation After Cardiac Implantable Electronic Device Implantation and Its Impact on Mortality and Hospitalization: A Single-Center Cohort Study.
    J Cardiovasc Electrophysiol · 2026-10-13
    单中心303例CIED植入患者中约1/3在1年内三尖瓣反流进展至少1级，进展独立预测心血管住院（HR 1.64），但不独立预测死亡。
  • Beyond the held-out split: validation design, data leakage and cross-device generalisability of machine-learning arrhythmia detection from single-lead and wearable electrocardiography. Protocol for a scoping review
    Open Science Framework · 2026-10-13
    本范围综述方案拟系统梳理单导联与可穿戴心电机器学习心律失常检测模型的验证设计，按V0-V6分级评估验证水平、训练测试是否按人分离及跨设备等域偏移测试情况。

遗传与基础（13）

  • Clinical characteristics, genetic findings, and outcomes in 77 Chinese children with dilated cardiomyopathy who underwent genetic testing: a retrospective study
    BMC Pediatrics · 2026-10-13
    77例中国扩张型心肌病患儿中22.1%检出致病/可能致病变异，基因阳性者无事件生存显著更差（P=0.025），但校正后关联未达统计学显著。
  • Impact of 18FDG-Avidity and Immunosuppression on Idiopathic and Genetic Cardiomyopathies.
    Circ Cardiovasc Imaging · 2026-10-13
    在无明确心脏结节病的遗传性或特发性心肌病患者中，心肌18FDG摄取与心衰或心律失常风险无显著独立关联，免疫抑制治疗也未改善预后。
  • Artificial Intelligence-Enhanced Cardiac Magnetic Resonance in Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy: Diagnosis, Phenotypic Characterization, and Risk Prediction
    Diagnostics · 2026-10-13
    AI增强的心脏磁共振在肥厚型心肌病的诊断、表型刻画和风险预测中展现出潜力，但多数研究为回顾性、缺乏前瞻性临床效用验证，距离常规应用尚有距离。
  • Genotype and arrhythmic risk in dilated cardiomyopathy.
    Eur Heart J · 2026-10-13
    在2660例扩张型心肌病患者中，携带高致心律失常基因（LMNA等）P/LP变异者发生主要室性心律失常的风险是基因阴性者的3.25倍，且独立于年龄、性别和LVEF。
  • Atrial fibroblast metabolic reprogramming in atrial fibrillation: a candidate mechanism within multicellular atrial cardiomyopathy.
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-10-13
    本叙述性综述指出，心房成纤维细胞代谢重编程是连接肥胖、糖尿病等代谢应激与房颤心房基质形成的可检验候选机制，但尚无研究直接测定人房成纤维细胞代谢，因果性未确立。
  • Case Report: Fabry cardiomyopathy associated with a novel truncating GLA variant, c.837_838delinsAT, p.(Gln280Ter).
    Front Med (Lausanne) · 2026-10-13
    一例52岁女性肥厚型心肌病患者检出既往未报道的GLA截短变异c.837_838delinsAT p.(Gln280Ter)，确诊Fabry病心肌病，经心血管风险评估后植入ICD并启动酶替代治疗。
  • Daytime benign, nocturnal lethal: Diagnostic challenges and fatal delays in phenotypic type 3 long QT syndrome: A case report
    Heart Science Journal · 2026-10-13
    17岁女性LQT3表型患者因夜间晕厥被误诊为精神性，确诊后ICD植入因考试推迟，最终发生夜间TdP猝死。
  • Genetic landscape of paediatric channelopathies and cardiomyopathies in Hong Kong.
    Hong Kong Med J · 2026-10-13
    香港单中心165例儿童离子通道病与心肌病先证者中57.0%检出致病/可能致病变异，CPVT检出率最高（81.8%），一级亲属级联筛查阳性率27.3%。
  • Postmortem genetic testing after sudden unexplained death: a proposed medico-legal implementation framework for familial risk
    J Forensic Leg Med · 2026-10-13
    本文提出一个法医学与临床遗传学衔接的实施框架，用于猝死尸检后基因检测中家族风险的分层管理，强调即使基因检测阴性或未进行，也应基于表型或情境进行家族临床转诊。
  • Sinoatrial node dysfunction: molecular mechanisms, arrhythmogenesis, and translational pathways toward precision therapy.
    Pharmacol Ther · 2026-10-13
    本综述系统整合了窦房结功能障碍（SND）的分子机制与转化研究路径，提出基于机制的SND分类以支持精准治疗，弥补现有起搏治疗无法纠正分子和组织层面病变的缺口。
  • Xinluo plan: analysis code, logs and result tables for a single-nucleus, spatial, genetic and bulk transcriptomic atlas of the human atrial neural compartment in atrial fibrillation (v1.0)
    ScienceDB · 2026-10-13
    基于公共人类左房单核RNA测序数据构建心房神经组分图谱，发现施万细胞而非神经元占主导，且房颤中髓鞘化施万细胞特征下调。
  • Atrial fibrillation begets atrial fibrillation – serum-driven amplification of atrial electrical instability
    medRxiv · 2026-10-13
    持续性AF患者血清在恢复窦律后仍具有促进心房电不稳定的生物活性，提示“AF begets AF”存在可逆的循环因子机制。
  • Network toxicology, machine learning, single-cell analysis, and molecular docking reveal 6PPD/6PPD-Q-associated atrial fibrillation signatures.
    J Adv Res · 2026-10-12
    环境污染物6PPD/6PPD-Q通过靶向DDR1、BCHE、HTR2B、KCNJ3等核心基因促进房颤发生，动物实验证实暴露增加房颤可诱发性并延长持续时间。

其他（1）

  • FPGA-Based Low-Power Architecture for Real-Time Arrhythmia Detection Using Fixed-Length Segmentation
    International Journal of Innovative Research in Technology · 2026-10-13
    基于FPGA的实时心电监测原型系统在89.7秒测试中实现99.68%灵敏度和99.74%阳性预测值，功耗仅160mW。

item.title: 2026-10-12 心脏电生理日报（42 篇）
item.description:
共 42 篇。在日报页面阅读完整解读 →

房颤与消融（21）

  • PRE-ABLATION SERUM BIOMARKERS ASSOCIATED WITH ATRIAL FIBRILLATION RECURRENCE: A SYSTEMATIC REVIEW AND META-ANALYSIS TO IMPROVE PATIENT SELECTION FOR CATHETER ABLATION
    Artefactum · 2026-10-12
    本系统综述与荟萃分析纳入30项研究，发现炎症生物标志物和复合评分与房颤消融术后复发相关，但证据异质性大，需多中心验证。
  • Circulating osteoprotegerin levels in atrial fibrillation: a systematic review and meta-analysis
    BMC Cardiovascular Disorders · 2026-10-12
    该系统评价纳入35篇文献，房颤患者血浆OPG合并均值约6.47 pmol/L，但异质性极高（I²=95.4%），现有证据不支持统一的房颤与对照比较效应或诊断阈值。
  • Cardiac-Net: A Wearable ECG Prototype and Hybrid CNN–Transformer Model for Atrial Fibrillation Detection in Long-Term ECG Recordings
    BioMedInformatics · 2026-10-12
    Cardiac-Net可穿戴心电系统联合混合CNN-Transformer模型在长程心电中检测房颤，记录级交叉验证AUC 0.953，但误报负担高且部分患者检测失败，临床部署仍需优化。
  • Left Atrial Appendage Closure or Medical Therapy in Atrial Fibrillation: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
    Cardiology · 2026-10-12
    纳入5项RCT共5404例房颤患者的荟萃分析显示，左心耳封堵在全因死亡和大出血方面不劣于药物治疗，但在卒中、心血管死亡及系统性栓塞等终点未达到非劣效。
  • Pre-excited atrial fibrillation in a woman with minimal pre-excitation: a case report
    Chulalongkorn Medical Journal · 2026-10-12
    46岁泰国女性以预激性房颤为首发表现，电复律后仅见微小预激，电生理检查证实左外侧旁路并成功消融，提示微小预激并不代表低危。
  • Tricuspid Stenosis Due to Cardiac Sarcoma.
    Cureus · 2026-10-12
    32岁男性原发性心脏双相滑膜肉瘤致三尖瓣流入道梗阻，术后出现心房扑动及左室功能不全，需电复律。
  • The Impact of Energy Drinks on the Genesis of Cardiac Arrhythmias: A Narrative Review
    Cureus · 2026-10-12
    健康人群单次饮用能量饮料可致QTc间期延长，但未记录到临床显著心律失常；病例报告提示能量饮料（尤其与酒精同服）可能与房颤发生相关。
  • GLP-1 Receptor Agonists and Thromboembolic Risk in Patients With Atrial Fibrillation or Flutter and Type 2 Diabetes: A Propensity Score-Matched Cohort Study
    Diabetes Obes Metab · 2026-10-12
    在房颤/房扑合并2型糖尿病患者中，GLP-1受体激动剂与血栓栓塞风险的关系经倾向评分匹配队列研究评估，摘要未报告具体效应量。
  • Physical activity, atrial fibrillation and the dose-response relationship: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
    Eur J Prev Cardiol · 2026-10-12
    体力活动与房颤风险呈U型关系，每周26 MET-hr时风险最低，超过78 MET-hr（约6-7小时耐力训练）风险反而增加。
  • Effect of Antiarrhythmic Drug Treatment on the Clinical Recurrence Rate of Atrial Arrhythmia Within 90 Days After Primary Pulmonary Vein Isolation
    Indian Journal of Clinical Cardiology · 2026-10-12
    首次肺静脉隔离后90天空白期内，抗心律失常药物未降低临床房性心律失常复发率（32% vs 24%，P=0.51），但治疗组首次复发时间更早（12天 vs 43天，P=0.04）。
  • Left pulmonary vein re-isolation and unexpected extensive posterior wall isolation with vein of Marshall ethanol infusion after cryoballoon pulmonary vein isolation and roof-line ablation
    Indian Pacing Electrophysiol J · 2026-10-12
  • Quality and Engagement Metrics of Short Versus Long-Form Videos on Atrial Fibrillation
    Journal of Consumer Health on the Internet · 2026-10-12
    在房颤在线视频中，短视频与长视频的可理解性、可行动性和整体质量均较低，且视频时长与质量、上传者类型与受众参与度之间无显著关联。
  • Review of Transcutaneous Vagus Nerve Stimulation as a Therapeutic Approach for the Suppression of Ventricular Premature Contractions
    Medical Science Monitor · 2026-10-12
    经皮迷走神经刺激（tVNS）通过调节自主神经平衡可能抑制室性早搏（PVC），但现有临床证据尚属初步且异质，需进一步验证。
  • Left Atrial Appendage Occlusion with the Watchman FLX Device: A Single-Centre Retrospective Analysis of Procedural and One-Year Clinical Outcomes
    Medical Sciences · 2026-10-12
    单中心100例非瓣膜性房颤患者植入Watchman FLX左心耳封堵器，装置植入成功率100%，围术期并发症7%（大出血6%、心包填塞1%），1年卒中率1%、死亡率11%。
  • Potassium repletion at a serum potassium of 3.3-3.7 mmol/L and new-onset atrial fibrillation in adult ICU patients without cardiac surgery: a pre-registered target trial emulation in MIMIC-IV
    Open Science Framework · 2026-10-12
    在非心脏手术ICU患者中，血钾3.3-3.7 mmol/L时启动补钾与不补钾的新发AF风险对比，将通过MIMIC-IV目标试验模拟评估。
  • Blanking Period after Atrial Fibrillation Catheter Ablation: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
    Pacing Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-12
    房颤消融后空白期内早期房性心律失常复发与晚期复发相关，且关联强度逐月增强，第三个月最强（OR 21.4），提示空白期或应短于常规3个月。
  • Timing of Catheter Ablation After Heart Failure Diagnosis for Atrial Fibrillation: A Propensity-Score-Matched Analysis
    Pacing Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-12
    在AF合并HF患者中，HF诊断后3个月内行导管消融较91天后消融可减少电复律和HF加重事件，但全因死亡率无差异。
  • Association Between Baseline Cognitive Impairment and Atrial Fibrillation Recurrence After Catheter Ablation
    Pacing Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-12
    在2692例接受导管消融的非瓣膜性房颤患者中，基线轻度认知障碍（MoCA≤26）与消融后房颤复发风险独立相关（aHR 1.48），但复合硬终点无差异。
  • Unipolar electrogram-guided vs. ablation index-guided high-power short-duration pulmonary vein isolation in patients with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation: a single-center randomized controlled trial.
    Quant Imaging Med Surg · 2026-10-12
    在阵发性房颤患者中，UPE引导的HPSD射频消融相比固定AI引导可提高肺静脉首次隔离率并降低急性肺静脉再连接率，但12个月房颤复发率无差异。
  • Clinical and nosological determinants of zonulin and trimethylamine N-oxide levels in patientswith atrial fibrillation
    Russian Journal of Cardiology · 2026-10-12
    房颤患者血浆TMAO和粪便连蛋白水平显著高于健康对照，且与房颤类型、EHRA分级及高血压、心衰相关。
  • Use Of a Selective Cardiac Myosin Atpase Inhibitor in a Patient with Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy with Critical Left Ventricular Outflow Tract Obstruction and Pulmonary Hypertension
    The Russian Archives of Internal Medicine · 2026-10-12
    一例50岁女性梗阻性HCM合并重度肺动脉高压患者，经mavacamten治疗3.5个月后sPAP从114降至71 mmHg、LVOT压差从112降至73 mmHg，成功接受室间隔心肌切除术。

室性心律失常（10）

  • Life-Threatening Ventricular Tachycardia and Transient Brugada-Like Electrocardiographic Abnormalities Caused by Severe Hyperkalemia Due to Urinary Retention in a 55-Year-Old Man
    American Journal of Case Reports · 2026-10-12
    55岁男性因尿潴留致严重高钾血症，表现为持续性室速和Brugada样心电图改变，纠正高钾后心律失常完全消失。
  • Anesthetic Challenges in Interarterial Right Coronary Artery Anomaly from the Left Sinus of Valsalva: A Case Report.
    Ann Card Anaesth · 2026-10-12
    一例22岁健康男性因娱乐性吸入剂使用发生院外心脏骤停，影像发现右冠状动脉起自左冠状窦并呈动脉间走行，在个体化麻醉管理下完成手术再植并顺利康复。
  • Clinical practice guidelines: management of non-post-operative supra-ventricular tachycardia in neonates and children less than 18 years old hospitalized in a Pediatric Intensive Care Unit.
    Ann Intensive Care · 2026-10-12
    法国专家组发布21条儿童非术后室上性心动过速管理指南，仅5条基于GRADE证据，16条为专家意见，均获强力推荐。
  • Understanding the Mortality Trends in Patients With Ventricular Arrhythmias and Cardiomyopathy: A 25‐Year Retrospective Analysis From 1999–2024
    Annals of Noninvasive Electrocardiology · 2026-10-12
    1999至2024年美国≥25岁室性心律失常合并心肌病患者死亡例数达81204例，年龄调整死亡率从2.54降至1.01/10万（AAPC -3.55%，P<0.000001），但性别、种族和地域差异持续存在。
  • Pituitary Histopathology in Fatal Heroin Intoxication, Suicidal Hanging, and Sudden Cardiac Death: An Exploratory Retrospective Autopsy Study
    Forensic Sciences · 2026-10-12
    探索性尸检研究显示，垂体后叶出血见于缢死与海洛因致死但心脏性猝死对照无，海洛因组缺血坏死更重，样本小仅HE染色待验证。
  • Incremental prognostic value of hepatic tissue alterations derived from cardiac magnetic resonance imaging for arrhythmogenic right ventricular cardiomyopathy: a case-control study.
    Quant Imaging Med Surg · 2026-10-12
    在94例确诊ARVC患者中，基于心脏磁共振T1 mapping获得的肝脏native T1是持续性室性心律失常的独立预测因子，将其加入ARVC风险评分和右室整体纵向应变模型可提升预测效能。
  • Corrigendum to “Twenty years in the battle against sudden cardiac death: progress, pitfalls, and prospects for the future” [Resusc. Plus 31 (2026) 101401]
    Resuscitation Plus · 2026-10-12
  • [Sudden cardiac death and hypertrophic cardiomyopathy : risk assessment and indications for implantable cardioverter-defibrillator].
    Rev Med Liege · 2026-10-12
    本文综述ESC与ACC/AHA指南对肌节蛋白性肥厚型心肌病一级预防ICD植入指征的差异，强调基于危险因素整合评估的个体化决策。
  • Clinical Case of a Patient with Stable Ventricular Tachycardia and Primary Hyperaldosteronism
    The Russian Archives of Internal Medicine · 2026-10-12
    37岁女性因稳定型多形性室速就诊，意外发现原发性醛固酮增多症，提示电解质筛查在心律失常患者中的重要性。
  • Ectopic activity and β-adrenergic reactivity of erythrocyte membranes in children with ventricular arrhythmia after radiofrequency ablation: a pilot observational study
    Сибирский журнал клинической и экспериментальной медицины · 2026-10-12
    儿童室性心律失常射频消融术后，术前较低的β-肾上腺素能受体反应性与无复发相关，术后晚期无复发者该指标显著降低。

器械治疗（4）

  • Pacemaker Dependency in Patients Undergoing Implantation of Dual-chamber Devices After Alcohol Septum Ablation: A Retrospective Analysis.
    CJC Open · 2026-10-12
    酒精室间隔消融术后因AV阻滞植入双腔起搏器的HOCM患者中，仅44.8%长期存在起搏器依赖，提示多数患者AV传导可恢复。
  • Harmonised and Traceable Medical Metrology Infrastructure for Safe and Reliable Healthcare in Europe
    Comillas Repository (Comillas Pontifical University) · 2026-10-12
    欧洲Met4MED项目旨在为心电图机、脑电图机、电外科设备和除颤器等医疗电气设备开发可溯源计量方法，并利用人工智能提升关键参数准确性。
  • Machine Learning-Based Prediction of Long-Term Mortality in Patients with Implantable Cardioverter Defibrillators
    Journal of Cardiovascular Development and Disease · 2026-10-12
    基于3321例ICD/CRT-D患者，随机生存森林模型预测全因死亡表现最佳（C-index 0.71），高危组死亡风险为低危组4.5倍，LVEDD是最重要预测因子。
  • [Leadless pacemakers : current evidence and future perspectives].
    Rev Med Liege · 2026-10-12
    无导线起搏器从单腔发展到双腔，AVEIR系统实现心房与心室模块间直接通信，并支持取出与重新定位，安全性与传统起搏器相当。

遗传与基础（5）

  • Generation and Functional Characterization of Cadaver-Derived iPSC-Cardiomyocytes: A Feasibility Study Toward Functional Molecular Autopsy in Sudden Cardiac Death
    Cardiogenetics · 2026-10-12
    从7例尸检者跟腱培养成纤维细胞，3例成功重编程为iPSC并分化为心肌细胞，证实死后心肌细胞功能研究可行。
  • Multichannel Dysfunction Associated With a Dominant-Negative KCNH2 Missense Variant, p.G604S, Results in Action Potential Duration Prolongation and Early Afterdepolarizations in a Patient-Specific, Reengineered Cardiomyocyte Model of Type 2 Long-QT Syndrome.
    Circ Arrhythm Electrophysiol · 2026-10-12
    在KCNH2-G604S iPSC-CMs中，IKr严重缺失合并持续性ICa,L增益导致APD显著延长和早期后除极，钙通道阻滞剂可逆转。
  • Clustered Regularly Interspaced Short Palindromic Repeats (CRISPR)-Based Genome Editing in Inherited Cardiovascular Diseases: Therapeutic Advances, Emerging Editing Platforms, and Translational Challenges.
    Cureus · 2026-10-12
    CRISPR及其衍生编辑平台在遗传性心血管病临床前模型中显示纠正致病突变的潜力，但脱靶效应、心脏递送和免疫原性等转化障碍尚未解决。
  • KCNJ2 gene spontaneous missense mutation in a child with Andersen-Tawil syndrome: a case report
    Frontiers in Pediatrics · 2026-10-12
    一例10岁Andersen-Tawil综合征患儿携带新发KCNJ2 c.461G>A（p.C154Y）杂合突变，并合并亚临床甲状腺功能减退，经普罗帕酮和乙酰唑胺治疗后短期预后良好。
  • Network toxicology, machine learning, single-cell analysis, and molecular docking reveal 6PPD/6PPD-Q-associated atrial fibrillation signatures
    J Adv Res · 2026-10-12
    环境污染物6PPD/6PPD-Q通过靶向DDR1、BCHE、HTR2B和KCNJ3等核心基因，可能促进心房颤动的发生，动物实验证实暴露增加AF可诱发性并延长持续时间。

其他（2）

  • Inter-Lead RRI Agreement Between Lead I and Lead II Across Diagnostic ECG Categories: Pilot Evidence for Wearable HRV Monitoring
    Applied Sciences · 2026-10-12
    在正常心电图中，单导联（I导联）与II导联的RR间期及HRV时域指标一致性良好，但病理心电图一致性下降，提示可穿戴单导联设备需按导联校准。
  • Comparison of Electrocardiogram Interpretation Between Artificial Intelligence and Healthcare Professionals
    CRC Press eBooks · 2026-10-12
    在25名健康成年男性中，GPT-5与医疗专业人员在心率、T波振幅和PR间期上无显著差异，但P波振幅和QT间期存在统计学差异，提示AI心电图分析整体一致但仍有局限。

item.title: 2026-10-11 心脏电生理日报（57 篇）
item.description:
共 57 篇。在日报页面阅读完整解读 →

房颤与消融（37）

  • Impact of COPD or Asthma on the Risk of Atrial Fibrillation and Comorbidities in Al-Wahda Derna Hospital
    AlQalam Journal of Medical and Applied Sciences · 2026-10-11
    在COPD或哮喘患者中，COPD患者AF患病率更高，AF与高龄、严重肺功能损害及心血管合并症显著相关，合并AF者住院增加、功能能力下降。
  • Pulsed field ablation with Renal denervation for persistent Atrial fibrIllation: Rationale and design of the PRAISE-AF randomized trial.
    Am Heart J · 2026-10-11
    PRAISE-AF试验将评估脉冲场消融联合肾去交感神经术能否降低持续性房颤患者术后12个月房性快速性心律失常复发率。
  • Predictive Value of Left Atrial Strain Combined with Low-Voltage Substrate for Recurrence After Radiofrequency Catheter Ablation in Persistent Atrial Fibrillation
    Diagnostics · 2026-10-11
    在持续性房颤射频消融患者中，术后3个月左房储备应变（LASr-3mo）与低电压区（LVA）百分比均与复发独立相关，联合模型显示良好区分度（校正AUC 0.913）。
  • Longitudinal Left Atrial Remodeling With Pharmacological Rhythm Versus Rate Control in Paroxysmal and Persistent Atrial Fibrillation.
    Echocardiography · 2026-10-11
    在阵发性或持续性房颤患者中，药物节律控制较心率控制可延缓左房重构（随访LAVI低9.38 mL/m2），并降低全因死亡或卒中住院风险（HR 0.46）。
  • Sleep-Disordered Breathing and Sleep Fragmentation in Relation to Atrial Fibrillation Risk: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
    J Arrhythm · 2026-10-11
    睡眠呼吸障碍显著增加新发房颤（RR 1.67）与复发房颤（RR 1.55）风险，AHI每升高1单位新发风险增2%，提示其可能是可干预的房颤危险因素。
  • Development and Validation of a Novel Contact Force-Integrated Pulsed Field Quantization Index for Pulmonary Vein Isolation in a Porcine Model.
    J Cardiovasc Electrophysiol · 2026-10-11
    在猪模型中开发并验证了整合接触力的双极脉冲场消融量化指数PFQI，可实时准确预测损伤深度，指导肺静脉隔离实现100%急性隔离和30天持久隔离，且无外损伤。
  • Left Atrial Appendage Closure Versus Oral Anticoagulation for Prevention of Stroke or Systemic Embolism in Patients With Atrial Fibrillation: An Updated Meta-Analysis of 7004 Patients Across Six Randomized Trials.
    J Cardiovasc Electrophysiol · 2026-10-11
    纳入6项RCT共7004例AF患者，LAAC与OAC的卒中或系统性栓塞风险相当，但LAAC缺血性卒中或系统性栓塞风险升高41%，非手术相关出血显著减少。
  • Changes in Lead Parameters of Cardiac Implantable Electronic Devices After VT/VF Ablation Using a Dual-Energy Lattice-Tip Catheter.
    J Cardiovasc Electrophysiol · 2026-10-11
    双能量 lattice-tip 导管行室性心律失常消融后，起搏阈值急性升高与消融部位和导线解剖关系相关，但3个月时均恢复至基线水平。
  • Pulmonary Artery Approach for Radiofrequency Catheter Ablation of Atrial Tachycardia Originating From Left Atrial Post Wall: A Case Report.
    J Cardiovasc Electrophysiol · 2026-10-11
    右肺动脉途径可成功消融起源于左心房后壁顶部的心外膜房性心动过速，为心内膜消融失败病例提供替代策略。
  • Temporal Association Between Aromatase Inhibitor Initiation and New-Onset Atrial Fibrillation: A Case Report.
    J Pharm Technol · 2026-10-11
    一例71岁绝经后乳腺癌患者启动芳香化酶抑制剂后新发房颤，提示二者可能存在时间关联，需提高临床警惕。
  • Recurrent stent thrombosis in two coronary territories within two months in a patient with atrial fibrillation on triple antithrombotic therapy: a case report and literature review
    MedPeer publisher · 2026-10-11
    一例69岁阵发性房颤患者在接受三联抗栓治疗期间，两个月内于两个冠状动脉区域复发支架内血栓，提示即使最大强度抗栓治疗也不能消除支架血栓风险。
  • Blanking Period after Atrial Fibrillation Catheter Ablation: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
    Pacing Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-11
    房颤消融后空白期内早期房性心律失常复发与晚期复发相关，且关联强度逐月递增，第三个月最强（OR 21.4），提示传统3个月空白期可能过长。
  • Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease and Atrial Fibrillation Recurrence After Catheter Ablation: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
    Rev Cardiovasc Med · 2026-10-11
    MASLD与房颤导管消融术后复发风险显著相关（RR 1.77），FIB-4和NFS中/高纤维化风险亦与复发增加相关。
  • Oral Anticoagulants in Patients With Atrial Fibrillation and Advanced or End-Stage Renal Disease: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
    Rev Cardiovasc Med · 2026-10-11
    在晚期CKD非透析房颤患者中，DOAC（尤其阿哌沙班）较华法林出血更少且疗效相当；透析依赖ESRD患者抗凝净获益仍不明确，华法林证据不一致。
  • Adverse Event Landscape of Pulsed Field Ablation Catheters: A Computational Review of FDA MAUDE Post-Market Surveillance Data.
    Rev Cardiovasc Med · 2026-10-11
    基于FDA MAUDE数据库6930份PFA导管报告，60.4%可归类为不良事件，设备故障、心包填塞/积液和卒中/TIA最常见，PFA特异性生理事件占8.9%。
  • Fibroblast Activation Protein Inhibitor Positron Emission Tomography Imaging in Atrial Fibrillation: Current Evidence and Future Perspectives.
    Rev Cardiovasc Med · 2026-10-11
    FAPI PET/CT可无创显示心房成纤维细胞活化与纤维化基质，为房颤基质成像提供新分子影像手段，但现有证据限于综述层面，尚缺临床结局数据。
  • Risk of Atrial Fibrillation Recurrence After Modified Cox-Maze IV Surgery: Comparing Atrial Functional Mitral Regurgitation and Rheumatic Mitral Regurgitation.
    Rev Cardiovasc Med · 2026-10-11
    在接受二尖瓣手术联合改良Cox-Maze IV的长期持续性房颤患者中，心房功能性二尖瓣反流（AFMR）患者术后房颤复发风险显著高于风湿性二尖瓣反流（RMR）患者，1年复发率31.2% vs 6.2%。
  • The "Floating Lotus" Sign on Intracardiac Echocardiography: Characterization and Predictors of a Novel Left Atrial Appendage Pseudo-Thrombus.
    Rev Cardiovasc Med · 2026-10-11
    ICE引导的房颤消融或左心耳封堵术中，27.9%患者出现“浮莲征”伪血栓，心衰（LVEF<55%）是其唯一独立预测因素。
  • Enhancer of Zeste Homolog 2 Inhibition Attenuates Atrial Fibrillation Post-Myocardial Infarction Through Reduced Atrial Fibrosis.
    Rev Cardiovasc Med · 2026-10-11
    小鼠心肌梗死后EZH2上调并伴H3K27me3升高与心房纤维化，EZH2抑制剂GSK126可减轻纤维化并降低房颤发生率。
  • A CASE REPORT ON VALVULAR HEART DISEASE WITH ATRIAL FIBRILLATION
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-10-11
    62岁男性二尖瓣重度反流合并快速心室率房颤，经抗凝、控率及利尿等治疗后症状与心室率改善。
  • af-onset-within-patient: a within-patient test of AF onset predictors, including the published AF-Mamba weights
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-10-11
    在患者自身对照设计中，针对健康对照训练的房颤发作预测模型（含已发表AF-Mamba权重）能否识别同一患者临近的房颤发作，结果显示其区分能力有限。
  • Pulsed Field Versus Radiofrequency Ablation For Repeat Ablation of Atrial Fibrillation: Evaluation of Outcomes
    medRxiv · 2026-10-11
    在既往RFA后复发房颤患者中，再次消融采用PFA较RFA复发率更低（28% vs 55%），无心律失常生存更长，手术时间更短但透视时间更长，安全性相当。
  • Experience of using Etacizin in patients with vagal atrial fibrillation
    Новые Санкт-Петербургские врачебные ведомости. · 2026-10-11
    摘要原文缺失，无法提取研究对象、样本量及结局数据，无法给出核心结论。
  • Parameters of atrial remodeling in patients with persistent atrial fibrillation after elective restoration of sinus rhythm
    Новые Санкт-Петербургские врачебные ведомости. · 2026-10-11
    摘要原文缺失，无法提取研究对象、样本量及主要终点等关键信息，无法形成可用的中文解读。
  • Factors influencing the maintenance of sinus rhythm one year after cardioversion in patients with persistent atrial fibrillation
    Новые Санкт-Петербургские врачебные ведомости. · 2026-10-11
    在105例持续性房颤患者中，电复律后1年房颤复发率为54.3%；达标血压和血脂水平降低复发风险，而左房容积指数增大增加复发风险。
  • Clinical Impact of Interlesion Distance on Acute Pulmonary Vein Isolation Success in Patients With Paroxysmal Atrial Fibrillation.
    Circ Rep · 2026-10-10
    在阵发性房颤患者中，采用6mm病灶间距离（ILD）策略的急性肺静脉隔离（PVI）成功率劣于标准4mm策略（56.7% vs 68.7%），尽管前者显著减少了射频消融次数和时间。
  • Trends in the incidence of atrial fibrillation and the prescription of oral anticoagulants in adults with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease in UK primary care (2010-2022): a cohort study.
    EClinicalMedicine · 2026-10-10
    英国COPD患者房颤发病率2010-2022年上升29%，OAC使用虽增2.9倍但仅66.3%在确诊后一年内启用，老年、非白人及重度COPD者用药不足。
  • Arrhythmic risk in axial spondyloarthritis: a narrative review.
    EULAR Rheumatol Open · 2026-10-10
    综述指出轴性脊柱关节炎患者房室传导阻滞与房颤患病率升高，且与疾病活动度相关，控制全身炎症或可辅助抗心律失常治疗。
  • Unintended right atrial lesions after monopolar biphasic lattice-tip pulsed-field ablation: a case series.
    Eur Heart J Case Rep · 2026-10-10
    4例房颤患者使用格点尖端单极双相脉冲场消融行肺静脉隔离后，电解剖标测发现右心房后壁、房间隔或上腔静脉出现非预期损伤。
  • Discontinuation of oral anticoagulants is common after catheter ablation in older patients with atrial fibrillation.
    Eur Heart J Open · 2026-10-10
    老年房颤患者消融后口服抗凝药停用普遍，即使CHA2DS2-VASc≥3者1年内也有44%停用，与指南推荐存在差距。
  • Left Atrial Enlargement Identifies Risk of Stroke Independent of Atrial Fibrillation.
    J Am Heart Assoc · 2026-10-10
    在无房颤人群中，左房扩大与卒中风险独立相关（HR 1.49），且不依赖于新发房颤，提示左房扩大可作为血栓栓塞风险的标志。
  • Left Bundle Branch Area Pacing Improves Atrial Function and Reverses Atrial Remodeling in Dyssynchrony Heart Failure Model.
    J Am Heart Assoc · 2026-10-10
    在快速起搏诱导的犬失同步心衰模型中，左束支区域起搏可显著逆转心房功能、细胞和分子重构，效果优于左室间隔起搏，或可解释其减少新发房颤的机制。
  • First-in-human experience and one-year outcomes using a novel conformal pulsed-field ablation balloon catheter for pulmonary vein isolation in paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
    J Interv Card Electrophysiol · 2026-10-10
    首个人体研究显示，新型共形脉冲场消融球囊行肺静脉隔离急性成功率100%，3个月静脉水平持久隔离率93.1%，1年无房性心律失常复发率90.7%。
  • Cardiometabolic health-frailty phenotypes and bidirectional transitions between atrial fibrillation and heart failure: multistate trajectories and proteomic signatures.
    J Nutr Health Aging · 2026-10-10
    在UK Biobank 31.9万无AF/HF人群中，心血管代谢不健康合并衰弱（CMU-F）表型与AF、HF及AF-HF共病风险最高相关，FABP4是最一致的初步蛋白信号。
  • C-Reactive Protein as a Predictor of Cardiovascular Events and Mortality in Obstructive Sleep Apnea: A Propensity-Matched Analysis Using the TriNetX Research Network.
    Sleep Sci · 2026-10-10
    在阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停患者中，CRP≥3.0 mg/L与全因死亡及心血管事件风险显著增加相关，提示炎症标志物有助于风险分层。
  • Fibrosis burden and spatial pattern affect left atrial appendage stasis in multi-beat multi-physics simulations.
    bioRxiv · 2026-10-10
    在共同左心房解剖的多搏动多物理场模拟中，纤维化负荷主要决定整体左心房血流动力学，而左心耳淤滞还取决于纤维化的空间分布。
  • Reliability and accuracy of medication-based performance measures for assessment of outpatient cardiology clinicians.
    medRxiv · 2026-10-10
    在VA门诊心内科10项药物绩效指标中，多数可靠性足以用于医生横向比较，但以同行评议为金标准时准确度仅0.51-0.73，且系统性低估绩效，不宜单独用于医生质量评价。

室性心律失常（7）

  • Clinical case: Myocarditis in an adolescent with post-COVID syndrome
    CHILDREN INFECTIONS · 2026-10-11
    一例15岁青少年在接触COVID-19患者10个月后出现严重乏力、体重下降、心动过缓及心电图改变，心脏MRI证实亚急性心肌炎伴心肌水肿、坏死和纤维化，提示后COVID综合征可表现为迟发性心肌炎。
  • Electrical Alternans With Alternating Left Ventricular Apical Ballooning Mimicking Takotsubo Cardiomyopathy in a Patient With Extreme QT Prolongation.
    J Cardiovasc Electrophysiol · 2026-10-11
    5岁先天性长QT综合征3型患儿在心房起搏下出现电交替与机械交替，表现为交替性左室心尖球囊样扩张，美西律可消除交替并恢复左室功能。
  • Ventricular arrhythmias in pregnant women with and without structural heart disease: are there differences in outcomes?
    Translational Medicine · 2026-10-11
    妊娠期室性心律失常在结构性心脏病患者中与不良结局相关，无结构性心脏病者高负荷也可能增加产科和胎儿并发症风险，但现有风险模型未纳入室性早搏负荷。
  • Cardiac segmentation for ventricular tachycardia radioablation and radiotherapy patients with cardiac implants.
    ArXiv · 2026-10-10
    在ICD患者中，补充ICD图像训练的深度学习模型可改善心脏亚结构分割，并支持VT-SBRT的剂量分析。
  • Rising Obesity-Driven Cardiac Mortality Among Young Adults in the United States: A 25-Year Retrospective Analysis (1999-2023).
    J Am Heart Assoc · 2026-10-10
    1999至2023年美国15-44岁人群肥胖相关心脏死亡率从0.9升至2.5/10万，男性、黑人、美洲原住民及南部农村地区差异显著。
  • Global longitudinal strain assessment of systolic dysfunction in Doberman Pinschers with ventricular arrhythmias and normal echocardiographic measurements.
    J Vet Intern Med · 2026-10-10
    在超声常规指标正常的杜宾犬室性心律失常B1期，整体纵向应变已显著降低，且心律失常负荷越高应变越差。
  • Twenty years in the battle against sudden cardiac death: progress, pitfalls, and prospects for the future.
    Resusc Plus · 2026-10-10
    美国Sudden Cardiac Arrest Foundation成立20年，通过公众教育、Call-Push-Shock运动和幸存者联盟等举措，推动心脏骤停生存链的进步，但摘要未报告具体临床结局数据。

器械治疗（10）

  • Intraoperative Application of the PRAETORIAN Score to Predict Optimal Subcutaneous Implantable Cardioverter-Defibrillator Placement
    J Arrhythm · 2026-10-11
    在124例接受S-ICD植入的日本患者中，术中仰卧位PRAETORIAN评分与常规站立位评分高度一致，仅2例发生临床风险类别重分类，BMI升高与评分不一致相关。
  • Successful Bailout Retrieval of an Active-Fixation Atrial Leadless Pacemaker Following Suspected Tissue Entrapment During Repositioning
    J Arrhythm · 2026-10-11
    81岁女性AVEIR DR植入中，AR心房无导线起搏器重新定位时疑似心肌嵌顿并螺旋拉伸，推进保护鞘完全包裹器件后成功安全回收。
  • Cardiac resynchronization therapy outcomes by sex and QRS duration: insights from AdaptResponse and a Real-world registry.
    J Card Fail · 2026-10-11
    在QRS 120-149ms的心衰患者中，CRT与无CRT相比，男性和女性5年全因死亡率分别相对降低49%和50%，且女性短QRS的死亡率与男性长QRS相似。
  • Procedural Outcomes of Leadless Pacemaker Extraction and Retrieval: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis With Descriptive Synthesis of Post-Implant Management.
    J Cardiovasc Electrophysiol · 2026-10-11
    无导线起搏器取出/回收的汇总成功率为89.1%，主要回收相关事件发生率3.8%，证据确定性极低。
  • Development and Clinical Evaluation of a Vascular Access-Optimized Perioperative Care Pathway for Temporary Pacemaker Implantation.
    Rev Cardiovasc Med · 2026-10-11
    经肘正中静脉行临时起搏器植入并配合标准化围术期护理路径，较股静脉途径电极脱位与并发症更少、患者舒适度与情绪状态更佳。
  • How do healthcare providers manage perioperative care for patients with pacemakers, as described in qualitative studies?
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-10-11
    该摘要为综述性概述，未报告具体研究数据，仅强调起搏器患者围术期管理需周密计划、持续监测与多学科沟通以保障器械安全与功能。
  • Rapid Radiological Disappearance of Pancreatic Duct Stones Following Oral Trimethadione.
    ACG Case Rep J · 2026-10-10
    一例合并ICD的慢性胰腺炎患者，因解剖改变无法常规干预，口服三甲双酮2周后胰管结石迅速消失，提示其可能成为器械植入患者胰管结石的挽救性治疗选择。
  • Breast cancer metastasis mimicking pacemaker pocket infection: a diagnostic pitfall and long-term preservation of the cardiac implantable electronic device-a case report.
    Eur Heart J Case Rep · 2026-10-10
    81岁女性起搏器囊袋反复红肿疼痛、培养阴性，最终证实为乳腺癌转移而非囊袋感染，完整切除肿瘤并保留起搏系统，长期随访装置功能正常。
  • Appropriate ICD Therapies in Primary Prevention: A Propensity-Matched Comparison of Contemporary and Historic Heart Failure Cohorts.
    J Arrhythm · 2026-10-10
    在HFrEF一级预防ICD患者中，当代ARNI/SGLT2i时代与历史队列的恰当ICD治疗发生率无显著差异（HR 1.52，95%CI 0.84-2.72，P=0.165）。
  • Simultaneous Cardiopulmonary Exercise Testing and Cardiac Magnetic Resonance Imaging in Patients with Conduction System Pacemakers.
    J Cardiovasc Magn Reson · 2026-10-10

遗传与基础（3）

  • Metabolic stress exacerbates Ca2+ dysregulation and arrhythmias in catecholaminergic polymorphic ventricular tachycardia.
    Exp Physiol · 2026-10-11
    在CASQ2-/-小鼠CPVT模型中，引入Akita糖尿病代谢应激可加重心肌细胞钙处理异常和心律失常，并导致舒张功能障碍和心肌肥厚，但不伴纤维化或细胞死亡。
  • Congenital Long QT Syndrome: From Conventional Management to Emerging Biological Therapies.
    Rev Cardiovasc Med · 2026-10-11
    本综述系统梳理先天性长QT综合征的传统治疗与新兴分子疗法，强调基因编辑、RNA干扰等机制导向策略的临床转化前景。
  • Mechanisms and Advances in the Treatment of Arrhythmias Associated With Pulmonary Hypertension.
    Rev Cardiovasc Med · 2026-10-11
    本综述系统梳理了肺动脉高压相关心律失常的电重构、结构重构、代谢紊乱与炎症机制，指出房颤/房扑最常见，治疗涵盖靶向药物、抗心律失常药、导管消融及Cx43调节剂、基因治疗等新兴手段。

item.title: 2026-10-10 心脏电生理日报（31 篇）
item.description:
共 31 篇。在日报页面阅读完整解读 →

房颤与消融（13）

  • Clinical Impact of Interlesion Distance on Acute Pulmonary Vein Isolation Success in Patients With Paroxysmal Atrial Fibrillation
    Circ Rep · 2026-10-10
  • Body Mass Index Variability and Cardiovascular Risk: Contemporary Evidence and Clinical Implications for Diabetes Care
    Curr Diab Rep · 2026-10-10
    BMI变异性与全因死亡、动脉粥样硬化性心血管疾病、心衰和房颤风险增加独立相关，糖尿病可能放大此风险，但尚缺乏可操作阈值。
  • Monopolar biphasic pulsed field ablation and coronary endothelial function: the Vasc-PFA study.
    Eur Heart J · 2026-10-10
  • Arrhythmia and dementia: time to think beyond atrial fibrillation.
    Eur Heart J · 2026-10-10
  • Ventricular Tachycardia Ablation in Late-Onset Phenotype Fabry Disease: A Case Report
    European Heart Journal - Case Reports · 2026-10-10
    71岁晚发型Fabry病伴LVAD患者，经心内超声引导下经房间隔左室途径行VT消融，靶向基底至中段下侧壁晚电位，术后起搏器未再记录到VT。
  • Left Bundle Branch Area Pacing Improves Atrial Function and Reverses Atrial Remodeling in Dyssynchrony Heart Failure Model
    J Am Heart Assoc · 2026-10-10
    在快速起搏诱导的犬失同步心衰模型中，左束支区域起搏（LBBP）可显著逆转心房功能、细胞和分子重构，效果优于左室间隔起搏（LVSP），或可解释LBBP后新发房颤减少。
  • Left Atrial Enlargement Identifies Risk of Stroke Independent of Atrial Fibrillation
    J Am Heart Assoc · 2026-10-10
    在无房颤人群中，左房扩大与卒中风险独立相关（HR 1.49），且不依赖于新发房颤，提示左房扩大可作为血栓栓塞风险的标志。
  • First-in-human experience and one-year outcomes using a novel conformal pulsed-field ablation balloon catheter for pulmonary vein isolation in paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
    J Interv Card Electrophysiol · 2026-10-10
    新型共形脉冲场消融球囊导管在阵发性房颤患者中实现100%急性肺静脉隔离，1年无房性心律失常复发率90.7%，安全性良好。
  • Cardiometabolic health-frailty phenotypes and bidirectional transitions between atrial fibrillation and heart failure: multistate trajectories and proteomic signatures
    J Nutr Health Aging · 2026-10-10
    在UK Biobank无AF/HF人群中，心血管代谢不健康合并衰弱（CMU-F）表型与AF、HF及AF-HF共病风险最高相关，FABP4是初步蛋白信号。
  • Cardiometabolic Substrate Modification in Atrial Fibrillation: Obesity and Epicardial Adipose Tissue in the Era of Incretin-Based Therapies and Catheter Ablation
    Journal of Cardiovascular Development and Disease · 2026-10-10
    房颤是系统性心脏代谢疾病的心房表现，减重、运动及GLP-1受体激动剂等代谢干预可改善心律控制，但减少消融后复发的证据仍以非随机研究为主。
  • Left Atrial Appendage Occlusion vs Oral Anticoagulation for Stroke Prevention in Atrial Fibrillation: A Meta-Analysis.
    Pacing Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-10
    在房颤患者中，左心耳封堵（LAAO）与口服抗凝（OAC）相比，非手术相关出血风险显著更低，但主要不良心血管事件（MACE）和卒中风险无统计学差异。
  • Atrial Fibrillation and Aging: The Role of MicroRNA Networks Across Cellular, Structural, and Electrophysiological Remodeling
    Preprints.org · 2026-10-10
    衰老通过miRNA网络调控心房细胞、结构和电生理重构，促进房颤发生，但现有证据存在机制与关联、实验与临床间的缺失环节。
  • The prognostic value of interleukin-6 in the assessment of arrhythmia recurrence in patients with hypertension and paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
    Terapevticheskii arkhiv · 2026-10-10
    在高血压合并阵发性房颤患者中，血浆IL-6>4.0 pg/ml可预测6个月内房颤复发，敏感性70%、特异性72%，AUC 0.76，复发风险增加1.42倍。

室性心律失常（6）

  • Transient Type 1 Brugada ECG Pattern in a Patient With Severe Coronary Artery Disease
    Cureus · 2026-10-10
    一例49岁严重多支冠脉病变患者在心绞痛发作期间出现1型Brugada心电图模式，血运重建后该模式完全消失，提示心肌缺血可诱发可逆性Brugada表型。
  • Supplemental Material for: Clinical Outcomes of Anomalous Aortic Origin of Right Coronary Artery from the Left Coronary Sinus
    Figshare · 2026-10-10
    在10134例接受CCTA的患者中，偶发发现的右冠状动脉异常起源于左冠状窦（AAORCA）未显示心脏死亡风险显著高于正常或CAD人群，但事件数少需谨慎解读。
  • Rising Obesity-Driven Cardiac Mortality Among Young Adults in the United States: A 25-Year Retrospective Analysis (1999-2023)
    J Am Heart Assoc · 2026-10-10
    1999-2023年美国15-44岁人群肥胖相关心脏死亡率从0.9升至2.5/10万，男性、黑人、美洲原住民及南部非都市区差异显著。
  • Stellate ganglion block for ventricular arrhythmia disease states: Emerging treatment options
    J Anesth Transl Med · 2026-10-10
    星状神经节阻滞可短期减少难治性室性心律失常负荷并终止电风暴，但证据限于病例系列和观察性研究。
  • Management and Prognosis of Sustained Ventricular Tachycardia in the Emergency Department: A Retrospective, Observational, Single-Centre Study
    Journal of Clinical Medicine · 2026-10-10
    急诊持续性室速虽仅占就诊量0.025%，但90%合并结构性心脏病，1年死亡率达17%，LVEF≤30%及院内复发独立预测死亡。
  • Reflex Supraventricular Tachycardia and Chest Pain Following the First Dose of Fixed-Dose Perindopril/Amlodipine in an Older Patient with Hypertension and Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus: A Case Report
    Journal of Disease and Global Health · 2026-10-10
    一例70岁高血压合并2型糖尿病男性首次服用培哚普利/氨氯地平固定复方制剂1小时后出现反射性室上性心动过速伴胸痛，腺苷终止后症状缓解，因果关系评定为很可能。

器械治疗（7）

  • Left ventricular ejection fraction recovery under contemporary quadruple guideline-directed therapy and the need for ICD/CRT-D implantation in HFrEF: a retrospective single-center cohort study.
    Expert Rev Cardiovasc Ther · 2026-10-10
    在当代四联GDMT下，HFrEF患者约3个月LVEF显著恢复，44.6%仍植入ICD/CRT-D，基线左室舒张末径较大与恢复较差及器械植入相关。
  • Dataset - Hsieh et al. - Disentangling the Connection between Recent Trends in Tropical Cloud Contraction, SST Warming Patterns, and Atmospheric Circulation
    Figshare · 2026-10-10
    该数据集并非心脏电生理研究，而是气候模拟数据，无法提供器械治疗相关的临床解读。
  • Dramatic T-wave Inversions
    Indian Journal of Clinical Cardiology · 2026-10-10
    65岁扩张型心肌病伴左束支传导阻滞患者行左束支优化心脏再同步治疗后，心电图出现显著T波倒置，提示心室激动顺序纠正。
  • Lose the Hardware: The Rise of Leadless Modular Cardiac Pacing
    Journal of Clinical Medicine · 2026-10-10
    无导线起搏已从单腔心室系统发展为房室同步、独立心房起搏及全无导线双腔平台，模块化无导线起搏概念可先植入独立装置、按需序贯追加，并与S-ICD及无导线CRT整合，迈向全无导线心律管理生态。
  • MicraAV Versus Dual-Chamber Transvenous Pacemakers in Patients with Atrioventricular Block Following Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement: A 12-Month Single-Center Retrospective Study
    Journal of Clinical Medicine · 2026-10-10
    TAVR后房室传导阻滞患者中，MicraAV与双腔静脉起搏器12个月全因死亡和器械并发症均较低，但MicraAV组心衰再住院有增多趋势（17.2% vs 4.4%），需大样本验证。
  • CARDIAC RESYNCHRONIZATION THERAPY IN PATIENTS WITHOUT TYPICAL LEFT BUNDLE BRANCH BLOCK: A SYSTEMATIC REVIEW OF PATIENT SELECTION STRATEGIES AND EMERGING CONDUCTION SYSTEM PACING ALTERNATIVE
    World Journal of Biology Pharmacy and Health Sciences · 2026-10-10
    非LBBB心衰患者不应一概排除CRT，向量心电QRS面积优于传统指标，LBBAP较BiVP改善更佳但证据多为观察性。
  • FORCED INTRAOPERATIVE MODIFICATION OF PERMANENT CARDIAC PACING TACTICS THROUGH PERSISTENT LEFT SUPERIOR VENA CAVATA IN A HIGH-RISK PATIENT FOR CARDIAC SURGERY: A CASE REPORT
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-10-10
    在标准静脉入路不可行且存在永存左上腔静脉的高危心脏术后患者中，放弃心室导线、采用AAIR单腔心房起搏是安全可行的替代策略。

遗传与基础（3）

  • The genetic landscape of myotonic dystrophy type 1: insights from nearly one million genomes.
    Brain · 2026-10-10
    基于近百万全基因组测序数据，DMPK致病性重复扩增的患病率约为1/1527，是既往估计的2-5倍，且与心脏传导异常和早发性白内障显著相关，多数携带者未被临床诊断。
  • sddb-warning-time-tests: power and within-patient tests of HRV-based sudden cardiac death prediction on the MIT-BIH SDDB benchmark
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-10-10
    该研究通过可复现代码对MIT-BIH SDDB等数据库进行HRV特征分析，发现跨数据库时间窗测试无法证实基于HRV的猝死预测具有真实预警时间。
  • Cardiac phenotype in children with X-linked ichthyosis (STS-sEDD): findings from a prospective cohort.
    Eur J Pediatr · 2026-10-09
    14例STS-sEDD男童中，多模态心脏评估未发现临床显著心律失常，心脏结构基本正常，缺失范围与心脏表现无关。

其他（2）

  • A penalized, synergistic deep learning architecture leveraging DBN and GAN for classifying highly asymmetric medical data: A multi-domain validation
    Array · 2026-10-10
    一种结合DBN和GAN的惩罚性协同深度学习架构，在高度不平衡的ECG数据分类中达到99.47%准确率和0.9905的MCC，并在多领域数据上展现强泛化能力。
  • Motion Artifacts Quantification in Ambulatory Holter ECG Across Age Groups: Insights from Simultaneous 3-Axis Accelerometry
    Journal of Experimental and Theoretical Analyses · 2026-10-10
    老年男性动态心电图的运动伪差率最高（1.9%），且LF/HF比值显著低于年轻男性，提示年龄和性别影响运动伪差负担及HRV分析可靠性。

item.title: 2026-10-09 心脏电生理日报（55 篇）
item.description:
共 55 篇。在日报页面阅读完整解读 →

房颤与消融（27）
