  • Cost-Effectiveness of Annual Atrial Fibrillation Screening Compared with Current Opportunistic Screening in Australian Primary Care: A Model-Based Economic Evaluation.
    Appl Health Econ Health Policy · 2026-10-09
    在澳大利亚≥65岁人群中，每年结构化12导联心电图房颤筛查相比当前机会性筛查，每获得1个QALY需多花9797澳元，低于28000澳元/QALY的阈值，具成本效益。
  • Oral Obesity Medicines in the Era of Cardiovascular-Kidney-Metabolic Syndrome (CKM): Beyond Weight Loss Toward Disease Modification
    Drug Des Devel Ther · 2026-10-09
    口服减重药物在CKM综合征框架下从单纯减重转向疾病修饰，口服司美格鲁肽心血管获益证据最强，orforglipron的心血管肾脏结局数据尚待公布。
  • Pulsed Field Ablation With the Volt System for Recurrent Atypical Atrial Flutter in a Patient With Extensive Prior Ablation: A Case Report
    European Heart Journal - Case Reports · 2026-10-09
    一例多次射频消融后复发非典型房扑患者，使用Volt球囊篮式脉冲场消融系统成功终止房扑，3个月随访维持窦性心律。
  • Physical activity, atrial fibrillation and the dose-response relationship: a systematic review and meta-analysis
    European Journal of Preventive Cardiology · 2026-10-09
    体力活动与房颤风险呈U型关系，每周26 MET-hr时风险最低，超过78 MET-hr（约每周6-7小时耐力训练）风险反而增加。
  • Supplemental Material for: Left Atrial Appendage Closure or Medical Therapy in Atrial Fibrillation: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
    Figshare · 2026-10-09
    在房颤患者中，左心耳封堵相比药物治疗在全因死亡和大出血上达到非劣效，但复合终点、心血管死亡、系统性栓塞和所有卒中未达非劣效。
  • ERRATUM: Beyond the classical triangle: morphological variations of the Triangle of Koch in human hearts and their clinical implications.
    Folia Morphol (Warsz) · 2026-10-09
    30例固定人心标本中Koch三角形态变异显著，形状、Todaro腱突出度及冠状窦口位置不一，与房室结消融及起搏导线植入安全性相关。
  • Quality of life after cryoballoon vs. radiofrequency ablation in atrial fibrillation: a subanalysis of the FREEZE cohort study
    Frontiers in Cardiovascular Medicine · 2026-10-09
    在FREEZE队列中，CBA与RFA均显著改善症状性AF患者HRQoL，但CBA与疼痛/不适、EQ-VAS及EuroQol 5D评分的更大改善独立相关。
  • Epicardial adipose tissue in obesity-related heart failure with preserved ejection fraction and atrial fibrillation: mechanisms, imaging, and therapeutic modulation
    Frontiers in Endocrinology · 2026-10-09
    心外膜脂肪组织是肥胖相关HFpEF与AF交互中的可测量表型，局部实验证据在AF中强于HFpEF，但改变EAT本身能否带来临床获益尚需纵向研究。
  • Present state and future of screening for atrial fibrillation: a state-of-the-art review
    Heart · 2026-10-09
  • Substrate Comprising Fibrosis and Epicardial Adipose Tissue-Associated Electrophysiological Remodeling Can Sustain Atrial Fibrillation Drivers: Insights from Image-Personalized Computational Simulations.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-09
    在持续性房颤患者中，将心外膜脂肪组织（EAT）效应加入基于纤维化的左房计算模型可增加功能性折返的可诱发性，且折返优先锚定于纤维化与EAT重叠区域。
  • Conduction System Recovery After Pulsed Field Ablation of a Para-Hisian PVC.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-09
  • Nuclear magnetic resonance-derived lipoprotein profile and risk of atrial tachyarrhythmia recurrence after catheter ablation: a case-cohort design within the PREDIMAR trial.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-09
    在PREDIMAR试验嵌套的病例队列研究中，基线残粒胆固醇升高与导管消融后房性快速性心律失常复发风险增加相关（HR 1.26/SD）。
  • Dynamics of P wave Morphological Variability Preceding the Onset of Atrial Fibrillation.
    IEEE Trans Biomed Eng · 2026-10-09
    在32例患者176次房颤发作前60分钟内，63%的片段出现P波形态变异性（PMV）升高，变化点位于房颤发作前4-17分钟，聚类分析提示房颤前存在异位灶活动、传导不稳定或无表现三种模式。
  • Computer-Aided-Diagnosis of Cardiac Arrhythmia Using a Three-Channel Convolutional Neural Network
    IntechOpen eBooks · 2026-10-09
    三通道CNN模型在MIT-BIH AFDB和CinC 2017数据库上分类房颤、房扑等心律，F1分数最高达99.64%，显示高准确性和鲁棒性。
  • Right Atrium-Dominant Single-Loop Biatrial Tachycardia Mimicking Reverse Typical Atrial Flutter After Mitral Valve Repair via a Superior Transseptal Approach.
    J Arrhythm · 2026-10-09
    二尖瓣修复术后经上房间隔入路患者可出现右房主导的单环双房心动过速，模拟逆向典型房扑，左房参与有限。
  • Sleep-Disordered Breathing and Sleep Fragmentation in Relation to Atrial Fibrillation Risk: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
    J Arrhythm · 2026-10-09
    睡眠呼吸障碍使新发房颤风险增加67%、复发风险增加55%，且AHI每升高1单位房颤风险增加2%，提示睡眠障碍是可干预的房颤危险因素。
  • Renal Sympathetic Denervation Plus Pulmonary Vein Isolation for Atrial Fibrillation in Patients with Hypertension: A Meta-Analysis of Randomised Controlled Trials.
    J Coll Physicians Surg Pak · 2026-10-09
    在合并高血压的房颤患者中，PVI联合RSDN较单纯PVI显著降低12个月房颤复发率（RR 0.58）及收缩压、舒张压，但24个月复发无差异。
  • Short-term vericiguat after catheter ablation for atrial fibrillation: a prospective patient preference–based clinical study
    Journal of Cardiothoracic Surgery · 2026-10-09
    在房颤消融术后患者中，短期口服维利西呱与12个月时晚期房性快速性心律失常复发率降低相关，但空白期及6个月时无显著差异，样本量小且非随机，结论需谨慎。
  • Atrial Remodeling and Arrhythmia in Scimitar Syndrome: A Literature Review
    Journal of Cardiovascular Development and Disease · 2026-10-09
    弯刀综合征因右肺静脉异常引流至下腔静脉导致右心容量负荷过重，进而引起右房扩大与心房重构，显著增加房颤和房扑等房性及室上性心律失常风险。
  • Mortality involving non-rheumatic valvular heart disease and atrial fibrillation in the United States: Long-term trends and implications.
    Medicine (Baltimore) · 2026-10-09
    1999至2023年美国AF合并NRVHD相关死亡从2.98/10万升至7.30/10万，AAPC 4.17，男性、老年人、农村及西部人群负担更重。
  • Impact of atrial fibrillation catheter ablation o'n tricuspid regurgitation severity: a systematic review and meta-analysis
    Open Heart · 2026-10-09
  • Left Atrial Appendage Occlusion vs Oral Anticoagulation for Stroke Prevention in Atrial Fibrillation: A Meta-Analysis
    Pacing Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-09
    在AF患者中，LAAO与OAC相比不增加MACE或卒中风险，但显著降低非手术相关出血（RR 0.63），疗效证据仍不确定。
  • Prediction of cardiovascular outcomes using electrocardiography from overnight polysomnography.
    Sleep · 2026-10-09
    基于夜间多导睡眠图单导联心电图的深度学习模型可预测房颤、心衰和死亡等长期心血管风险，外部验证中每标准差输出值增加对应风险比显著升高。
  • An Explainable Machine Learning Model Integrating Clinical Parameters for Identifying Left Atrial Appendage Thrombus in Non-valvular Atrial Fibrillation.
    Ultrasound Med Biol · 2026-10-09
    在325例非瓣膜性房颤患者中，逻辑回归模型整合临床与超声特征预测左心耳血栓，测试集AUC达0.913，SHAP分析提示左心耳血流速度、房颤类型等为关键预测因子。
  • Available datapackage for study 'Non-interventional Study Describing Patients' Perception on Anticoagulant Treatment and Treatment Convenience When Treated With Pradaxa or Vitamin K Antagonist for Stroke Prophylaxis in Atrial Fibrillation'
    Vivli · 2026-10-09
    该非干预性研究拟比较房颤患者服用达比加群（Pradaxa）与维生素K拮抗剂抗凝时对治疗便利性的主观感受，但摘要未报告样本量、终点及任何结果数据。
  • What are the considerations for managing medications in an elderly patient with atrial fibrillation and myasthenia gravis, currently on azathioprine and previously on prednisolone?
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-10-09
    摘要仅为一般性管理原则陈述，未报告具体研究对象、样本量或统计结果，无法得出可引用的临床结论。
  • WITHDRAWN: How to Detect the Early Cardiac Functional Change and Predict Heart Failure in Paroxysmal Atrial Fibrillation? A Prospective Cohort Study
    medRxiv · 2026-10-09
    该论文已被作者撤稿，无可解读的研究结论，撤稿原因为重新分析后入组人数、随访数据与终点事件数均与原分析不一致。

室性心律失常（6）

  • From Sudden Cardiac Death Prevention to Performance Optimization: A Conceptual Framework for Cardiovascular Assessment in Elite Athletes.
    Anatol J Cardiol · 2026-10-09
    本文提出一个整合结构、电生理与功能评估的精英运动员心血管评估概念框架，属假说性、未经前瞻验证，强调CPET与一次性CCTA为选择性补充而非普筛。
  • Artificial Intelligence-Enhanced Electrocardiography for the Detection of Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy in Athletes: A Systematic Review of Diagnostic Accuracy and External Validity
    Cureus · 2026-10-09
    本系统综述提示，AI-ECG 用于运动员 HCM 筛查的诊断准确性证据有限，外部有效性尚待验证。
  • Post-induction residual time: a novel sensing phenomenon during induced ventricular fibrillation in subcutaneous ICD recipients.
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-10-09
    在S-ICD患者中，诱发性室颤的感知与治疗时间较自发性室性心律失常事件更长，且诱发性事件存在可测量的诱导后残余时间（PRT），提示50Hz诱导技术可能无法完全模拟自发性心律失常。
  • Clinical Characteristics and Transplacental Treatment of Fetal Ventricular Tachycardia: A Nationwide Survey in Japan.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-09
    日本全国调查24例胎儿室速，LQTS相关者多在33周前发病且经胎盘治疗有效率高，但出生后更易耐药并伴神经发育延迟。
  • Identifying the High-Risk Arrhythmic Mitral Valve Prolapse Phenotype by Imaging
    JACC Cardiovasc Imaging · 2026-10-09
    综述指出，致心律失常性二尖瓣脱垂（AMVP）中的恶性表型多见于年轻女性，需结合超声、心脏磁共振及节律监测识别高危特征以进行风险分层。
  • Multimodality Imaging-Guided Ventricular Tachycardia Ablation in a Hypoplastic Right Ventricle After Glenn Palliation.
    JACC Case Rep · 2026-10-09
    一例右心室发育不良且既往行双向Glenn术的成人患者，经多模态影像与高密度标测指导，以基质均质化消融成功治疗持续性单形性室速，术后晚电位消失并植入皮下ICD。

器械治疗（7）

  • Rapid Radiological Disappearance of Pancreatic Duct Stones Following Oral Trimethadione
    ACG Case Rep J · 2026-10-09
    一例合并ICD的慢性胰腺炎患者，口服三甲双酮2周后胰管结石影像学迅速消失，提示其或为无法行常规干预时的挽救选择。
  • Do pacemakers prolong the dying process in a palliative setting?-a retrospective matched cohort analysis.
    Ann Palliat Med · 2026-10-09
    回顾性匹配队列显示，终末期姑息治疗患者中，未停用起搏器并未延长死亡过程，部分患者甚至比匹配对照更早死亡。
  • Eighteen Years of Complication-Free Survival Following Inadvertent Left Ventricular Implantable Cardioverter Defibrillator (ICD) Lead Placement via Atrial Septal Defect: A Case Report
    Cureus · 2026-10-09
    一例经房间隔缺损误入左心室的ICD导线患者，采用抗凝观察策略后18年无并发症生存。
  • Outcomes of leadless pacing with the Micra VR beyond 10 years.
    Europace · 2026-10-09
  • Prognostic value of the inflammatory burden index in predicting 1-year mortality in patients undergoing cardiac resynchronization therapy for heart failure
    Frontiers in Cardiovascular Medicine · 2026-10-09
    在525例接受CRT的心衰患者中，炎症负荷指数（IBI）和CRP均为1年死亡的独立预测因子，且较基线临床模型显著提升风险分层能力，但IBI与CRP预测效能相当。
  • Left bundle branch area pacing in dual-chamber pacemaker implantation: Procedural feasibility and electrical outcomes – Case series
    Heart India · 2026-10-09
    单中心7例双腔起搏器植入中行左束支区域起搏，6例（85.7%）成功，QRS明显变窄且起搏参数稳定，无急性并发症。
  • Axillary microaxial flow pump support for stepwise source control and bridge to durable left ventricular assist device therapy in cardiac device-related infective endocarditis.
    J Artif Organs · 2026-10-09
    53岁扩张型心肌病合并CRT-D感染及混合性脓毒症-心源性休克患者，经腋动脉Impella 5.5支持完成分阶段感染源控制与高危导线拔除，最终成功桥接至持久性LVAD。

心力衰竭与代谢（1）

  • Differences in Tricuspid Valve Insufficiency, Mechanical Synchrony, and Cardiac Remodeling Between Left Bundle Branch Area Pacing and Right Ventricular Pacing.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-09
    在基线心衰负担更重的情况下，左束支区域起搏（LBBAP）2年内三尖瓣反流进展率仍低于右室心尖部或间隔部起搏（20.0% vs 43.3%/35.9%），且导线相关三尖瓣反流预后劣于功能性反流。

影像与标测（2）

  • Utility of an automatic and patient-triggered cardiac event recorder: experience in children.
    BMC Pediatr · 2026-10-09
    在81例有疑似心律失常症状的儿童中，自动+手动事件记录仪诊断心律失常的阳性率（63%）显著高于24小时动态心电图（16.7%），且自动模式在无症状患儿中额外检出56%的心律失常。
  • Artificial Intelligence in Cardiac Electrophysiology Ethics, Explainability, Equity, and the Road Ahead.
    Indian Pacing Electrophysiol J · 2026-10-09
    该综述指出，AI 在心脏电生理领域的应用面临模型可解释性不足、训练数据代表性欠缺和全球公平可及性受限等伦理与监管挑战，需通过严格验证、持续监测和临床医生监督实现负责任落地。

遗传与基础（10）

  • Trends in Preventing Sudden Cardiac Death in Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy
    Cardiogenetics · 2026-10-09
    肥厚型心肌病心律失常事件从致命为主转向可预防为主，主要归因于ICD植入普及而非时间推移或院外复苏改善，但植入范围扩大且每预防一例事件所需器械数增加。
  • Towards a suitable biomarker for childhood screening for familial hypercholesterolemia: a systematic literature review
    Clin Chem Lab Med · 2026-10-09
    本系统综述纳入35项研究，发现FH儿童LDL-c、TC、ApoB等生物标志物持续升高，但仅3项筛查研究同时结合生物标志物与基因检测，敏感性和特异性有限，尚缺乏可用于儿童普筛的可靠标志物。
  • Cardiac phenotype in children with X-linked ichthyosis (STS-sEDD): findings from a prospective cohort
    Eur J Pediatr · 2026-10-09
    在14例X连锁鱼鳞病男孩中，多模态心脏评估未发现临床显著心律失常，心脏结构正常，提示临床相关心脏受累不常见。
  • Case Report: Duchenne muscular dystrophy-associated cardiomyopathy presenting as adolescent nonischemic heart failure-from red-flag clues to genetic confirmation and multisystem management.
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-10-09
    一例17岁男性以非缺血性心力衰竭起病，经神经肌肉线索、影像与基因检测确诊DMD相关心肌病，规范心衰治疗后LVEF从44%恢复至55%。
  • Atypical echocardiographic phenotype of end-stage hypertrophic cardiomyopathy: a case series
    Frontiers in Cardiovascular Medicine · 2026-10-09
    三例缺乏典型非对称性肥厚的终末期HCM，经多模态影像与基因检测确诊，分别携带MYBPC3或MYH7致病突变，优化药物治疗后病情稳定。
  • Beyond the light-driven pacemaker: the suprachiasmatic nucleus as a dynamic coordinator of environmental cues
    Frontiers in Neuroscience · 2026-10-09
    综述提出视交叉上核是整合光、代谢、星形胶质细胞与温度线索的异质性可塑性网络，而非仅被动接受光授时，并据此构建整合环路模型解释时差与代谢病中的节律紊乱。
  • AXIN1 Gene Polymorphism in Fatal Cardiomyopathy Cases: A Cross-Sectional Autopsy Study in Myanmar
    International Journal of Genetics and Genomics · 2026-10-09
    在缅甸50例尸检确诊的致命性心肌病中，AXIN1 rs1805105以CT基因型为主（50%），但基因型与心肌病类型无显著关联（p=0.124）。
  • Ventricular Fibrillation in PRKAG2 Cardiomyopathy: A Genetic Arrhythmia Substrate Beyond Wolff-Parkinson-White.
    JACC Case Rep · 2026-10-09
    25岁女性PRKAG2综合征患者发生院外心脏骤停，电生理检查排除WPW综合征而发现束室旁路，植入ICD进行二级预防。
  • Pathogenic Variants in NKX2-5 Associated With Familial Atrial Septal Defect and Conduction System Disease
    JACC Case Rep · 2026-10-09
    一个三代家系中，新型NKX2-5致病性变异（c.300del; p.Asp101Thrfs*75）与常染色体显性遗传的房间隔缺损及传导系统疾病共分离，提示对合并传导异常的房间隔缺损患者应进行家系调查和基因检测。
  • Generation of a human induced pluripotent stem cell line (ZZUNEUi040-A) from a male patient with hypertrophic cardiomyopathy carrying a heterozygous TPM1 (c.644C > T) mutation.
    Stem Cell Res · 2026-10-09
    从携带TPM1 c.644C>T杂合突变的10岁男性非梗阻性不对称性HCM患者外周血单核细胞成功建立人iPSC系ZZUNEUi040-A，核型正常且具三胚层分化潜能。

其他（2）

  • Multi-class electrocardiogram signal classification using deep learning and two-dimensional time-frequency codification
    2026-10-09
    基于双ResNet-18架构和时频编码的深度学习模型在MIT-BIH数据库上实现四类心律失常分类，总体准确率97.39%，Macro-F1为0.954。
  • A Rounding Error Dressed as Reform: The Implications of a Large Private Health Insurance Company's Prior Authorization Concession for the Electrophysiology Patient.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-09

item.title: 2026-10-08 心脏电生理日报（63 篇）
item.description:
共 63 篇。在日报页面阅读完整解读 →

房颤与消融（36）

  • Pulmonary Vein Stenosis and Atrial Fibrillation Recurrence: A Comparison of Clinical Outcomes of Radiofrequency Ablation versus Cryoablation
    2026-10-08
  • TyG-BRI, frailty, and all-cause mortality in older adults with atrial fibrillation without diabetes: a two-cohort study
    BMC Geriatrics · 2026-10-08
    在无糖尿病的老年房颤患者中，TyG-BRI与衰弱状态均与全因死亡相关，联合评估可识别不同死亡风险亚组。
  • A Fast and Generalizable Deep Neural Network for the Detection of Atrial Fibrillation
    Bioengineering · 2026-10-08
    一个14M参数的CNN仅用HDXML数据集训练，在六个外部队列（超125万份心电图）中检测房颤的ROC-AUC均超过0.95，且无需GPU推理仅需110毫秒。
  • CO-50 | LEFT ATRIAL APPENDAGE OCCLUSION IN PATIENTS WITH ATRIAL FIBRILLATION AND BLEEDING DISORDERS: A SINGLE-CENTER EXPERIENCE
    Bleeding Thrombosis and Vascular Biology · 2026-10-08
    单中心回顾性研究显示，8例合并出血性疾病的房颤患者行左心耳封堵术，无血栓栓塞事件，5例发生出血事件但多为轻度，提示LAAO在高出血风险患者中安全可行。
  • Cardiac amyloidosis: what every interventional cardiologist should know.
    Cardiovasc Interv Ther · 2026-10-08
    综述指出介入心脏病医生在评估胸痛、冠脉病、房颤、主动脉瓣狭窄时应警惕心脏淀粉样变，当病变不能完全解释症状时需进一步排查。
  • Lyme Carditis Beyond Atrioventricular Block: Cardiac Arrest and Transient Atrial Fibrillation With Preserved Atrioventricular Conduction.
    Case Rep Cardiol · 2026-10-08
    一例莱姆心脏炎患者表现为心脏骤停和短暂性房颤，但房室传导正常，提示PR间期正常不能排除电不稳定。
  • Serial Artificial Intelligence ECG-Derived Atrial Fibrillation Probability and Recurrence Risk After Pulsed Field Ablation.
    Circ Arrhythm Electrophysiol · 2026-10-08
    在1052例接受脉冲场消融的房颤患者中，基线及术后早期窦性心律AI-ECG房颤概率评分动态与复发风险独立相关，RI-90每增加0.1风险增加15%，可辅助风险分层。
  • Randomising the Grey Zone: Evaluating the SINGLE-AF Trial in the Intermediate Risk Cohort with Atrial Fibrillation
    EMJ Cardiology · 2026-10-08
    针对CHA2DS2-VASc评分中间风险房颤人群，SINGLE-AF试验评估以卒中预防为目标的抗凝策略，但摘要未报告样本量、终点及统计结果。
  • Glucagon-Like Peptide-1 Receptor Agonists and the Risk of Stroke in Patients with Atrial Fibrillation and Type 2 Diabetes: A Danish Nationwide Cohort Study
    EMJ Cardiology · 2026-10-08
  • Improving Long-Term Outcomes in Atrial Fibrillation: Temporal Decline in Stroke and Dementia Risk Among Danish Patients – A Danish Nationwide Registry-Based Study, 1995–2025
    EMJ Cardiology · 2026-10-08
  • Impact of differences in kidney function estimation by creatinine compared to cystatin C on clinical outcomes in patients with atrial fibrillation.
    Eur Heart J Open · 2026-10-08
    在3804例房颤患者中，基于胱抑素C与肌酐估算的eGFR差值（eGFRdiff）普遍存在，更负的eGFRdiff与心血管事件、心衰住院及脑缺血性病变风险增加相关。
  • Phenotypic clustering of atrial fibrillation patients using latent class analysis and its potential utility for ablation strategy: insights from the DIRECT-Extend and EARNEST-PVI studies.
    Eur Heart J Open · 2026-10-08
    潜在类别分析在房颤患者中识别出三种表型，预后不同，且仅低合并症表型从PVI+广泛消融中获益。
  • Improved patient value after implementing same day discharge for patients undergoing pulmonary vein isolation.
    Europace · 2026-10-08
    实施肺静脉隔离当日出院方案后，患者90天全因死亡率更低、并发症无差异，且围术期及术后总费用显著降低，每例平均节省315欧元。
  • Histology analysis images for sinus rhythm and atrial fibrillation patients
    Figshare · 2026-10-08
    该数据集提供窦性心律与房颤患者心房组织ZEN Lite原始组织学图像及细胞边界与核中心标注，用于比较阵发性与持续性房颤的微观结构重构。
  • Preliminary exploration of differentially expressed circular RNAs for discriminating atrial fibrillation-related stroke.
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-10-08
    房颤相关卒中患者外周血存在差异表达环状RNA，其中circRNA_12852为独立危险因素，对鉴别房颤相关卒中具有一定价值（AUC 0.810）。
  • Correlation between myocardial radiomics features at the left atrium-left atrial appendage junction and stroke risk in atrial fibrillation patients: a retrospective case-control study.
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-10-08
    房颤相关心源性卒中患者左心房-左心耳交界处心肌厚度及影像组学特征显著改变，联合模型在测试队列中预测卒中的AUC达0.968。
  • Association between the triglyceride-high-density lipoprotein-glucose-body index and atrial fibrillation: a retrospective case-control study.
    Front Nutr · 2026-10-08
    在1137例回顾性病例对照研究中，TyHGB指数与房颤风险独立相关，每增加1单位房颤风险增加61%，预测性能与TyG相当。
  • Explainable deep learning-based classification of Wolff-Parkinson-White electrocardiographic signals.
    Front Physiol · 2026-10-08
    基于个体化虚拟心脏模型合成心电图训练的深度学习模型，可在24个心脏区域定位单个显性旁路，准确率超94%，并确定V2导联最关键。
  • Open wavefront ablation terminates rotor-driven atrial fibrillation
    Frontiers in Network Physiology · 2026-10-08
    在600例患者个体化房颤模拟中，闭合所有开放波可100%终止房颤，提示开放波是维持房颤的关键靶点。
  • Systems-based perspectives on atrial fibrillation: integrating classification and severity
    Indian Journal of Thoracic and Cardiovascular Surgery · 2026-10-08
  • Clinical Advantages and Pitfalls of Pulsed Field Ablation: How to Prevent ALH Syndrome.
    J Arrhythm · 2026-10-08
    脉冲场消融（PFA）在房颤肺静脉隔离中不劣于传统热消融，但可导致急性肾损伤、卒中、冠脉痉挛等独特并发症，需警惕ALH综合征。
  • Right Atrium-Dominant Single-Loop Biatrial Tachycardia Mimicking Reverse Typical Atrial Flutter After Mitral Valve Repair via a Superior Transseptal Approach
    J Arrhythm · 2026-10-08
    二尖瓣修复术后经上房间隔入路患者可出现右房主导的单环双房心动过速，模拟逆向典型房扑，双房标测与拖拽证实左房参与有限。
  • Prognostic Value of Preoperative 2-Dimensional Left Ventricular, Right Ventricular, and Left Atrial Strain in Patients Undergoing Off-Pump Coronary Artery Bypass Grafting: A Prospective Observational Study.
    J Cardiothorac Vasc Anesth · 2026-10-08
    在择期非体外循环冠脉搭桥患者中，术前右室游离壁纵向应变和左房储器应变是术后新发房颤的独立预测因子，而左室整体纵向应变和左室射血分数并非独立预测因子。
  • Temporal Association Between Aromatase Inhibitor Initiation and New-Onset Atrial Fibrillation: A Case Report
    J Pharm Technol · 2026-10-08
    一例71岁绝经后乳腺癌患者启动芳香化酶抑制剂后短期内新发房颤，提示两者可能存在时间关联。
  • Acute Regional Atrial Metabolic Inflexibility in Atrial Fibrillation: Evidence From Human Vein of Marshall Arteriovenous Samplings.
    JACC Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-08
  • Effects of Dual-Energy Lattice-Tip Catheter Ablation of Ventricular Arrhythmias on Cardiac Implantable Electronic Device Performance.
    JACC Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-08
    Sphere-9双能量网格头导管行室性心律失常消融后，右室导线感知、阻抗及起搏阈值出现小幅但持续的变化，左室导线起搏阻抗降低，严重CIED交互罕见。
  • Adjunctive Low-Voltage Area Ablation Reduces Atrial Fibrillation Recurrence in Persistent Atrial Fibrillation: A Systematic Review, Meta-Analysis, and Trial Sequential Analysis.
    JACC Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-08
    在持续性房颤患者中，PVI联合低电压区消融较单纯PVI显著降低房性快速性心律失常复发（HR 0.67），且不增加主要围术期并发症。
  • Increased Heart Failure Risk After Low-Voltage-Area Ablation in Patients With Paroxysmal Atrial Fibrillation.
    JACC Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-08
    在阵发性房颤伴低电压区患者中，低电压区消融与更高的心衰住院风险相关（30% vs 6%），尽管窦性心律维持率高达96%。
  • Impact of Early Atrial Tachyarrhythmia Within the Blanking Period on Late Recurrence After Pulsed Field Ablation of Atrial Fibrillation.
    JACC Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-08
    PFA房颤消融后3个月内任何早期房性心律失常均强烈预测晚期复发（HR 4.89），且不受发生时机或是否需心脏复律影响，提示传统空白期概念不适用于PFA。
  • Durability and Safety of Superior Vena Cava Isolation With a Lattice-Tip Pulsed Field Ablation Catheter: Focal Versus Circumferential Lesion Sets
    JACC Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-08
  • Hybrid Ablation for Patients with Persistent and Long-Standing Persistent Atrial Fibrillation
    Journal of Cardiovascular Development and Disease · 2026-10-08
    混合消融（心外膜外科消融联合心内膜导管消融）较单纯导管消融可提高持续性和长程持续性房颤患者的无房颤生存率，但主要不良事件风险为5-7.8%。
  • Efficacy and Safety of Direct Oral Anticoagulants for Stroke Prevention in Korean Patients With Atrial Fibrillation
    Journal of Korean Medical Science · 2026-10-08
  • Evaluation of Warfarin Therapy and Achievement of Target Time in Therapeutic Range in Patients with Atrial Fibrillation at Cardiac Care Center Outpatient Clinic of Dr. Soetomo General Hospital
    Jurnal Sehat Indonesia (JUSINDO) · 2026-10-08
    在106例房颤患者中，华法林平均TTR仅43.15%，仅18.87%达到TTR≥65%，提示抗凝质量不达标。
  • The Role of High-Normal Potassium Levels in the Maintenance of Sinus Rhythm Following Cardiac Surgery in Patients with Persistent Atrial Fibrillation.
    Res Heart Yield Transl Med · 2026-10-08
    在持续性房颤心脏手术患者中，维持高正常血钾水平（>4.4 mmol/L）可提高术后窦性心律恢复率（87%）和48小时维持率（71%），并缩短ICU停留时间。
  • Clinical Event Rates and Patient Satisfaction with Generic Rivaroxaban in Atrial Fibrillation: The Prospective Guardian Study.
    TH Open · 2026-10-08
    在1092例房颤患者中，使用仿制利伐沙班1年，症状性血栓栓塞事件率0.64%，大出血率0.18%，治疗持续性和患者满意度均较高。
  • Detector checkpoints (ResNet-34, seeds 1-10) for: Does Simulated-Noise Stress Testing Predict Real Free-Living Degradation of Wearable ECG Atrial Fibrillation Detection?
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-10-08
    该数据集提供10个基于ResNet-34的房颤检测器检查点（种子1-10），训练于Chapman-Shaoxing-Ningbo数据库Lead I，用于评估模拟噪声压力测试能否预测可穿戴ECG在真实自由生活场景下的性能退化。

室性心律失常（11）

  • From Sudden Cardiac Death Prevention to Performance Optimization: A Conceptual Framework for Cardiovascular Assessment in Elite Athletes
    Anatol J Cardiol · 2026-10-08
    本文提出整合结构、电生理和功能评估的精英运动员心血管评估概念框架，在传统赛前筛查基础上增加超声心动图和可选的运动心肺试验，以兼顾猝死预防与运动表现优化，但尚需前瞻性验证。
  • Value of Left Ventricular Low Voltage Area and Ejection Fraction in Predicting End-Stage Heart Failure Outcomes After Ventricular Tachycardia Ablation in Patients With Non-Ischemic Cardiomyopathy.
    Circ Arrhythm Electrophysiol · 2026-10-08
    在非缺血性心肌病室速消融患者中，单极低电压区（LVA）和LVEF是终末期心衰结局的独立预测因子，双极LVA无独立关联，联合构建的3分风险评分可识别高危患者。
  • Persistent Supraventricular Tachycardia Following Central Venous Catheter Insertion: When Withdrawal of the Mechanical Stimulus Is Not Enough.
    Cureus · 2026-10-08
    42岁心衰合并糖尿病酮症酸中毒患者，中心静脉导管置入后诱发持续室上性心动过速，撤除导管后仍不终止，提示需积极评估血流动力学并启动抗心律失常治疗。
  • Interrogating the Purkinje Network: A Multimodal Strategy for Ventricular Conduction System Research and Sudden Cardiac Death
    EMJ Cardiology · 2026-10-08
  • Bidirectional ventricular tachycardia unmasked by beta-blockade in pheochromocytoma presenting as hypertensive optic neuropathy: a case report and literature review
    Frontiers in Medicine · 2026-10-08
    51岁女性嗜铬细胞瘤患者，在未先用α受体阻滞剂的情况下使用β受体阻滞剂后诱发出双向性室速，提示BVT可为嗜铬细胞瘤的首发表现。
  • Multimodality Imaging-Guided Ventricular Tachycardia Ablation in a Hypoplastic Right Ventricle After Glenn Palliation
    JACC Case Rep · 2026-10-08
    一例右心室发育不良且既往行双向Glenn术的成人患者，通过多模态影像与高密度标测指导室速消融，以基质均质化策略消除晚电位，并植入皮下ICD。
  • Four Distinct Morphologies of Bundle Branch Reentrant Ventricular Tachycardia Eliminated by Right Bundle Branch Ablation.
    JACC Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-08
  • Oscillatory Epicardial Delayed Potentials and Associated Unipolar Voltage Gradients in Brugada Syndrome
    JACC Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-08
  • Forensic cause-of-death determination of myocardial infarction-related sudden cardiac death in histopathologically similar cases using computational pathology
    Leg Med (Tokyo) · 2026-10-08
    计算病理学框架（UNI-CLAM）在412张全切片图像中区分心肌梗死相关心源性猝死与其他死因，外部验证AUC达0.829，并识别出心肌破裂与变性共现等特征性损伤模式。
  • Advanced renal cell carcinoma with extensive venous tumor thrombus: A case report
    Medical Reports · 2026-10-08
    一例59岁晚期肾细胞癌伴静脉瘤栓延伸至右心房的患者，因肿瘤进展采取保守抗凝联合免疫检查点治疗。
  • Delayed left ventricular remodelling in patients with heart failure and reduced ejection fraction: a systematic review.
    Open Heart · 2026-10-08
    在LVEF≤35%且已接受至少3个月GDMT的心衰患者中，继续3-6个月GDMT后21%-59%的患者LVEF改善至35%以上，期间全因死亡率0%-7.6%。

器械治疗（6）

  • Upgrading to biventricular pacing or left bundle branch area pacing for the treatment of pacemaker-induced cardiomyopathy
    BMC Cardiovascular Disorders · 2026-10-08
    在31例起搏器诱导心肌病（PiCM）患者中，升级为双心室起搏（BiVP）或左束支区域起搏（LBBAP）均与短期心功能、电同步性改善相关，但两组间无显著差异，且研究不足以判定等效性。
  • Out of sight, not out of risk: laser extraction of a 26-year-old abandoned pacemaker lead guided by multimodal imaging.
    Cardiol J · 2026-10-08
  • Optimal Depolarization Sequence for CRT Patients
    European Heart Journal Open · 2026-10-08
    在121例CRT患者中，CineECG衍生的植入前心尖-基底去极化梯度可独立预测CRT反应，梯度越小反应越好。
  • Appropriate ICD Therapies in Primary Prevention: A Propensity-Matched Comparison of Contemporary and Historic Heart Failure Cohorts
    J Arrhythm · 2026-10-08
    在HFrEF一级预防ICD患者中，当代ARNI/SGLT2i治疗时代与历史队列的恰当ICD治疗发生率无显著差异（HR 1.52，95%CI 0.84-2.72，P=0.165）。
  • From Sensing to Authority: A Consequence-Sensitive Architecture for Pacemaker Inhibition Under Uncertain Signal Origin
    OSF Preprints (OSF Preprints) · 2026-10-08
    本文提出一种基于后果敏感性的起搏抑制决策架构，将事件检测、来源归因、抑制相关性和抑制权限分层处理，并计划通过回顾性政策比较进行验证，但尚未报告任何实证数据。
  • Attractive and repulsive couplings between circadian pacemaker neurons promote entrainment to light-dark cycles with after-effect.
    NPJ Biol Timing Sleep · 2026-10-07
    视交叉上核核心-壳区之间吸引性与排斥性耦合的相位振子模型可解释光暗周期同步及撤光后自由运行周期缓慢回归的内在机制。

影像与标测（2）

  • Cardiac Magnetic Resonance-derived Ablation Footprint after Sequential Unipolar Radiofrequency, Focal Pulsed Field, and Bipolar Radiofrequency Ablation of Resistant Left Ventricular Summit VT.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-08
  • CADENCE: Open-source software for signal conditioning, feature extraction, visualization and analysis of cardiac optical mapping data
    bioRxiv (Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory) · 2026-10-08
    CADENCE是一款开源MATLAB软件，整合了光学标测数据的信号处理、特征提取与可视化全流程，在四物种、三组织制备和三种相机配置中验证，与专家观察者间一致性相当，可促进实验室标准化。

遗传与基础（5）

  • Towards a suitable biomarker for childhood screening for familial hypercholesterolemia: a systematic literature review.
    Clin Chem Lab Med · 2026-10-08
    系统综述纳入35项研究，LDL-c、TC和ApoB在杂合性FH儿童中持续升高，但仅3项筛查研究同时结合生物标志物与基因检测，敏感性和特异性有限或未报告。
  • Supplemental Material for: “I Don’t Think It Is Fair…There Should be a Solution to Every Problem”: Experiences of Individuals with Sudden Arrhythmia Death Syndromes Who Attempt to Obtain Life Insurance
    Figshare · 2026-10-08
    遗传性心律失常性猝死综合征患者或高危者尝试获取寿险时多数失败，认为保险专业人员缺乏对疾病的理解，拒绝不公平。
  • Histone lysine demethylase inhibition is a disease-modifying therapy for hypertrophic cardiomyopathy.
    bioRxiv · 2026-10-08
    泛KDM抑制剂JIB-04在Myh6 R403Q/+小鼠中可预防并逆转肥厚型心肌病，减少心肌肥厚和纤维化，完全预防心源性猝死，其作用与表观遗传重塑及靶点PHF2相关。
  • Lead Exposure During Differentiation Perturbs Electrophysiological Function in iPSC-Derived Cardiomyocytes in a Cell Line-Dependent Manner
    bioRxiv (Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory) · 2026-10-08
    在iPSC来源心肌细胞分化早期暴露于铅，会以细胞系依赖的方式持续改变动作电位和钙瞬变，并增加心律失常。
  • The ARumenamide AR-788 suppresses the transient outward current in human iPSC-derived right-ventricular Brugada cardioids
    medRxiv · 2026-10-08
    AR-788在携带SCN5A移码突变的BrS右心室类器官中抑制Ito，使Ito恢复至野生型水平而不降低INa，但同时也抑制IKr。

其他（3）

  • Radiofrequency-Facilitated Left Bundle Branch Area Pacing as a Bailout Strategy in Patients With Septal Resistance.
    JACC Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-08
  • CMR-derived anatomical indices for arrhythmia risk stratification in Ebstein anomaly.
    Rev Esp Cardiol (Engl Ed) · 2026-10-08
  • Could any of the patient's psychiatric medications contribute to or increase the risk of observed cardiac arrhythmias, including first-degree AV block and intermittent third-degree AV block? The patient is being treated with olanzapine, lithium, zolpidem, bupropion, quetiapine, oxazepam, and alimemazine
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-10-08
    多种精神科药物（锂盐、安非他酮、喹硫平、奥氮平）与心律失常风险增加相关，尤其在一度房室传导阻滞和间歇性三度房室传导阻滞患者中需警惕。

item.title: 2026-10-07 心脏电生理日报（69 篇）
item.description:
共 69 篇。在日报页面阅读完整解读 →

房颤与消融（34）

  • Haemodynamic Overestimation of Mitral Stenosis in Calcific Mitral Valve Disease: A Case Report Highlighting the Impact of Atrial Fibrillation, Mitral Regurgitation, and Volume Overload
    2026-10-07
    一例钙化性二尖瓣病变合并房颤、二尖瓣反流与容量负荷过重的患者，跨瓣压差被高估为中度二尖瓣狭窄，纠正血流动力学后压差由16/9降至8/4 mmHg、瓣口面积1.8 cm²。
  • Vericiguat in Experimental Atrial Fibrillation: Distinguishing Remodeling from Rhythm Control.
    Anatol J Cardiol · 2026-10-07
  • Listen to Your Heart and Mind: A Pilot Mixed-Methods Study on Combined Screening for Raised Blood Pressure, Atrial Fibrillation, Cognitive Impairment and Hearing Loss in Older Adults.
    Australas J Ageing · 2026-10-07
    在听力健康评估场景中对≥65岁社区老年人开展血压、AF、认知障碍联合筛查，71%受试者检出至少一项新发异常，受试者认为便捷高效，提示该模式可行且可接受。
  • Artificial Intelligence for Postoperative Atrial Fibrillation After Cardiac Surgery: A 2026 Perspective
    Cardiovascular Medicine · 2026-10-07
    心脏术后房颤是常见并发症，2026年观点提出术前心电图结合人工智能可早期识别高危患者，但尚需前瞻性验证。
  • Phenotype-Based Risk Stratification in Patients With New-Onset Atrial Fibrillation Following Myocardial Infarction Using a Data-Driven Approach.
    Catheter Cardiovasc Interv · 2026-10-07
    基于主成分分析在451例心梗后新发房颤患者中识别出三个风险表型，高风险组3年不良事件生存率最低，决策树模型可辅助临床风险分层。
  • Role of Lifestyle and Risk Factor Modification Clinics in Patients With Atrial Fibrillation: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials.
    Circ Arrhythm Electrophysiol · 2026-10-07
    在11项RCT共3364例AF患者的荟萃分析中，生活方式与危险因素管理门诊显著降低消融术后房性心律失常复发（OR 0.34）及AF相关住院，并改善生活质量。
  • Reclassifying Single Lead Sinus Rhythm ECGs for Improved AF Recurrence Detection With Deep Learning.
    Circ Arrhythm Electrophysiol · 2026-10-07
    基于单导联窦性心律心电图的深度学习模型可区分AF消融术后3天内复发风险，AUC 0.86，优于临床特征模型（AUC 0.71）。
  • A dual-channel deep learning framework integrating preoperative and intraoperative multi-phase data for predicting post-ablation recurrence in atrial fibrillation.
    Comput Methods Biomech Biomed Engin · 2026-10-07
    ACFT双通道深度学习模型整合术中消融序列与临床指标，预测房颤消融术后复发AUC达0.844，较标准基准提升7%。
  • Graph neural network for predicting reentrant drivers in atrial digital twins
    Comput Methods Programs Biomed · 2026-10-07
    本研究开发图神经网络，基于31个持续性房颤数字孪生体训练，前瞻性验证4例，预测折返驱动区域引导消融，使新发折返减少70%以上，模拟轮次减少66%。
  • Impact of Procedural Experience Implanting a Next Generation Left Atrial Appendage Occluder -VERITAS Study Insights.
    Europace · 2026-10-07
  • Classic case report: Concomitant Pulsed Field Ablation, Cavotricuspid Isthmus Ablation and Percutaneous Left Atrial Appendage Occlusion in a Patient with Prior Intracranial Haemorrhage
    European Heart Journal - Case Reports · 2026-10-07
    在既往脑出血且疑诊脑淀粉样血管病的持续性房颤患者中，单次手术联合脉冲场消融、三尖瓣峡部消融和左心耳封堵可行，术后短期抗凝后完全停药。
  • Psychosocial Symptom Networks Across Atrial Fibrillation Subtypes: Evidence from Two Waves of the ARENA Cohort
    European Heart Journal Open · 2026-10-07
    ARENA队列研究显示，房颤患者心理社会症状网络结构在不同房颤类型、EHRA分级和随访时间点间总体稳定，但特定症状关联和节点中心性存在差异，焦虑、心脏担忧、孤独感和睡眠问题是潜在干预靶点。
  • Adverse Arrhythmia-Related Outcomes After Catheter Ablation in Patients with Inflammatory Bowel Disease: A Nationwide Propensity Score–Matched Cohort Study
    European Heart Journal Open · 2026-10-07
    在瑞士全国队列中，IBD患者导管消融后不良心律失常相关复合终点风险较无IBD匹配对照高30%（HR 1.30），主要由心律失常住院增加驱动。
  • Case report: A unified CTA-fluoroscopy roadmap for single-session pulsed field ablation and left atrial appendage occlusion.
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-10-07
    在5例单次联合PFA与左心耳封堵术中，CTA-透视融合路标工作流在4例完整实施，全部完成PFA和WATCHMAN植入，45天CTA随访无残余漏或器械相关血栓。
  • Extent of posterior wall lesion following pulmonary vein isolation with pentaspline pulsed field and cryoballoon ablation: the potential role of deployment technique
    Frontiers in Cardiovascular Medicine · 2026-10-07
    在复发性房颤患者中，五分支脉冲场消融与冷冻球囊隔离肺静脉后，左房后壁慢性隔离面积无显著差异，但脉冲场消融手术时间更短。
  • SPISE for predicting the presence of atrial fibrillation in patients with coronary artery disease: a comparative analysis with TyG index
    Frontiers in Endocrinology · 2026-10-07
    在冠心病患者中，SPISE指数与合并房颤独立负相关（OR=0.627），且对房颤的预测价值优于TyG指数（AUC 0.646 vs 0.566）。
  • The Indispensable Role of Sham Controls in Evaluating Interventional Therapies: The Need for Objective Rigor in Atrial Fibrillation Ablation.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-07
  • Why Sham Studies Are a Sham in 2026! Sham-controlled AF ablation trials as a case study.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-07
  • Feasibility of tissue proximity indication during atrial fibrillation rhythm as an indicator of acute pulmonary vein reconnection using variable-loop pulsed field ablation catheter.
    Int J Cardiol · 2026-10-07
    在AF节律下使用可变环脉冲场消融导管时，TPI阴性联合双极电压≥0.35 mV可预测急性肺静脉再连接，但准确性受消融部位影响。
  • Clinical Advantages and Pitfalls of Pulsed Field Ablation: How to Prevent ALH Syndrome
    J Arrhythm · 2026-10-07
    脉冲场消融（PFA）在房颤肺静脉隔离中不劣于传统热消融，但可导致急性肾损伤、卒中、冠脉痉挛等热消融罕见的新并发症，溶血相关损伤可能是重要机制。
  • Evolving Mechanisms on Mortality in Atrial Fibrillation: A 25-Year National Death-Certificate Analysis.
    J Cardiovasc Electrophysiol · 2026-10-07
    美国25年死亡证明分析显示，房颤相关死亡中射血分数保留的心衰和卒中无关痴呆占比上升，而缺血性卒中和心肌梗死稳定或下降。
  • Systolic Blood Pressure Variability and Outcomes in Atrial Fibrillation: A Nationwide Population Study in Korea.
    J Korean Med Sci · 2026-10-07
    在韩国房颤人群中，收缩压变异性最高组较最低组显著增加卒中（aHR 1.211）、大出血（aHR 1.125）和全因死亡（aHR 1.189）风险，且与口服抗凝药使用无交互作用。
  • Pulsed-Field Ablation Versus Thermal Ablation for Atrial Fibrillation: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
    Journal of Clinical Question · 2026-10-07
    在阵发性房颤首次消融中，脉冲场消融与热消融相比未显著降低房性心律失常复发，但显著缩短手术时间和左房停留时间。
  • Silent Rhythms: Integrated Pathways for Community Atrial Fibrillation Management
    Lenus, The Irish Health Repository (Dr Steevens Hospital Library) · 2026-10-07
    该会议摘要报告了社区房颤整合管理路径的实践，但摘要未报告研究人群、样本量及任何结局数据。
  • Galway University Hospital/Galway City Integrated Care Hub Atrial Fibrillation Virtual Care At Home (AFVCAH) Project
    Lenus, The Irish Health Repository (Dr Steevens Hospital Library) · 2026-10-07
    该摘要仅为会议海报记录，未报告研究对象、样本量或任何结局数据，无法得出关于房颤虚拟居家照护的疗效结论。
  • Epicardial Adipose Tissue as a Metabolic Target to Improve Outcomes After Catheter Ablation for Atrial Fibrillation
    Medical Science Monitor · 2026-10-07
    综述提示，降糖、降脂及心衰药物可缩小心外膜脂肪并抑制其炎症活性，从而改善房颤导管消融后的心律结局。
  • Does a More Extensive Lesion Set Improve Rhythm Control? Outcomes of Cryoablation During Mitral Valve Replacement
    Preprints.org · 2026-10-07
    在二尖瓣置换同期行双心房冷冻消融的基础上追加冠状静脉窦消融，未能显著降低出院后房颤复发风险（HR 0.52，95%CI 0.12–2.15），12个月窦性心律率三组间无差异。
  • Atrial Fibrillation in Aotearoa New Zealand Wāhine
    ResearchSpace (University of Auckland) · 2026-10-07
    新西兰女性房颤患者接受动态心电图监测更频繁但时长更短、紧急转诊更少，转诊消融时年龄更大且阵发性房颤更多，校正后房颤复发风险显著高于男性（aHR 1.93）。
  • Reversible Atrial Fibrillation Secondary to a Megaoesophagus
    Scholars Journal of Medical Case Reports · 2026-10-07
    93岁男性因巨食管压迫左心房导致可逆性房颤，食管扩张和清除食物残渣后恢复窦性心律。
  • PROGNOSTIC SIGNIFICANCE OF VENTRICULAR ECTOPIC ACTIVITY FOR CARDIOVASCULAR MORTALITY IN PATIENTS WITH ATRIAL FIBRILLATION
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-10-07
    在196例房颤患者中，室性异位活动对心血管死亡的预测价值尚未明确，摘要未报告具体效应量及P值。
  • COMPARATIVE ANTIRECURRENCE ANTIARRHYTHMIC EFFICACY OF SOME FAST SODIUM CHANNEL BLOCKERS IN PATIENTS WITH ATRIAL FIBRILLATION
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-10-07
    在无/轻微结构性心脏病的房颤患者中，艾克萨利特明与普罗帕酮12个月节律控制疗效相当，但普罗帕酮绝对有效率更高。
  • AGE-RELATED DIFFERENCES OF PEAK AND TROUGH PLASMA CONCENTRATIONS OF RIVAROXABAN IN UZBEK POPULATION WITH ATRIAL FIBRILLATION
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-10-07
    在房颤患者中，≥75岁者利伐沙班谷浓度显著高于39-75岁者（78.50 vs 26.75 ng/mL，p=0.031），尽管更多使用减量，提示现行减量算法未完全抵消年龄相关差异。
  • LAPPACONITINE HYDROBROMIDE (ALLAPININ): CLINICAL AND EXPERIMENTAL PROSPECTS
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-10-07
    氢溴酸高乌甲素联合β受体阻滞剂可显著降低冠心病血运重建术后房颤和室性早搏发生率，短期使用安全有效。
  • Stoichiometry-dependent gating and structural pharmacology of cardiac GIRK1/4 channels
    bioRxiv (Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory) · 2026-10-07
    心脏GIRK1/4通道以1:3和2:2两种化学计量比组装，GIRK1亚基比例增加使HBC门控逐步开放、基础活性升高；ML297对1:3组装抑制、对2:2组装增强，揭示亚基组成决定药理学效应。

室性心律失常（9）

  • Standardized Spark-Pattern Cut-Mode Electrosurgical Bailout Workflow for Difficult Left Bundle Branch Area Pacing Lead Advancement: Procedural and Follow-Up Outcomes From a 15-Patient Case Series.
    Circ Arrhythm Electrophysiol · 2026-10-07
    在15例常规机械推进失败的左束支区域起搏患者中，标准化火花模式切割电外科补救流程实现15/15手术成功，随访400天无导线故障或间隔穿孔。
  • Prognostic Impact of Left Ventricular Apical Aneurysm Identified by Echocardiography in Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy - A Multicenter Retrospective Study in Japan.
    Circ J · 2026-10-07
    日本多中心369例肥厚型心肌病患者的回顾性研究显示，超声心动图识别的左室心尖部室壁瘤与基线心律失常事件负担增加相关，但不增加全因死亡和心血管死亡风险。
  • Fetal Supraventricular Tachycardia Complicated by Hydrops Fetalis: A Case Report of Complete Reversal With Transplacental Flecainide Therapy
    Cureus · 2026-10-07
    30周胎儿室上速合并水肿经母体氟卡尼治疗10天恢复窦律、水肿完全消退，但出生后仍反复发作需升级治疗。
  • Ventricular arrhythmic burden before and after mitral valve repair in mitral valve prolapse: the role of mitral annular disjunction
    Frontiers in Cardiovascular Medicine · 2026-10-07
    二尖瓣脱垂患者行二尖瓣修复术后室性早搏负荷显著下降，但术前存在二尖瓣环分离者术后PVC负荷仍明显更高，且下降比例与无MAD者相当。
  • Left bundle branch area pacing induced dual bundle branches non-reentrant bigeminy and Takotsubo cardiomyopathy: a case report
    Frontiers in Physiology · 2026-10-07
    76岁女性LBBaP术后出现双束支非折返性二联律并诱发Takotsubo心肌病，经β受体阻滞剂调整后二联律消除、心功能恢复。
  • Substrate-Based Ablation Guided by Combined Fractionation and Frequency Analysis for Multiple and Unmappable Ventricular Tachycardias.
    J Arrhythm · 2026-10-07
    联合碎裂电位与峰值频率标测可在多发性、不可标测室速患者中识别室速相关基质区，为消融提供补充指导。
  • Multicenter Coronary Venous Carbon Dioxide Insufflation for Subxiphoid Epicardial Access in Ventricular Tachycardia Ablation.
    JACC Asia · 2026-10-07
    在亚洲多中心回顾性研究中，冠状静脉CO2充气（Epi-CO2）辅助心外膜入路用于室速消融，未发生主要入路相关并发症，而传统入路发生率为12.0%。
  • Sustained Monomorphic Ventricular Tachycardia Decades After Ventricular Septal Defect Repair.
    JACC Case Rep · 2026-10-07
    57岁男性室间隔缺损补片修补术后数十年出现持续性单形性室速，提示修补术后终身心律失常风险，但补片依赖性折返需三维电解剖标测证实。
  • Long-Term Follow-up of Spontaneous Coronary Artery Dissection in Young Women: A Single-Center Tertiary Referral Cohort.
    Turk Kardiyol Dern Ars · 2026-10-07
    年轻女性SCAD患者中，以Yip-Saw 3型最常见，前降支最常受累，多数接受PCI，长期随访死亡率5%。

器械治疗（11）

  • Unusual electrocardiographic manifestations and clinical outcome of alternating bifascicular block after ventricular septal defect transcatheter closure: case report
    BMC Cardiovascular Disorders · 2026-10-07
    3岁室间隔缺损封堵术后患儿出现交替性双分支阻滞，进展为三束支阻滞并发生长达8.9秒的心室停搏，植入永久起搏器后2年无晕厥。
  • Seizure Like Activity During Permanent Pacemaker Implantation: A Case of Suspected Venous Air Embolism With Acute Hypoxia.
    Clin Case Rep · 2026-10-07
    78岁男性永久起搏器植入术中导线操作时突发全身僵硬、癫痫样活动伴严重低氧（血氧饱和度70%），疑诊静脉空气栓塞，经高流量吸氧及暂停操作后完全恢复，无神经后遗症。
  • Near-infrared laser-controlled thermoelectric hydrogel for leadless controlled and battery-free cardiac pacing
    Colloids and Surfaces A Physicochemical and Engineering Aspects · 2026-10-07
  • Predicting survival beyond 5 years on continuous-flow left ventricular assist device: a landmark analysis from the STELLAR registry.
    ESC Heart Fail · 2026-10-07
    在连续流LVAD支持存活≥5年的患者中，后续死亡与年龄、血红蛋白、MELD-XI评分及ICD存在独立相关，LVAD型号无显著影响。
  • Infection of an implantable automatic defibrillator due to Pasteurella multocida.
    Enferm Infecc Microbiol Clin (Engl Ed) · 2026-10-07
  • Trajectories of kinesiophobia over the first six months after cardiac pacemaker or defibrillator implantation: clinical, psychological, and rehabilitation predictors and their relation to functional capacity
    Frontiers in Cardiovascular Medicine · 2026-10-07
    起搏器或除颤器植入后6个月内运动恐惧呈三种轨迹，约26%患者持续高恐惧且功能容量最差，抑郁、焦虑、低自我效能、基线步行距离短和缺乏运动指导可早期识别。
  • Leadless Atrial Pacemaker Migration Presenting as Gluteal Spasms.
    JACC Case Rep · 2026-10-07
    80岁女性植入无导线心房起搏器后发生装置移位至右侧髂内静脉，表现为节律性臀肌痉挛，为全球首例报告。
  • Analysis of Electrical Signals of Electroporated Langendorff-Perfused Hearts in Laporine Model
    Lithuanian University of Health Sciences · 2026-10-07
    在Langendorff灌流兔心模型中，脉冲场消融（PEF）可导致深度达3 mm的完全电信号丢失，且损伤程度依赖于刺激参数，光学标测与微电极记录可交叉验证消融效果。
  • Attractive and repulsive couplings between circadian pacemaker neurons promote entrainment to light-dark cycles with after-effect
    NPJ Biol Timing Sleep · 2026-10-07
    视交叉上核核心-壳区之间的吸引性与排斥性耦合可增强光暗周期同步能力，并在转入持续黑暗后产生周期后效应。
  • Conduction System Pacing Versus Biventricular Pacing for Cardiac Resynchronization Therapy in Patients with Heart Failure with Reduced Ejection Fraction and Left Bundle Branch Block: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials with GRADE Assessment and Trial Sequential Analysis
    Open Science Framework · 2026-10-07
    在HFrEF合并LBBB患者中，CSP较BiVP可能更改善LVEF，但证据确定性有限，对临床硬终点影响尚不明确。
  • Advancing conduction system pacing:Comparative outcomes, quality standards, and clinical integration in modern cardiac pacing
    Research Publications (Maastricht University) · 2026-10-07

心力衰竭与代谢（2）

  • Dapagliflozin and ventricular repolarization across heart failure phenotypes.
    Curr Med Res Opin · 2026-10-07
    在T2DM患者中，达格列净治疗3个月可降低多项心室复极心电图指标，HFrEF患者降幅最大（QTc -14.3 ms），但研究仅涉及替代终点。
  • ACUTE TOXICITY AND ANTIARRHYTHMIC ACTIVITY OF THE ALKALOID NITRARIDINE
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-10-07
    在乌头碱诱导的大鼠心律失常模型中，生物碱nitraridine（3-5 mg/kg）对心电图参数无明显影响，10 mg/kg仅延长R-R间期10-14.2%，提示其作为低毒性抗心律失常药物具有实用研究价值。

影像与标测（1）

  • Comparison of virtual and true ECG-gated coronary CT angiography in patients with acute chest pain: a prospective cohort study
    Frontiers in Radiology · 2026-10-07
    在急性胸痛疑似冠心病患者中，虚拟心电门控CCTA较真实心电门控缩短检查时间、提升图像信噪比与血管水平诊断一致性，但辐射剂量轻度增加。

遗传与基础（10）

  • Risk-Stratified Cardiac Monitoring During Antipsychotic Treatment in Adolescents and Young Adults.
    Acta Psychiatr Scand · 2026-10-07
    在青少年和年轻成人抗精神病药治疗中，患者层面危险因素（电解质紊乱、心动过缓、进食障碍等）对QTc风险的预测价值高于药物种类，建议采用分层监测而非统一方案。
  • The genetic landscape of myotonic dystrophy type 1: insights from nearly one million genomes
    Brain · 2026-10-07
    基于近百万全基因组测序数据，致病性DMPK重复扩增的患病率约为1/1527，是既往估计的2-5倍，且与传导阻滞、房颤/房扑及早发白内障显著相关，多数携带者此前未被诊断为DM1。
  • NIMA-Related Kinase-7 Activates Atrial Cardiomyocyte NLRP3 Inflammasome and Associates With Occurrence of Postoperative Atrial Fibrillation.
    Circ Arrhythm Electrophysiol · 2026-10-07
    NEK7 在房性心肌细胞中激活 NLRP3 炎症小体，并与心脏术后房颤的发生相关，提示其可能是术后房颤炎症机制的上游调控靶点。
  • Homozygous LMNA (p.Arg216His) variant in an Ecuadorian patient with atrial flutter and high-grade atrioventricular block: a case report
    Frontiers in Cardiovascular Medicine · 2026-10-07
    一例42岁厄瓜多尔男性携带纯合LMNA p.Arg216His变异，表现为心房扑动伴缓慢心室率、高级别房室传导阻滞和严重心动过缓，为首次报道的纯合状态。
  • Commentary: Calcium arrhythmogenicity of Purkinje fibers: importance of the animal model
    Frontiers in Physiology · 2026-10-07
    本文评论指出TRPV4通道可能通过增加钙内流和诱发延迟后除极参与梗死后浦肯野纤维心律失常，强调大动物模型对转化研究的重要性。
  • Sudden cardiac death due to aortic stenosis.
    Heart · 2026-10-07
    在尸检确诊的猝死登记中，主动脉瓣狭窄所致猝死仅占1.1%，且过半患者生前未确诊，尸检几乎均见心肌肥厚与纤维化。
  • Ion Channel Dysfunction and Electrical Instability in Atrial Fibrillation
    International Journal of Science and Research (IJSR) · 2026-10-07
    本综述系统阐述了心房颤动中心脏离子通道功能障碍与钙释放异常导致电不稳定的机制，并探讨了基于这些机制的药物、导管消融及个体化管理新策略。
  • PHARMACOGENETIC ANALYSIS OF THE EFFICACY OF ANTIHYPERTENSIVE THERAPY INCLUDING EPLERENONE IN PATIENTS WITH ARTERIAL HYPERTENSION AND PERMANENT ATRIAL FIBRILLATION CONSIDERING THE C-344T POLYMORPHISM OF THE CYP11B2 GENE
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-10-07
    在高血压合并永久性AF患者中，依普利酮治疗6个月可显著降低左室质量指数，但颈动脉IMT和尿MAU/肌酐比的改善仅见于CYP11B2 C-344T多态性C等位基因携带者。
  • CD14 Blockade Attenuates Arrhythmogenic Cardiomyopathy
    bioRxiv (Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory) · 2026-10-07
    在Dsg2突变小鼠模型中，抗CD14抗体治疗可减轻致心律失常性心肌病的疾病表型，减少炎症性巨噬细胞和促纤维化成纤维细胞。
  • Sex-related phenotypic differences in myotonic dystrophy types 1 and 2: a nationwide registry study from Serbia.
    J Neurol · 2026-10-06
    塞尔维亚全国注册研究显示，强直性肌营养不良1型和2型存在性别相关表型差异：DM1男性神经肌肉受累更重，DM2女性近端下肢无力与呼吸功能下降更明显，而两型男性心脏与代谢负担均更高。

其他（2）

  • Diagnostic yield of 24-hour Holter monitoring in children presenting with chest pain, palpitations, or syncope: A single-center retrospective study
    Turkish Journal of Pediatric Disease · 2026-10-07
    儿童24小时动态心电图诊断率因症状而异，但异常心电图而非症状本身是严重心律失常和干预的独立预测因子，孤立性晕厥患者无严重心律失常。
  • PERSONALIZED APPROACH TO THE USE OF ALLAPININ IN CARDIAC ARRHYTHMIAS IN EMERGENCY CARDIOLOGY
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-10-07
    综述指出，Allapinin（氢溴酸高乌甲素，IC类抗心律失常药）在急诊心律失常中仅应作为个体化策略的组成部分，用于严格筛选的患者，而非急诊终止心动过速的通用手段。

item.title: 2026-10-06 心脏电生理日报（61 篇）
item.description:
共 61 篇。在日报页面阅读完整解读 →

房颤与消融（35）

  • Thrombospondin-1 and Thrombospondin-2 are associated with biatrial fibrotic remodeling in human valvular heart disease.
    Adv Med Sci · 2026-10-06
    在瓣膜性心脏病患者中，心房TSP-1和TSP-2表达与双心房纤维化及炎症重构相关，二尖瓣病变左房改变最显著。
  • New-Onset Atrial Fibrillation After Alcohol Septal Ablation Versus Surgical Myectomy in Obstructive Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy: A Propensity-Matched Analysis.
    Am J Cardiol · 2026-10-06
    在倾向匹配的梗阻性肥厚型心肌病人群中，酒精室间隔消融术后新发房颤风险显著高于外科心肌切除术，且风险差异从术后第7天开始显现并持续扩大至3年。
  • Left Atrial Appendage Closure or Medical Therapy in Atrial Fibrillation: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
    Cardiology · 2026-10-06
    在房颤患者中，左心耳封堵在全因死亡与大出血方面不劣于药物治疗，但在卒中、心血管死亡及复合终点上未达到非劣效。
  • Lyme Carditis Beyond Atrioventricular Block: Cardiac Arrest and Transient Atrial Fibrillation With Preserved Atrioventricular Conduction
    Case Rep Cardiol · 2026-10-06
    一例无房室传导阻滞的莱姆心肌炎患者，表现为心脏骤停和短暂性房颤，提示PR间期正常不能排除电不稳定。
  • Racial and Ethnic Disparities in the Utilization and Outcomes of Catheter Ablation for Atrial Fibrillation and Flutter: a State-of-the-Art Review.
    Curr Cardiol Rep · 2026-10-06
    美国黑人和西班牙裔/亚裔房颤/房扑患者接受导管消融的可能性显著低于白人，但临床试验显示少数族裔从消融中获益更大，凸显医疗公平性问题。
  • The Left Atrial Appendage: Anatomy, Electrophysiology, and Clinical Implications for Atrial Fibrillation and Stroke.
    Curr Cardiol Rep · 2026-10-06
    左心耳是房颤血栓栓塞的主要来源和潜在致心律失常基质，LAA电隔离和封堵在特定患者中有效，OPTION试验显示封堵不劣于抗凝且出血更少。
  • Subclinical atrial fibrillation: Detection, stroke risk, and treatment
    Deutsches Ärzteblatt international · 2026-10-06
    亚临床房颤增加卒中风险但程度低于临床房颤，常规口服抗凝不能推荐，因其获益与出血风险相抵，更多是心房心肌病的标志。
  • Discharge treatment patterns as risk markers after post-operative atrial fibrillation.
    Eur Heart J · 2026-10-06
  • A broader VISION of post-operative atrial fibrillation management.
    Eur Heart J · 2026-10-06
  • Biventricular vs conduction system pacing after atrioventricular node ablation for heart failure with atrial fibrillation: the CONDUCT-AF trial.
    Eur Heart J · 2026-10-06
    在难治性房颤合并心衰患者中，房室结消融后行左束支区域起搏的6个月LVEF改善不劣于双心室起搏，且起搏QRS更窄、手术时间更短。
  • Thymic cyst-induced left atrial compression associated with atrial fibrillation: a unique case report.
    Eur Heart J Case Rep · 2026-10-06
    37岁无心血管危险因素的阵发性房颤女性，在心内超声（ICE）引导肺静脉隔离时偶然发现左房上方异位胸腺囊肿，手术切除后房颤发作改善，提示年轻房颤患者需排查少见解剖病因。
  • Disappearance of local ventricular components during extrastimulus pacing after ultra-low-temperature cryoablation for ventricular tachycardia: a case report.
    Eur Heart J Case Rep · 2026-10-06
    一例扩张型心肌病VT患者在接受超低温冷冻消融15个月后复发，再次消融时发现额外刺激起搏下局部心室电图可重复性消失，提示部分损伤心肌的局部不应期或源-汇失配。
  • Impact of Procedural Experience Implanting a Next Generation Left Atrial Appendage Occluder –VERITAS Study Insights
    Europace · 2026-10-06
    VERITAS研究显示，随着术者植入新一代左心耳封堵器经验增加，手术成功率提高且主要并发症减少，学习曲线约20例。
  • Predictive value of the cholesterol-HDL-glucose (CHG) index for recurrence after radiofrequency catheter ablation of atrial fibrillation: a retrospective cohort study
    European journal of medical research · 2026-10-06
    在625例非瓣膜性房颤患者中，CHG指数是RFCA术后复发的独立预测因子，AUC 0.698，加入传统模型可改善风险分层。
  • Integrated bioinformatics and clinical validation of oxidative stress-associated genes in atrial fibrillation and chronic kidney disease.
    Exp Ther Med · 2026-10-06
    生物信息学分析鉴定出BTG2、ZFP36和NPPB为房颤与慢性肾脏病共有的氧化应激相关关键基因，并在患者外周血中验证其表达差异。
  • ANGPTL2 and CP define complementary circadian-associated signals in atrial fibrillation: integrative transcriptomics and external validation.
    Front Cell Dev Biol · 2026-10-06
    ANGPTL2和CP被鉴定为房颤中与昼夜节律相关的候选基因，在颤动心房中上调并呈节律表达，主要富集于血管和基质细胞，但未证实因果调控或临床疗效。
  • Left atrial appendage morphology and hemodynamics: potential new markers for individualized thromboembolic risk assessment in atrial fibrillation
    Frontiers in Cardiovascular Medicine · 2026-10-06
    左心耳形态与血流动力学指标可弥补CHA₂DS₂-VASc评分的不足，基于数字孪生的两层评估框架有望实现房颤血栓栓塞风险的个体化评估。
  • Efficacy and Safety of Flecainide Versus Amiodarone for the Cardioversion of paroxysmal Atrial Fibrillation in Patients with Coronary Artery Disease without evidence of residual ischemia: The FLECA-ED Randomized Clinical Trial.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-06
    在无残余缺血的冠心病合并阵发性房颤患者中，静脉氟卡尼6小时内转复窦律优于胺碘酮（85.7% vs 40.0%），且不增加室性致心律失常事件。
  • Clinical Implications of Hemolysis after Pulsed Field Ablation - What Can We Learn from Benchtop Models and Preclinical Experiments.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-06
    脉冲场消融（PFA）相关血管内溶血是日益被认识的不良反应，偶可进展为急性肾损伤，其机制、决定因素和临床意义尚不完全清楚，需通过生理性台架模型和跨平台评估来深入理解并减轻其发生。
  • Safety and Efficacy of Pulsed Field Ablation for Atrial Fibrillation in Patients With Chronic Kidney Disease.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-06
    在2269例接受PFA的AF患者中，CKD各期均未独立增加非肾脏并发症，但基线eGFR每降低1 mL/min/1.73 m²与术后AKI风险独立相关（OR 0.96），12个月无AF复发生存率在CKD与非CKD间无显著差异。
  • Heart Rhythm Society and Heart Rhythm Advocates position statement: Prior authorization in cardiac electrophysiology: Evidence, policy, and reform
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-06
    该立场声明指出，医保优势计划和商业保险的预先授权要求已成为指南指示电生理诊疗的系统性障碍，导致患者伤害和行政负担，需通过申诉策略和政策改革应对。
  • Direct Oral Anticoagulant-Calibrated Heparin LRT Assay as a Rapid Alternative to an Anti-Factor Xa Assay for Measuring Apixaban, Edoxaban, and Rivaroxaban in Patients With Non-Valvular Atrial Fibrillation.
    Int J Lab Hematol · 2026-10-06
    在非瓣膜性房颤患者中，DOAC校准的肝素LRT试剂与抗Xa试剂检测阿哌沙班、艾多沙班和利伐沙班浓度具有良好一致性，可作为快速替代方法。
  • Electrogram Determinants of Acute Electrogram Attenuation During Pulmonary Vein Pulsed Field Ablation.
    J Cardiovasc Electrophysiol · 2026-10-06
    基线双极振幅和峰值频率与肺静脉脉冲场消融中急性电图衰减独立相关，联合应用可分层预测衰减程度。
  • Enhancing Persistent Atrial Fibrillation Ablation: The Added Value of Vein of Marshall Ethanol Infusion in a Tailored Strategy.
    J Cardiovasc Electrophysiol · 2026-10-06
    在持续性房颤患者中，基于低电压区（LVA）指导的个体化消融策略（含Marshall静脉乙醇灌注）较单纯肺静脉隔离（PVI）显著降低1年房性心律失常复发风险（13.5% vs 30.5%，p=0.02）。
  • Impact of Ganglionated Plexus Ablation on Early Recurrence After Thoracoscopic Atrial Fibrillation Ablation: A Post Hoc Analysis of the AFACT Study.
    J Cardiovasc Electrophysiol · 2026-10-06
    在晚期房颤胸腔镜消融中，辅助GP消融未减少早期复发率，但使首次早期复发时间推迟，且GP消融组早期复发与晚期复发相关。
  • Temporal Association Between Intrathoracic Impedance and Tachyarrhythmia Occurrence.
    J Cardiovasc Electrophysiol · 2026-10-06
    在植入心脏设备的患者中，胸腔内阻抗下降与随后房颤发生存在时间关联，且在发作层面与室速更短时间相关。
  • Atrial Septal Defect Management Status and Long-Term Outcomes After Atrial Fibrillation Ablation: A Real-World Cohort Study.
    J Cardiovasc Electrophysiol · 2026-10-06
    在27675例首次房颤消融患者中，未修复的房间隔缺损（ASD）和外科修复与更高的房性心律失常复发风险相关，而经皮封堵则无此关联，且复发的时间模式因ASD管理状态而异。
  • Pulmonary Vein Isolation Alone Versus Adjunctive Ablation for Paroxysmal Atrial Fibrillation.
    J Cardiovasc Electrophysiol · 2026-10-06
    在真实世界中，27.2%的阵发性房颤患者首次消融时接受PVI+策略，倾向性匹配分析显示PVI+与更高的复发、重复消融、心脏电复律、AAD使用、非典型房扑及进展为持续性AF风险相关。
  • Predictors of Recurrence and Quality of Life After Cryoballoon Ablation in Atrial Fibrillation: Data From a Multicenter Taiwanese Registry With 24-Month Follow-Up.
    J Cardiovasc Electrophysiol · 2026-10-06
    台湾多中心注册研究显示，冷冻球囊消融治疗阵发性房颤12个月无复发率约90%，24个月降至62%，诊断至消融时间延长独立预测复发，34%患者生活质量VAS改善≥10分。
  • Pre-existing Atrial Fibrillation and Long-term Outcomes Following Total Knee Arthroplasty.
    J Knee Surg · 2026-10-06
    合并房颤的全膝关节置换患者10年内翻修风险持续升高约23%，主要归因于假体周围感染增加，而关节纤维化反而减少。
  • The modified APPLE score for predicting atrial fibrillation recurrence in patients with hypertension undergoing radiofrequency ablation
    Scientific Reports · 2026-10-06
    在380例合并高血压的房颤射频消融患者中，整合炎症与心脏结构指标的改良APPLE评分预测复发AUC达0.889，显著优于传统APPLE评分。
  • Patterns of heart rate variability in patients with atrial fibrillation and arterial hypertension according to the presence of type 2 diabetes mellitus
    Zaporozhye Medical Journal · 2026-10-06
    在房颤合并高血压患者中，合并2型糖尿病与更显著的总体心率变异性抑制、交感优势及夜间副交感活性降低相关，且血糖控制越差HRV异常越明显。
  • In a patient with atrial fibrillation on Sintrom treatment and INR in range, without heart failure, who is going to undergo a procedure for two implants, how should one proceed?
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-10-06
    对于服用Sintrom且INR达标、无心力衰竭、拟行双植入手术的房颤患者，摘要仅提出围术期应术前停用Sintrom、术后出血风险可控后恢复，未报告具体研究数据。
  • Post-Diagnosis Complications in Adults with Major Arrhythmia: Impact of Ambulatory Cardiac Monitoring
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-10-06
    动态心脏监测（ACM）与主要心律失常诊断后较少的住院和急诊就诊相关，但诊断率差异未转化为结局差异，且对心衰、心梗、卒中及心源性死亡的影响仍未明确。
  • Atrial Fibrillation in Patients With Pectus Excavatum: Clinical Characteristics, Management, and Outcomes.
    Pacing Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-05
    在11,578例漏斗胸患者中，11.3%合并房颤，以阵发性为主；接受Nuss手术者出血事件显著少于未手术者，但需更大样本验证。

室性心律失常（13）

  • Outcomes of Mitral Valve Intervention for Patients With Bileaflet Mitral Valve Prolapse and Preoperative Ventricular Arrhythmias.
    Am J Cardiol · 2026-10-06
    双叶二尖瓣脱垂合并室性心律失常患者接受二尖瓣手术安全，1年无室性心律失常复发率70%，复发与年龄、延迟手术及BMI、LVEF相关。
  • Multidimensional evaluation of generative AI chatbots for public consultation on sudden cardiac death: safety, accuracy, empathy, reliability, quality, and readability across six models
    BMC Public Health · 2026-10-06
    六款生成式AI聊天机器人对56个心脏性猝死相关公共咨询问题的回答总体安全且临床相关，但所有模型均存在潜在安全隐患，尤其在紧急升级、CPR/AED指导和恢复运动建议方面。
  • Prognostic Impact of Left Ventricular Apical Aneurysm Identified by Echocardiography in Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy　- A Multicenter Retrospective Study in Japan
    Circ J · 2026-10-06
    日本多中心回顾性队列显示，超声心动图识别的左室心尖部室壁瘤在肥厚型心肌病患者中占12.7%，与基线室性心律失常事件负担更高相关，但未增加全因或心血管死亡。
  • Trends in Hyperkalemia-Related Sudden Cardiac Death Among Older Adults in the United States, 1999-2020.
    Clin Cardiol · 2026-10-06
    1999-2020年美国高钾血症相关心脏性猝死年龄调整死亡率翻倍，2010年后显著上升，男性、黑人及南部中西部居民负担最重。
  • Persistent Supraventricular Tachycardia Following Central Venous Catheter Insertion: When Withdrawal of the Mechanical Stimulus Is Not Enough
    Cureus · 2026-10-06
    42岁射血分数降低心衰合并糖尿病酮症酸中毒患者，右颈内静脉置管后即刻出现约217次/分的窄QRS心动过速，撤除导丝与导管后仍持续，需药物处理而非等待自行终止。
  • Potassium-Increasing Regimens in Patients at High Risk of Ventricular Arrhythmias: A Prespecified Observational Analysis of the Randomized POTCAST Trial.
    Europace · 2026-10-06
    在POTCAST试验中，MRA、补钾或联合治疗均能提升血钾，且主要终点发生率均低于对照组，但三种方案间无显著差异。
  • The prevalence of Brugada syndrome in patients presenting to an emergency room in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-10-06
    沙特利雅得急诊1000例患者中Brugada综合征患病率为0.2%，Brugada心电图模式患病率为2.6%，提示该地区患病率较高。
  • Performance and Limitations of Multipolar Electrogram Mapping in Scar-Related Ventricular Tachycardia.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-06
    多极电图标测在瘢痕相关室速中能提高舒张期电位识别率（76% vs 46%），但检测LAVA/晚电位的敏感性低于双极LAM（80% vs 92%）。
  • Feasibility and Acute Hemodynamic Outcomes of S3 Functional Mapping During Scar-Related Ventricular Tachycardia Ablation.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-06
  • Multimodality Cardiovascular Imaging in the Evaluation of Cardiac Sarcoidosis.
    JACC Cardiovasc Imaging · 2026-10-06
    多模态心脏影像（CMR与PET）可提高心脏结节病的诊断、预后评估及治疗决策指导，但摘要未报告具体研究数据。
  • Association of Poor Adherence to Guideline-Directed Medical Treatment With Adverse Events Including Fatal Arrhythmia in Heart Failure With Reduced Ejection Fraction: A Nationwide Cohort Analysis
    Korean Circulation Journal · 2026-10-06
    在植入ICD或CRT-D进行一级预防的HFrEF患者中，GDMT依从性差与全因死亡和致命性室性心律失常复合终点风险增加独立相关，尤其在缺血性心衰中更显著。
  • A Hybrid Quantum-Classical Machine Learning Approach for Ventricular Fibrillation Detection Using Heart Rate Variability Features
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-10-06
    混合量子-经典SVM在室颤检测中较经典SVM敏感度提升至95.11%，但准确率与特异度无显著改善。
  • Sign concordance of the Lean RECD tick and Level-3 excess3 on pre-VF Holter recordings does not extend to the alarm time
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-10-06
    在10份以室颤终止的Holter记录中，Lean RECD指标ΔT的变化方向与excess3在8/10记录中一致，但报警时间一致性仅6/10且提前时间均不吻合。

器械治疗（6）

  • Seizure Like Activity During Permanent Pacemaker Implantation: A Case of Suspected Venous Air Embolism With Acute Hypoxia
    Clin Case Rep · 2026-10-06
    78岁男性永久起搏器植入术中发生疑似静脉空气栓塞，表现为癫痫样活动和严重低氧血症，经高流量吸氧及暂停操作后完全恢复。
  • Case Report: Double-click on the ventricle: ventricular safety pacing triggered by right atrial lead dislodgement in a patient after right atrial tumor resection.
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-10-06
    44岁女性右心房肿瘤切除重建后植入双腔起搏器，随访发现心房导线脱位至右心室，心电图表现为心室安全起搏，重新程控为VVI模式后无症状。
  • Consensus-Recommended Follow-Up Mediates Cardiovascular Outcomes Disparities Between Implantable Cardioverter Defibrillator and Pacemaker Recipients.
    J Cardiovasc Electrophysiol · 2026-10-06
    在ICD与起搏器受者中，ICD患者共识推荐的随访依从性更低，其超额MACE风险有53.5%由随访依从性介导。
  • Deletion of the sodium leak channel NALCN in dopamine neurons alters D2R-mediated signalling and psychostimulant responsiveness.
    J Physiol · 2026-10-06
    多巴胺神经元选择性敲除NALCN通道降低其起搏活动，但不影响基础多巴胺水平，而增强对精神兴奋剂的反应。
  • Safety of bioelectrical impedance analysis in patients with cardiac implantable electronic devices: A systematic review.
    JPEN J Parenter Enteral Nutr · 2026-10-06
    系统综述纳入8项研究、866次生物电阻抗分析测量，未发现对心脏植入式电子设备功能产生电磁干扰或不良事件。
  • Device-Sparing Posteroseptal Trans-Tricuspid Lead Implantation After Tricuspid TEER: A Three-Case Device Rounds Report.
    Pacing Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-05
    三例T-TEER术后患者采用后间隔残余孔道成功植入右室导线，随访6-12个月三尖瓣反流轻至微量，无导线-瓣叶或装置交互。

遗传与基础（4）

  • Risk stratification in early non-ischaemic cardiomyopathy: the interplay of genetics and cardiac imaging
    Frontiers in Cardiovascular Medicine · 2026-10-06
    综述指出，早期非缺血性心肌病仅凭LVEF难以评估心律失常风险，整合CMR-LGE与基因型分型可推动更个性化的猝死预防策略。
  • Sex-related phenotypic differences in myotonic dystrophy types 1 and 2: a nationwide registry study from Serbia
    J Neurol · 2026-10-06
    塞尔维亚全国注册研究显示，强直性肌营养不良1型和2型存在性别相关表型差异：DM1男性神经肌肉受累更重，DM2女性近端下肢无力和呼吸功能下降更明显，而男性在兩型中心脏和代谢负担更重。
  • Impact of aging on catecholaminergic ventricular arrhythmia and cardiac transcriptome of cardiac calsequestrin null mice
    Journal of Molecular and Cellular Cardiology Plus · 2026-10-06
    衰老加重Casq2缺失小鼠的CPVT表型，triadin年龄依赖性变化与表型严重度相关，转录组分析揭示583个基因表达受基因型影响。
  • Risk Factors Predicting Atrial High-Rate Episodes in Patients Without Prior Atrial Fibrillation Undergoing Cardiac Implantable Electronic Device Implantation Based on Biomarkers and Genetic Study
    Korean Circulation Journal · 2026-10-06

其他（3）

  • Optimized LSTM-Based Method for Arrhythmia Detection from ECG Signals Using Crow Search Algorithm}
    Boletim da Sociedade Paranaense de Matemática · 2026-10-06
    本研究提出一种结合信号预处理、多域特征提取与CSA优化LSTM的心律失常检测框架，在ECG信号分类中达到99.8%的准确率。
  • Contemporary use of oesophageal temperature probes during left atrial ablation: results from an EHRA Scientific Initiatives Committee survey.
    Europace · 2026-10-06
  • Tafamidis: is it truly a game changer for transthyretin amyloid cardiomyopathy?
    Indian Pacing Electrophysiol J · 2026-10-06
    本综述指出，tafamidis 是首个获批的 ATTR-CM 疾病修饰治疗，可降低全因死亡并延缓功能与生活质量恶化，但受限于费用高、晚期疗效差及对已沉积淀粉样物质清除有限。

item.title: 2026-10-05 心脏电生理日报（45 篇）
item.description:
共 45 篇。在日报页面阅读完整解读 →

房颤与消融（25）

  • Anesthetic management for pulsed field ablation in a patient with Eisenmenger syndrome using general anesthesia with spontaneous ventilation: a case report
    BMC Anesthesiology · 2026-10-05
    一例48岁Eisenmenger综合征合并药物难治性房扑/房颤患者，在喉罩全麻保留自主呼吸下成功完成脉冲场消融，术中血流动力学稳定，但术后20天死于进行性心衰和多器官功能衰竭。
  • Trends and disparities in mortality involving aortic stenosis and atrial fibrillation among United States adults aged ≥ 55 years: a 26-year CDC WONDER analysis (1999–2024)
    BMC Cardiovascular Disorders · 2026-10-05
    1999至2024年美国≥55岁成人中主动脉瓣狭窄合并房颤的年龄调整死亡率增长超过三倍，存在持续的人口学和地理差异。
  • When a Lung Collapses: A Case of Polymicrobial Empyema Presenting as Massive Hydropneumothorax.
    Cureus · 2026-10-05
    一例70余岁男性因误吸致多微生物脓胸并巨大液气胸、右肺完全塌陷，住院期间发生快速心室率房扑及无脉性室速，经引流、抗生素及多学科救治后存活出院。
  • Measuring a moving target: analytic considerations for atrial fibrillation density
    Eur Heart J · 2026-10-05
  • Atrial fibrillation density and stroke risk: a promising advance that now needs predictive validation
    Eur Heart J · 2026-10-05
  • LAA occluder device impeding pulsed field ablation of an anterior mitral line: a case report about the role of a dual energy source
    Eur Heart J Case Rep · 2026-10-05
    一例植入左心耳封堵器的持续性房颤患者，在redo消融中脉冲场消融因阻抗无效反复中止，改用双能量导管射频能量完成二尖瓣前线性消融并实现双向阻滞。
  • Percutaneous Left Atrial Appendage Closure: The CHAMPION-like vs CLOSURE-like Patient Phenotype Framework.
    Europace · 2026-10-05
    LAAC的疗效取决于患者表型而非单纯装置性能，CHAMPION-like患者（生理储备好、预期寿命长）可获长期净获益，而CLOSURE-like患者（衰弱、高竞争风险）获益有限。
  • Efficacy, safety, and strategy-modifying factors of pulsed field ablation for persistent and long-standing persistent atrial fibrillation: a systematic review and meta-analysis
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-10-05
    在持续性和长程持续性房颤中，PFA较冷冻球囊消融可能降低12个月房性心律失常复发风险（RR 0.71），但证据确定性极低，仅为初步信号。
  • Single versus double transseptal puncture for atrial fibrillation radiofrequency ablation: a systematic review and meta-analysis
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-10-05
    单次房间隔穿刺与双次穿刺在房颤射频消融中3个月窦性心律维持率、透视时间和并发症发生率相似，但单次穿刺手术时间显著延长。
  • Case Report: Angiography-guided transvenous single-chamber pacemaker implantation in mirror-image dextrocardia with congenitally corrected transposition of the great arteries
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-10-05
    一例镜像右位心合并先天性矫正型大动脉转位的61岁男性，经右腋静脉在静脉造影与心房造影引导下成功植入单腔起搏器，术后1年随访起搏稳定、无并发症。
  • Maintenance of atrial fibrillation by reciprocal triggering of competitive focal sources: a hypothesis
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-10-05
    该假说提出，房颤的维持可能源于多个竞争性局灶源（DAD活动）的相互触发，这解释了房颤的时空周期性和Cox-Maze及肺静脉隔离的成功。
  • One-year outcomes in patients with persistent atrial fibrillation using CARTOFINDER mapping with OCTARAY: a Shinshu-AB registry study.
    Indian Pacing Electrophysiol J · 2026-10-05
    在持续性房颤患者中，与BOX隔离相比，CARTOFINDER引导的导管消融手术时间更短且1年房颤复发率更低。
  • Molecular phenotyping of atrial remodeling in atrial fibrillation using 18F-FDG and 18F-FAPI PET.
    Int J Cardiovasc Imaging · 2026-10-05
    在房颤患者中，18F-FDG与18F-FAPI PET显示心房摄取空间分布不同：FDG在左心耳摄取更常见，FAPI在左房前壁和顶部更常见，提示两种示踪剂反映互补的心房重构信息。
  • Colchicine for Prevention of Postoperative Atrial Fibrillation After Coronary Artery Bypass Grafting: Mechanisms, Evidence, and Clinical Implications.
    J Cardiothorac Vasc Anesth · 2026-10-05
    本综述指出，秋水仙碱作为抗炎药物可能通过抑制炎症通路降低CABG术后房颤（发生率16%-50%）风险，但证据主要来自相关临床试验分析，尚需进一步验证。
  • Systolic Blood Pressure Variability and Outcomes in Atrial Fibrillation: A Nationwide Population Study in Korea
    J Korean Med Sci · 2026-10-05
    在韩国房颤人群中，收缩压及其变异性均独立增加卒中、大出血和全因死亡风险，提示血压管理需兼顾达标与稳定。
  • CoBiDiff: Anatomy-aware bidirectional diffusion for left atrium cross-modal augmentation
    Measurement Science and Technology · 2026-10-05
    CoBiDiff框架通过解剖感知双向扩散实现左心房跨模态图像增强，在MM-WHS 2017数据集上CT到MR和MR到CT增强的Dice系数分别达86.53%和95.04%，平均对称表面距离分别为1.511 mm和0.623 mm。
  • Population Mortality Involving Co-Reported Intracerebral Hemorrhage and Atrial Fibrillation or Flutter in the United States, 1999-2025: Trends, Demographic Disparities, and Forecasts to 2040.
    Neuroepidemiology · 2026-10-05
    美国1999-2025年ICD死亡记录中合并报告ICH与AF的死亡共52,967例，年龄标化死亡率由0.4升至0.7/10万后趋稳，男性、黑人、非都市及西部南部负担更高，2040年前绝对负担将持续增长。
  • Antiplatelet or Anticoagulant Therapy in Cardiac Patients Undergoing Dental Procedures: A Systematic Review of Clinical Practice Guidelines and Consensus Recommendations
    Open Science Framework · 2026-10-05
    该系统评价拟比较心脏抗栓患者接受牙科操作时各指南在继续、中断、桥接抗栓治疗及INR阈值、DOAC时机上的推荐一致性，但摘要未报告任何检索结果或数据。
  • Management strategies for new-onset AF after cardiac surgery in patients with low ejection fraction: a scoping review
    Open Science Framework · 2026-10-05
    本范围综述计划系统梳理LVEF<40%患者心脏术后新发房颤的管理策略与证据，但尚未报告任何结果。
  • Atrial Fibrillation in Patients With Pectus Excavatum: Clinical Characteristics, Management, and Outcomes
    Pacing Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-05
    在11,578例漏斗胸患者中，11.3%合并房颤，以阵发性为主；接受Nuss手术者出血事件显著少于未手术者，但血栓栓塞率相似。
  • ACUTE ATRIAL FIBRILLATION: RATE CONTROL WITH BETA-BLOCKERS VERSUS RHYTHM CONTROL WITH ANTIARRHYTHMIC DRUGS
    Seven Editora eBooks · 2026-10-05
    急性房颤中，β受体阻滞剂控制心室率与抗心律失常药物节律控制各有适用场景，无普适优势，需个体化选择。
  • Comparative Cardiovascular Physiology in animals- From ECG and Echocardiography to Heart-Organ crosstalk
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-10-05
    综述比较动物心血管生理，强调ECG和超声心动图需考虑种属、年龄、体位和生理状态，避免误判病理。
  • Radiofrequency Catheter Ablation of Atrial Fibrillation in Patients with Anomalous Pulmonary Venous Return: A Multicenter Case Series
    medRxiv · 2026-10-05
    在最大APVR房颤消融队列中，急性成功率100%，但5年无复发率仅53.9%，术后患者非肺静脉基质更常见。
  • Potential effect of replacing sedentary behavior with physical activity on the risk of atrial fibrillation: results from the UK Biobank and REGARDS study
    medRxiv · 2026-10-05
    在UKB与REGARDS两个前瞻队列中，用MVPA替代30分钟久坐与AF风险轻度降低相关（REGARDS OR 0.80），但UKB完全校正后关联消失，证据不一致。
  • Conductive Hydrogels as a Medium for Shapeable Catheter Ablation Electrodes
    medRxiv · 2026-10-05
    在离体猪心模型中，可塑形导电水凝胶电极能产生宽大椭球形消融灶，并在心房-食管模型中降低食管温度、损伤深度及蒸汽爆裂风险。

室性心律失常（8）

  • Cardiac Deceleration Capacity Refines Sudden Cardiac Death Risk Stratification in Patients with Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy for Primary Prevention.
    Am J Med · 2026-10-05
    在肥厚型心肌病患者中，心率减速力独立预测心源性猝死风险，将其加入传统风险模型可显著改善风险区分度，尤其在中等风险亚组。
  • Prognostic Impact of Left Ventricular Apical Aneurysm Identified by Echocardiography in Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy ― A Multicenter Retrospective Study in Japan ―
    Circulation Journal · 2026-10-05
    日本多中心回顾性研究显示，超声心动图识别的左室心尖部室壁瘤在肥厚型心肌病患者中占12.7%，与基线心律失常事件负担增加相关，但不增加全因死亡和心血管死亡风险。
  • Potassium-Increasing Regimens in Patients at High Risk of Ventricular Arrhythmias: A Prespecified Observational Analysis of the Randomized POTCAST Trial
    Europace · 2026-10-05
    在POTCAST试验中，MRA、补钾或联合治疗均能提升血钾水平，且主要终点事件率均低于对照组，但三种方案间无统计学显著差异。
  • Artificial intelligence and remote monitoring of cardiac devices: A narrative review.
    Indian Pacing Electrophysiol J · 2026-10-05
    叙述性综述指出，AI可提升CIED远程监测的预警效率并预测室性心律失常、心衰事件与器械故障，但受数据质量、算法透明度和监管隐私限制，尚未广泛落地。
  • Cardiac warning symptoms in paediatric out-of-hospital ventricular fibrillation cardiac arrest survivors.
    Open Heart · 2026-10-05
    近半数儿童院外室颤心脏骤停幸存者在事件前有预警症状，但仅少数就医且无随访，提示诊断机会被遗漏。
  • Rhythm and conduction disorders in children with hypertrophic cardiomyopathy
    Rossiyskiy Vestnik Perinatologii i Pediatrii (Russian Bulletin of Perinatology and Pediatrics) · 2026-10-05
    儿童肥厚型心肌病中77%存在心律失常或传导障碍，病态窦房结综合征使致命性心律失常风险增加5倍，室性早搏≥10/24h即与非持续性室速相关。
  • Synergism of metabolic disorders: Diabetes mellitus and obesity as key determinants of sudden cardiac death risk
    Therapy · 2026-10-05
  • Comparison of the Effects of Diazepam, Acepromazine and Xylazine as Preanesthetic Agents in Preventing Cardiac Arrhythmias in Sheep Under General Anesthesia with Ketamine
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-10-05
    在氯胺酮麻醉绵羊中，地西泮、乙酰丙嗪与赛拉嗪三种麻醉前用药均未能可靠预防肾上腺素诱发的室性心律失常。

器械治疗（6）

  • Risk Stratification for Pericardial Effusion After Leadless Pacemaker Implantation - Multicenter Study.
    Circ J · 2026-10-05
    日本多中心回顾性研究显示，原有风险评分可对Micra无导线起搏器植入后心包积液进行风险分层，但改良风险评分（mRS）区分度更佳，高、中、低危组发生率分别为26.9%、16.5%和8.8%。
  • Mycobacterium smegmatis Infection in a Cardiovascular Implantable Electronic Device in an Immunocompetent Patient.
    Cureus · 2026-10-05
    一例免疫功能正常老年患者在起搏器植入并多次导线复位后发生M. smegmatis囊袋感染与菌血症，经完全移除装置、植入无导线起搏器及药敏指导的多药抗感染治疗后痊愈。
  • Advances in left bundle branch area pacing: current evidence, clinical applications, and future perspectives
    Expert Rev Cardiovasc Ther · 2026-10-05
    左束支区域起搏（LBBAP）在观察性研究和荟萃分析中优于双心室起搏，但6项随机试验结果不一致；结局与是否确认夺获传导系统关系更密切，而非随机分组。
  • Feasibility and Safety of Transthoracic Echocardiography-Guided Transvenous Permanent Pacemaker Implantation Without Fluoroscopy.
    JACC Adv · 2026-10-05
    在经胸超声心动图（TTE）引导下无透视植入永久起搏器，31例中30例成功（96.8%），无急性重大并发症，但需大样本验证。
  • Device-Sparing Posteroseptal Trans-Tricuspid Lead Implantation After Tricuspid TEER: A Three-Case Device Rounds Report
    Pacing Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-05
    三例三尖瓣TEER术后患者采用后间隔路径成功植入起搏器或ICD导线，随访6-12个月三尖瓣反流轻微且无导线相关并发症。
  • Contemporary Advances of Leadless Pacing and Conduction System Pacing in Children With Congenital Heart Disease.
    Pacing Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-04
    综述指出无导线起搏与传导系统起搏可克服儿童及先天性心脏病患者传统起搏的导线故障和静脉闭塞等局限，但需按年龄和体型个体化选择。

遗传与基础（2）

  • The cardiac calcium handling machinery is remodeled in Friedreich ataxia.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-10-05
    Friedreich共济失调患者及FXN敲除小鼠心脏钙处理蛋白下调、线粒体钙调控异常，伴收缩功能减退和电重构。
  • A striking lipid phenotype: A case of homozygous familial hypercholesterolemia
    Journal of Association of Clinical Endocrinologist and Diabetologist of Bangladesh · 2026-10-05
    9岁近亲婚配家庭儿童因多发黄色瘤和角膜弓就诊，基因检测证实LDL受体突变，确诊纯合子家族性高胆固醇血症，强化他汀联合依折麦布后LDL-C降幅有限。

其他（4）

  • LifeRhythms: The continuous commitment of the European Heart Rhythm Association in the field of arrhythmias and electrophysiology.
    Europace · 2026-10-05
  • Psychosocial Vulnerability and Immediate Emotional Triggers Preceding Sudden Cardiac Arrest
    JACC Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-05
  • PoPEA: an energy and latency-optimized proof-of-processing framework for trusted end–edge–cloud healthcare analytics
    SINERGI · 2026-10-05
    PoPEA-BC 在真实 ECG 与 SpO2 异常检测负载上实现可验证的端-边-云分析，额外延迟<8%、能耗较仅 TEE 基线降低最多 24%，并可抵御拜占庭边缘节点。
  • Few-Shot Prototype Head Adaptation for On-Device ECG Personalization on PSoC~6
    arXiv (Cornell University) · 2026-10-05
    在PSoC 6微控制器上，采用原型头自适应对1-D CNN进行设备端个性化，仅需1/5/10个支持样本即可将患者间宏F1从约0.64提升至0.73/0.77/0.80，且计算开销极低。

item.title: 2026-10-04 心脏电生理日报（26 篇）
item.description:
共 26 篇。在日报页面阅读完整解读 →

房颤与消融（9）

  • Left Atrial Appendage Occlusion Among Cancer Patients With Atrial Fibrillation: A Systematic Review and Updated Meta-Analysis.
    Am J Cardiol · 2026-10-04
    在房颤合并癌症患者中，左心耳封堵术后长期全因死亡率显著高于无癌症患者（HR 1.64），但卒中与出血风险无显著差异。
  • Epicardial Connection as a Resource of Atrial Fibrillation Recurrence After Pulsed Field Ablation: A Case Report.
    Clin Case Rep · 2026-10-04
    一例左共肺静脉房颤患者脉冲场消融后复发，证实心外膜连接是罕见但重要的复发机制，提示首次消融需消融嵴部并评估心外膜传导。
  • Measuring a moving target: analytic considerations for atrial fibrillation density.
    Eur Heart J · 2026-10-04
  • Atrial fibrillation density and stroke risk: a promising advance that now needs predictive validation.
    Eur Heart J · 2026-10-04
  • Coronary Sinus Electrogram Changes After Cavotricuspid Isthmus Ablation for Typical Atrial Flutter: What Is the Mechanism?
    J Arrhythm · 2026-10-04
    典型心房扑动经三尖瓣峡部消融终止后，冠状窦心房电图出现改变，本文探讨其电生理机制。
  • First experience of zero-fluoro pulsed field ablation for atrial fibrillation: step-by-step. A case report
    Russian Journal of Cardiology · 2026-10-04
    首例ICE引导下零射线脉冲场消融治疗阵发性房颤成功，无三维标测系统，术后电解剖标测证实肺静脉隔离。
  • Relationship between soluble suppression of tumorigenicity 2 and arrhythmias and mortality risk in patients receiving maintenance hemodialysis
    Russian Journal of Cardiology · 2026-10-04
    在维持性血液透析患者中，sST2≥35 ng/mL可强效预测全因和心血管死亡，并与房颤及室上性早搏负荷相关。
  • berkant82/diltiazem-in-atrial-fibrillation-with-rapid-ventricular-response_R_scripts: DiltiazemR_scripts
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-10-04
    该摘要为R代码仓库说明，未报告原始研究结果，无法给出地尔硫䓬不同给药方案治疗房颤伴快速心室率的疗效结论。
  • Prevalence, Incidence, and Impact of Cancer in Atrial Fibrillation: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of 70,000,000 Patients.
    Health Sci Rep · 2026-10-03
    在房颤患者中癌症患病率约11%，发病率172.22/万人年，癌症与全因死亡风险增加83%和出血风险增加62%相关。

室性心律失常（3）

  • PREVENTING EXERCISE-RELATED SUDDEN CARDIAC DEATH THROUGH SYSTEMATIC PREPARTICIPATION CARDIOVASCULAR SCREENING: A TWO-YEAR REGIONAL COHORT STUDY OF PEDIATRIC ATHLETES IN ADJARA, GEORGIA.
    Georgian Med News · 2026-10-04
    在格鲁吉亚阿扎尔地区647名5-17岁竞技运动员中，结构化赛前心血管筛查检出11.3%的心血管异常，其中0.62%为高危情况（肥厚型心肌病1例、显著传导障碍3例），均无症状，需每162人筛查才能发现1例高危。
  • Predictive value of pre-procedural QTc interval for in-hospital major adverse cardiovascular events following primary percutaneous coronary intervention in acute myocardial infarction.
    Front Med (Lausanne) · 2026-10-03
    在急性心肌梗死直接PCI患者中，术前QTc延长与院内MACE相关，但校正传统危险因素后并非独立预测因子，增量预测价值有限。
  • The coronary sinus: A clinical perspective for the electrophysiologist.
    Indian Pacing Electrophysiol J · 2026-10-03
    综述阐述冠状窦及其Marshall结构的胚胎解剖与电生理特性，及其在房性心律失常、AVNRT、心外膜旁路和部分室性心律失常标测消融中的作用。

器械治疗（8）

  • Advances in left bundle branch area pacing: current evidence, clinical applications, and future perspectives.
    Expert Rev Cardiovasc Ther · 2026-10-04
    左束支区域起搏（LBBAP）在观察性研究和荟萃分析中优于双心室起搏（BVP），但六项随机试验结果不一，从劣效到大幅降低死亡或心衰住院不等；结局与确认的传导系统夺获更相关，但尚未证实。
  • Cardiac Resynchronization as an Enabler of ARNI Efficacy: Insights From a Real-World Cohort.
    J Arrhythm · 2026-10-04
    在真实世界CRT队列中，联合ARNI治疗可增强左室逆重构并减少远程监测发现的心衰事件，提示器械与药物存在协同作用。
  • Functional Mitral Regurgitation Trajectories in CRT-Treated HFrEF During Medical Therapy Optimization: Association with Reverse Remodeling
    J Clin Med · 2026-10-04
    在接受CRT的HFrEF患者中，加用沙库巴曲/缬沙坦后62%出现功能性二尖瓣反流改善，且与左室逆重构（LVEF提升、LVEDV和LAV缩小）相关。
  • Contemporary Advances of Leadless Pacing and Conduction System Pacing in Children With Congenital Heart Disease
    Pacing Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-04
    综述指出无导线起搏与传导系统起搏可克服儿童及先天性心脏病患者传统起搏的导线故障和静脉闭塞等局限，但需按年龄和体型个体化选择。
  • Idioventricular Rhythm: Electrophysiological Mechanisms, Clinical Recognition, and Contemporary Management Perspectives
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-10-04
    特发性室性心律是高位起搏点失败时出现的缓慢规则室性心律，多数无症状且预后良好，治疗应针对病因而非抑制心律。
  • Effect of a structured nurse-led empowerment protocol on knowledge, practical skills, and self-care behaviours among patients with permanent pacemakers: a quasi-experimental study.
    BMC Nurs · 2026-10-03
    在埃及新植入永久起搏器的成人中，护士主导的结构化赋能方案较常规护理显著改善知识、操作技能和自我护理行为，效应量大且部分维持至1个月，但非随机设计限制因果推断。
  • The C-reactive protein-albumin-lymphocyte index is associated with ventricular functional improvement and long-term outcomes after cardiac resynchronization therapy.
    Front Nutr · 2026-10-03
    基线CALLY指数每翻倍，CRT术后MACE风险降低25%，LVEF改善增加0.95个百分点，提示其可作为预后评估的补充指标。
  • Algorithm-Facilitated Pacemaker-Mediated Tachycardia Mimicking Refractory Septic Shock.
    JACC Case Rep · 2026-10-03
    62岁双腔起搏器患者因AV滞后算法与PVARP短于VA传导间期，引发约109次/分的慢速起搏器介导性心动过速，被误诊为脓毒性休克，调整起搏参数后终止。

心力衰竭与代谢（1）

  • Alcoholic Cardiomyopathy Mortality in the United States (1999-2024): Trends, Disparities, and Opportunities for Prevention
    Cureus · 2026-10-04
    1999-2024年美国酒精性心肌病年龄标化死亡率仅下降27.7%，降幅小于其他主要心肌病亚型，且男性、美国印第安/阿拉斯加原住民及阿拉斯加州负担最高。

遗传与基础（2）

  • Catecholaminergic polymorphic ventricular tachycardia with diagnostic difficulty differentiating seizures from syncope: a case report.
    Front Pediatr · 2026-10-03
    6岁女孩因运动或情绪诱发的短暂意识丧失被误诊为癫痫，最终通过运动试验诱发双向室速及RYR2基因突变确诊CPVT，提示儿童癫痫样发作需警惕遗传性心律失常。
  • Metabolomic biomarkers and metabolic remodelling in genetically characterised hypertrophic cardiomyopathy: a systematic review.
    Metabolomics · 2026-10-03
    系统综述14项研究共1511例基因特征明确的肥厚型心肌病患者，未发现基因型特异性代谢特征，代谢重塑与表型严重程度相关而非致病基因变异。

其他（3）

  • AI-ECG potassium to triage haemolysed hyperkalaemia: analysis code
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-10-04
    该研究提供基于心电图深度学习估计血钾的分析代码，用于区分溶血性假性高钾血症与真性高钾血症，模型在HEEDB开发并在MIMIC-IV外部验证。
  • Clinical relevance of lead-induced tricuspid regurgitation after transvenous ICD implantation in arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy.
    Europace · 2026-10-03
  • Delayed structural myocardial injury after stereotactic arrhythmia radioablation: A serial CMR study in a porcine model.
    Europace · 2026-10-03

item.title: 2026-10-03 心脏电生理日报（19 篇）
item.description:
共 19 篇。在日报页面阅读完整解读 →

房颤与消融（7）

  • A rhythm-adaptive subspace k-NN for reliable atrial fibrillation detection from short single-lead ECG recordings
    Biomedical Signal Processing and Control · 2026-10-03
    RASK框架在30秒单导联ECG上检测房颤准确率达99.1%，敏感度99.6%，特异度98.4%，为短时程记录提供节律自适应分类方法。
  • Coronary Sinus Electrogram Changes After Cavotricuspid Isthmus Ablation for Typical Atrial Flutter: What Is the Mechanism?
    J Arrhythm · 2026-10-03
    典型心房扑动患者行三尖瓣峡部消融后，冠状窦心房电图出现改变，摘要探讨其机制但未报告具体数据。
  • Hemodynamic and Metabolic Predictors of Unsuccessful Electrical Cardioversion or Early Atrial Fibrillation Recurrence After Electrical Cardioversion
    J Clin Med · 2026-10-03
    在持续性房颤患者中，电复律后30天内45.7%未能恢复或维持窦性心律，T2DM和较高的TFC是独立预测因素，而高血压与较低风险相关。
  • Machine Learning Integration of Ablation Quality Metrics for Predicting Atrial Fibrillation Recurrence: A Multicenter Study
    JACC Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-10-03
    多中心研究显示，整合消融质量指标的XGBoost模型可有效预测房颤消融术后1年复发，外部验证AUC达0.951-0.992。
  • Primary Non-Adherence and Associated Factors in Patients with Atrial Fibrillation in Germany: A Retrospective Cohort Study
    Journal of Cardiovascular Development and Disease · 2026-10-03
    德国房颤患者口服抗凝药首次处方30天内未取药率约10.6%，VKA最高（14.4%），直接Xa因子抑制剂较低（10.1%）。
  • Atrial Fibrillation During Pregnancy Without Structural Heart Disease: A 24-Year Single-Center Experience and PRISMA-IPD Systematic Review
    Open Science Framework · 2026-10-03
    妊娠期无结构性心脏病房颤以个案及单中心24年队列汇总，多数患者经节律控制后母婴结局良好。
  • [Atrial fibrillation screening-reading the P-wave].
    Inn Med (Heidelb) · 2026-10-02
    综述指出，窦性心律心电图上的P波参数和AI模型可识别房颤风险表型，用于风险适配地筛选延长节律监测人群，但不能诊断房颤或单独作为治疗指征。

室性心律失常（2）

  • X-Ray Endovascular Treatment of Left Main Coronary Artery Disease: Literature Review
    Creative Surgery and Oncology · 2026-10-03
    本文综述了左主干冠状动脉疾病（LMCAD）的X线血管内治疗进展，指出经皮冠状动脉介入治疗（PCI）正逐渐取代冠状动脉旁路移植术（CABG）成为血运重建选择，并强调了血管内成像和支架技术对安全性的支持。
  • The coronary sinus: A clinical perspective for the electrophysiologist
    Indian Pacing Electrophysiol J · 2026-10-03
    综述阐述冠状窦及其Marshall结构的胚胎解剖与电生理特性，及其在房性心律失常、AVNRT、心外膜旁路和部分室性心律失常标测消融中的作用。

器械治疗（6）

  • Effect of a structured nurse-led empowerment protocol on knowledge, practical skills, and self-care behaviours among patients with permanent pacemakers: a quasi-experimental study
    BMC Nurs · 2026-10-03
    在埃及新植入永久起搏器的成人中，护士主导的结构化赋能方案较常规护理显著改善知识、操作技能和自我护理行为，效应量大且部分维持至1个月，但非随机设计限制因果推断。
  • Predictors of Favourable Response to Cardiac Resynchronization Therapy in Patients with Heart Failure with Reduced Ejection Fraction: A Narrative Review
    Biomedicines · 2026-10-03
    典型LBBB和QRS≥150ms是CRT反应的最佳基线预测因子，女性、非缺血性病因等影响获益程度但不作为排除标准，多模态评估结合机械失同步与间隔存活可优化患者选择。
  • Risk Stratification for Pericardial Effusion After Leadless Pacemaker Implantation　- Multicenter Study
    Circ J · 2026-10-03
    日本多中心研究显示，原有风险评分可用于Micra无导线起搏器术后心包积液风险分层，但改良评分区分度更佳（高危组发生率26.9% vs 低危组8.8%，P<0.001）。
  • Cardiac Resynchronization as an Enabler of ARNI Efficacy: Insights From a Real-World Cohort
    J Arrhythm · 2026-10-03
    在真实世界CRT队列中，ARNI治疗与更显著的心脏逆重构相关，并减少器械远程监测发现的亚临床心衰事件，提示CRT与ARNI存在协同作用。
  • Algorithm-Facilitated Pacemaker-Mediated Tachycardia Mimicking Refractory Septic Shock
    JACC Case Rep · 2026-10-03
    62岁双腔起搏器患者因AV滞后功能与PVARP短于VA传导间期，出现频率约109次/分的慢速起搏器介导性心动过速，被误诊为脓毒性休克，关闭滞后并延长PVARP后终止。
  • Digital technologies and adaptive pacing for exercise rehabilitation in cardiac implantable electronic device recipients: a scoping review
    Open Science Framework · 2026-10-03
    本范围综述旨在系统梳理数字技术与自适应起搏在CIED患者运动康复中的应用类型、临床功能及报告结局，并识别技术信息向康复决策转化的证据缺口。

遗传与基础（2）

  • Metabolomic biomarkers and metabolic remodelling in genetically characterised hypertrophic cardiomyopathy: a systematic review
    Metabolomics · 2026-10-03
    系统综述14项研究1511例遗传学特征明确的HCM患者，未发现基因型特异性代谢特征，代谢重塑与表型严重程度相关。
