  • Generation of a human induced pluripotent stem cell line (ZZUNEUi040-A) from a male patient with hypertrophic cardiomyopathy carrying a heterozygous TPM1 (c.644C > T) mutation
    Stem Cell Res · 2026-10-03
    成功建立携带TPM1 c.644C>T突变的肥厚型心肌病患者来源的iPSC系ZZUNEUi040-A，该系核型正常、多能性标志物表达正常且具三胚层分化潜能，为HCM机制研究和药物筛选提供模型。

其他（2）

  • Delayed structural myocardial injury after stereotactic arrhythmia radioablation: A serial CMR study in a porcine model
    Europace · 2026-10-03
  • Clinical relevance of lead-induced tricuspid regurgitation after transvenous ICD implantation in arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy
    Europace · 2026-10-03

item.title: 2026-10-02 心脏电生理日报（64 篇）
item.description:
共 64 篇。在日报页面阅读完整解读 →

房颤与消融（25）

  • The implantable cardioverter–defibrillator
    2026-10-02
    本文综述ICD自1980年首次植入以来的发展，重点阐述各厂商在室颤检测计数方案与SVT-VT鉴别编程上的技术差异及临床意义。

其他（2）

    Natural Resources for Human Health · 2026-10-02
    提出一种两阶段深度学习框架，利用GAN离线增强和知识蒸馏轻量CNN，实现可解释、可网页部署的ECG心律失常分类，但尚未报告实际评估结果。

    Neurology · 2026-10-01

    Open Science Framework · 2026-10-01

  • Desde la esteatosis al riesgo cardiorrenal
    Revista de la Sociedad Argentina de Diabetes · 2026-10-01

  • Left Atrial Appendage Occlusion Among Cancer Patients with Atrial Fibrillation: a systematic review and update meta-analysis
    The American Journal of Cardiology · 2026-10-01
  • New-Onset Atrial Fibrillation After Alcohol Septal Ablation Versus Surgical Myectomy in Obstructive Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy: A Propensity-Matched Analysis
    The American Journal of Cardiology · 2026-10-01

    Value in Health Regional Issues · 2026-10-01

  • What are the comparative efficacy rates of intravenous Amiodarone versus intravenous Procainamide in treating recent-onset atrial fibrillation?
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-10-01

  • Socioeconomic status, healthcare access, and risk of atrial fibrillation: an investigation using the Jackson Heart Study Research Materials.
    medRxiv · 2026-10-01

    Сибирский журнал клинической и экспериментальной медицины · 2026-10-01

房颤与消融（35）

  • Incident Atrial Fibrillation Following Anthracycline-Based Adjuvant Chemotherapy in Women with Breast Cancer: A Single-Centre Retrospective Cohort Study
    Biomedicines · 2026-09-30
    在II期三阴性乳腺癌女性中，含蒽环类的AC-T辅助化疗方案6个月内临床记录房颤发生率显著高于TC方案（18.8% vs 6.6%），且早期PR间期延长与房颤发生相关。
  • Beta-Blocker Management in Obstructive Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy Treated with Mavacamten: A Practical Approach.
    Cardiology · 2026-09-30
    在oHCM患者中启动mavacamten后，β受体阻滞剂不削弱其缓解梗阻和症状的效果，但可能因限速作用减弱运动耐量改善；建议仅对有特定指征者继续使用β受体阻滞剂。
  • Case Report: Radiological-Pathological Correlation of Ectopic Pancreatic Tissue as Anterior Mediastinal Mass.
    Case Rep Radiol · 2026-09-30
    49岁女性前纵隔异位胰腺组织表现为伴中心坏死的大肿块，引发新发房颤伴快速心室率及非持续性室速，经手术活检确诊。

    一例85岁持续性房颤患者，既往植入左心耳封堵器，在脉冲场消融（PFA）完成前壁二尖瓣线时因封堵器附近阻抗异常反复中止，改用双能量导管切换至射频消融后成功实现双向阻滞。
  • AKT question relating to atrial fibrillation management
    InnovAiT Education and inspiration for general practice · 2026-09-30
  • AKT question relating to management of atrial fibrillation
    InnovAiT Education and inspiration for general practice · 2026-09-30
  • AKT answer relating to atrial fibrillation management

  • AKT answer relating to management of atrial fibrillation
    InnovAiT Education and inspiration for general practice · 2026-09-30

  • Hybrid Ablation and Edge-to-Edge Repair for Atrial Fibrillation Induced Cardiomyopathy and Functional Mitral Regurgitation.

  • Rescue OTSC: salvage treatment for recurrent diverticular bleeding after failed conventional endoscopic hemostasis.

  • Integrated Inflammatory markers in the assessment of left atrial appendage thrombosis risk in patients with non-valvular atrial fibrillation

    在非瓣膜性房颤患者中，整合炎症标志物（CRP>6.8 mg/L、NLR>2.07、SII、PIV）对左心耳血栓或血栓前状态具有预测价值，其中NLR预测能力最佳（AUC=0.732）。
  • Pulsed Field Ablation of the Cavotricuspid Isthmus During Pulmonary Vein Isolation: Efficacy, Safety, and Procedure Duration
    Ukrainian journal of cardiovascular surgery · 2026-09-30
    在房颤肺静脉隔离同期行三尖瓣峡部脉冲场消融，全部实现双向阻滞且中位仅需6次放电，总手术时间较射频消融显著缩短（52 vs 72分钟，P<0.001），安全性良好。
  • A Clinical Case of Complex Treatment for Tachycardia-Induced Cardiomyopathy

  • Artificial Intelligence in Cardiology: Clinical Advantages and Perspectives. A Literature Review

  • MATHEMATICAL MODELING OF THYROID MORPHOMETRIC PARAMETERS IN PATIENTS WITH ATRIAL FIBRILLATION AND CONCURRENT EUTHYROIDISM OR THYROTOXICOSIS

    在房颤合并甲状腺功能异常患者中，基于甲状腺激素水平可构建多元线性回归模型预测甲状腺形态学参数。
  • Comparison of Heart Rate Variability After Treatment of Atrial Fibrillation with Radiofrequency Ablation and Pulsed Field Ablation

  • Explainable machine-learning models for 30-day outcomes after atrial fibrillation admission in Syria and Egypt

  • Analysis code and aggregate source data for: Acute laboratory deficit burden and subsequent ICU-documented atrial fibrillation or flutter in patients with sepsis: a temporally ordered cohort study

    该研究利用MIMIC-IV数据，发现脓毒症患者急性实验室指标缺陷负担与后续ICU记录的房颤/房扑风险独立相关。

    СИСТЕМНЫЙ АНАЛИЗ И УПРАВЛЕНИЕ В БИОМЕДИЦИНСКИХ СИСТЕМАХ · 2026-09-30

  • Homozygous TNNC1-A8V Causes Impaired Diastolic Function and Restrictive Cardiomyopathy in Children and Mice.
    Circ Genom Precis Med · 2026-09-30
    TNNC1-A8V纯合变异可致儿童早发限制型心肌病，小鼠模型重现严重舒张功能障碍与心室不同步，为精准治疗提供依据。
  • Fragmented QRS: Electrophysiological Bases, Pathophysiological Mechanisms, and Clinical Prognostic Significance
    Cukurova Anestezi ve Cerrahi Bilimler Dergisi · 2026-09-30
    碎裂QRS波与心肌瘢痕（尤其缺血性心肌病）强相关，可作为室性心律失常和心源性死亡的独立风险标志，但评估方法主观且缺乏标准化。
  • Cardiac Sarcoidosis: A Practical Guide for Cardiologists.
    Curr Cardiol Rep · 2026-09-30
    心脏结节病诊断依赖CMR与FDG-PET互补评估炎症与瘢痕，治疗以激素为主，ICD用于高危患者，但诊断标准与免疫抑制策略仍缺乏随机试验证据。
  • Small but lethal: cystic tumour of the atrioventricular node-a case report.
    Eur Heart J Case Rep · 2026-09-30
    47岁女性反复心悸，消融前影像发现Koch三角区囊性占位，手术切除确诊房室结囊性肿瘤，术后完全性房室传导阻滞需起搏器，1年无复发。
  • Case Report: Iatrogenic left main coronary artery dissection during premature ventricular contraction ablation managed with emergent coronary artery bypass grafting.
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-09-30
    60岁男性经逆行主动脉途径行室早消融后并发医源性左主干夹层，经IVUS评估和心脏团队决策后行急诊CABG，术后恢复良好但3个月随访LVEF降至25%-30%。
  • Predictive Value of the Electrical Risk Score for Ventricular Arrhythmias in Heart Failure Patients with Primary Prevention Implantable Cardioverter Defibrillators
    J Clin Med · 2026-09-30
    在91例心衰一级预防ICD患者中，基线电风险评分（ERS）≥3分与12个月内恰当ICD电击独立相关，AUC达0.882，优于多数传统心电图指标。
  • Analysis of Nonlinear Characteristics of Heart Rate for Predicting Sudden Cardiac Death
    Lecture notes in computer science · 2026-09-30
  • Fatal Refractory Hypokalemic Paralysis Secondary to Occupational Toluene Exposure: A Case Report
    Tunisian Journal of Emergency Medicine · 2026-09-30
    一例42岁木工因职业性甲苯暴露导致远端肾小管酸中毒，引发难治性低钾性瘫痪，最终死于恶性室性心律失常。
  • Asymptomatic High-Grade Atrioventricular Block in a Serviceman: A Case Report
    Ukrainian journal of cardiovascular surgery · 2026-09-30
    一名无症状军人常规体检发现严重心动过缓及高级别房室传导阻滞，植入双腔频率应答起搏器后心律稳定，提示无症状高级别AVB也可致严重风险。
  • Особенности ведения пациента с острым инфарктом миокарда, осложненным рецидивирующей фибрилляцией желудочков. Клинический случай
    СИСТЕМНЫЙ АНАЛИЗ И УПРАВЛЕНИЕ В БИОМЕДИЦИНСКИХ СИСТЕМАХ · 2026-09-30
    52岁STEMI合并心源性休克患者延迟血运重建后出现反复室颤，经多次除颤和综合管理，最终心功能恢复良好。

器械治疗（9）

  • PR INTERVAL ON RESTING ECG IN PATIENTS WITH MOBITZ-1 SECOND-DEGREE ATRIOVENTRICULAR BLOCK DETECTED ON AMBULATORY ECG MONITORING
    Art of Medicine · 2026-09-30
    在40例动态心电图记录到Mobitz-1型二度房室传导阻滞的患者中，45%静息心电图PR间期正常，提示静息PR间期不能排除间歇性Mobitz-1型房室传导阻滞。
  • Сontemporary prospects for the use of leadless cardiac pacemakers
    BULLETIN OF SURGERY OF KAZAKHSTAN · 2026-09-30
    无导线起搏器较传统经静脉起搏器显著降低并发症风险（90天约0.46%，1年约1.77%），起搏参数稳定，是心律失常器械治疗的重要发展方向。
  • The medial septum model as a pacemaker of theta rhythm: the key role of short-term synaptic plasticity
    Cogn Neurodyn · 2026-09-30
    计算模型表明，内侧隔核Teevra与Komal细胞间抑制性突触的短期突触抑制足以产生并稳定约150度反相的theta节律，无需内在起搏或外部节律输入。
  • A Prospective Study of Comparison of Left Ventricular Volumes and Function by 2D and 3D Transthoracic Echocardiography in Patients With Left Ventricular Systolic Dysfunction.
    Cureus · 2026-09-30
    在左室收缩功能不全患者中，3D超声心动图测得的LVEF显著低于2D，并将43.5%的2D中度功能不全患者重分类为重度，可能影响ICD或CRT决策。
  • DUAL-CHAMBER PACEMAKER IMPLANTATION THROUGH A PERSISTENT LEFT SUPERIOR VENA CAVA WITH ABSENT RIGHT SUPERIOR VENA CAVA: THE ALPHA-LOOP TECHNIQUE
    International Journal of Advanced Research · 2026-09-30
    在永存左上腔静脉合并右上腔静脉缺如的患者中，采用alpha-loop技术可成功完成双腔起搏器植入，急性起搏参数满意。
  • A 3-year chronic post-sternotomy sinus tract maintained by a migrating pacemaker wire
    Journal of Cardiology & Cardiovascular Surgery · 2026-09-30
    26岁男性机械二尖瓣置换术后胸骨正中切开处慢性窦道渗液3年，最终证实为临时心表起搏导线迁移至皮下组织所致，取出导线后伤口愈合。
  • Analisis Uji Kalibrasi Alat Kejut Jantung Menggunakan Defibrillator Analyzer
    Jurnal Teknologi Elektro · 2026-09-30
    五台除颤器经校准检测均合格，漏电流最高28.9 µA，能量偏差最大8.60%，充电时间4.26-6.48秒，均符合安全标准。
  • 5G Cloud-Enabled Telemedicine for Remote Management of Heart Failure Patients With Implantable Cardioverter-Defibrillators: A Multicenter Open-Label Randomized Controlled Trial.
    MedComm (2020) · 2026-09-30
    在植入ICD/CRT-D的心衰患者中，5G云平台远程随访较门诊随访显著缩短临床事件至干预时间（4.2 vs 11.5天，P<0.001），并改善12个月生活质量。
  • Clinical case: complete atrioventricular block in a young child
    Vestnik of North-Eastern Federal University Medical Sciences · 2026-09-30
    一例2岁11月龄幼儿因完全性房室传导阻滞伴心衰表现紧急入院，植入永久起搏器后随访两年，DDD模式起搏比例99%，左室射血分数70%，心腔无扩大。

心力衰竭与代谢（2）

  • Incremental Value of 24-Hour Ambulatory Electrocardiogram-Derived Heart Rate Variability in Machine-Learning Prognostic Models for Heart Failure.
    Int Heart J · 2026-09-30
    在353例心衰患者中，基于24小时动态心电图的心率变异性指标加入机器学习预后模型后，虽未显著提高AUC（0.77 vs 0.71，P=0.263），但改善了阈值分类性能和校准斜率（1.01 vs 0.73）。
  • Deep Learning for Automated Electrocardiogram Analysis: Real-Time Arrhythmia Classification Using 1D-CNN
    International Journal of Computer Science and Mobile Computing · 2026-09-30
    轻量级1D-CNN在MIT-BIH数据库上实现五类心律失常分类，总体准确率95.5%，对室上性、室性及融合搏动的宏平均敏感度分别为88.87%、92.05%和88.27%，推理延迟亚毫秒级，适用于可穿戴设备实时监测。

影像与标测（1）

  • Affordable and Efficient Anatomy Mapping for LBBAP in Dextrocardia With Complete Heart Block.
    Pacing Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-09-30
    一例77岁右位心合并完全性房室传导阻滞患者，通过简化解剖标测成像与改良导管技术成功实现选择性左束支起搏。

遗传与基础（19）

  • The Deubiquitinase UCHL1 Drives Susceptibility to Atrial Fibrillation by Stabilizing CaMKII-δ.
    Adv Sci (Weinh) · 2026-09-30
    去泛素化酶UCHL1通过稳定CaMKII-δ并增强RyR2磷酸化促进房颤易感性，抑制UCHL1可减少房颤诱发。
  • Clinical Benefit of the Transthyretin Stabiliser Tafamidis in Hereditary Transthyretin Amyloid Cardiomyopathy: A Case Report.
    Br J Hosp Med (Lond) · 2026-09-30
    一例携带p.Val40Ile突变的遗传性ATTR-CM患者，经tafamidis治疗两年内心衰住院显著减少、临床稳定。
  • Normal electrocardiography at presentation masks SCN5A-related long QT syndrome: the importance of Holter monitoring in children with a family history of Brugada syndrome.
    Cardiol Young · 2026-09-30
    10岁女孩静息及运动心电图均正常，因Brugada综合征家族史行Holter监测发现睡眠中QT显著延长，基因检测证实SCN5A p.Glu1783Lys变异，提示SCN5A相关长QT综合征。
  • Rare Cardiac Genetic Variation Is Associated With Postoperative Atrial Fibrillation.
    Circ Genom Precis Med · 2026-09-30
    在近5万例无术前房颤的手术患者中，携带心肌病相关致病/可能致病变异者术后30天新发房颤风险升高约1.8倍，且5年无房颤生存率更低。
  • Circadian control of dopaminergic signaling to the mushroom body regulates sleep through rhythmic Pka-C1 transcription in Drosophila.
    Curr Biol · 2026-09-30
    果蝇研究揭示昼夜节律通过LNds抑制PAM-γ5多巴胺能神经元、经Dop1R激活蘑菇体γ-KC，并由Onecut驱动Pka-C1转录节律，形成转录-神经活动反馈环促进日间觉醒。
  • Data from: Nox4 mediates diastolic function in a genetic model of Pitx2 haploinsufficiency
    DRYAD · 2026-09-30
    在Pitx2单倍剂量不足小鼠模型中，Ang II输注诱发更显著的HFpEF样重构，Nox4上调介导舒张功能障碍，抑制Nox4可部分改善结构及功能指标。
  • Diagnosis of familial hypercholesterolemia through population screening
    Expert Rev Cardiovasc Ther · 2026-09-30
    家族性高胆固醇血症患病率约1/300且可治疗，成人分层多标准筛查（可结合人工智能）具成本效益，儿童新生儿干血斑或学校分层筛查可行且可能更经济。
  • TFAM Lys76 2-hydroxyisobutyrylation modulates oxidative stress and energy metabolism via the TFAM-ROS-AMPK axis in postoperative atrial fibrillation.
    Free Radic Biol Med · 2026-09-30
    术后房颤患者心房中TFAM Lys76的2-羟基异丁酰化修饰增强，通过损害COX活性和ATP生成、增加mtROS并抑制AMPK磷酸化，导致线粒体能量-氧化还原失衡。
  • Reverse Cascade Genetic Screening for Revealing New Cases of Familial Hypercholesterolemia in Russia: Pilot Project.
    Front Biosci (Schol Ed) · 2026-09-30
    在俄罗斯圣彼得堡儿童血脂筛查后开展反向级联基因筛查，35个家庭中检出14例（40%）遗传性血脂异常，LDL-C>4.8 mmol/L可较准确识别致病变异携带者。
  • Temporal association between adjunctive repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation and seizure reduction in a pediatric patient with DNM1L-associated EMPF1: a case report
    Front Pediatr · 2026-09-30
    1例DNM1L相关EMPF1患儿在抗癫痫药物与代谢鸡尾酒治疗基础上加用1 Hz rTMS后，癫痫发作频率由约20次/日降至0-1次/日，但仅为时间关联，不能归因于rTMS。
  • A Pilot Study of the Hereditary Heart Disease Risk Algorithm and User Experience of the Family Health Risk Calculator.
    Genet Med · 2026-09-30
    FHRC遗传性心脏病风险评估算法与心血管遗传咨询师评估一致性达94%，用户可用性高，但需优化家族史知识不足等障碍。
  • Complication management in hypertrophic cardiomyopathy.
    Heart Fail Rev · 2026-09-30
    肥厚型心肌病是动态异质性疾病连续谱，需基于多模态影像、基因检测和家系筛查进行表型驱动的个体化诊疗，心肌肌球蛋白抑制剂等靶向治疗凸显精准分型的重要性。
  • Atrial standstill: From molecular genetics to clinical management-A narrative review.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-09-30
    心房静止是弥漫性心房肌病变导致心房电与机械活动完全消失，易误诊为AF，血栓栓塞发生率达30%-54%，需永久起搏与抗凝并基因分层评估ICD。
  • Familial Hypercholesterolemia in Latin America: Unmet Needs, Barriers, and Challenges.
    J Lipid Atheroscler · 2026-09-30
    拉丁美洲FH患者超200万，但诊断率低、LDL-C达标率差，以他汀单药治疗为主，亟需加强登记、基因检测与级联筛查。
  • Navigating Heart Failure and Atrial Fibrillation Therapy in MELAS
    JACC Case Rep · 2026-09-30
    一例54岁MELAS女性合并快速心室率房颤、左心耳血栓及左室收缩功能新发下降，经多学科谨慎滴定常规心衰与控率治疗、抗凝后成功复律，左室收缩功能恢复。
  • Spontaneous Coronary Artery Dissection and Saw-Tooth Cardiomyopathy: A Novel Dual Diagnosis
    JACC Case Rep · 2026-09-30
    25岁男性急性SCAD合并罕见锯齿状心肌病，多模态影像区分急性缺血与基础结构病变，虽规范药物治疗仍遗留严重左室收缩功能障碍。
  • Fever-Induced Brugada Phenocopy: A Case Report
    Journal of Emergency Medicine Case Reports · 2026-09-30
    83岁男性发热后出现1型Brugada样心电图，退热后完全消失，提示发热诱发的Brugada拟表型，无需植入ICD。
  • Prediction of New-Onset Atrial Fibrillation in Patients with Acute Myocardial Infarction: A Machine Learning Approach
    Medical Sciences · 2026-09-30
    在150例急性心肌梗死患者中，机器学习模型预测新发房颤的ROC-AUC达0.991，E/e'、左室质量指数等为关键预测因子。
  • Miocardiopatía arritmogénica del ventrículo izquierdo por desmoplaquina. Presentación de un caso
    Revista de la Federación Argentina de Cardiología · 2026-09-30
    本文报告一例无症状的左心室致心律失常性心肌病，检出桥粒斑蛋白基因变异，并分析其风险分层与心脏性猝死一级预防的现有证据。

其他（3）

  • Occult Neoplasms in Sudden Unexpected Death in Infancy: A Scoping Review of Post-Mortem Findings
    Diagnostics (Basel) · 2026-09-30
    范围综述纳入25项研究32例婴儿猝死病例，尸检发现此前未诊断的肿瘤，其中半数被判定为死亡的直接原因。
  • A Prediction Score for Cardiovascular Implantable Electronic Device Infection in Non-Staphylococcus aureus Bacteremia.
    Pacing Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-09-30
    在非金黄色葡萄球菌菌血症的CIED患者中，21%发生明确装置感染，基于菌种类别、持续性菌血症、培养阳性时间和不明来源的四变量评分模型预测效能优异（AUC 0.940），但需外部验证。
  • Same-Day Discharge After Cardiac Device Generator Replacement: Safety and Patient Acceptability
    Pacing Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-09-30
    多中心回顾性研究显示，起搏器/ICD发生器更换后当日出院安全可行，365天装置相关感染率与常规住院无差异（1.9% vs 2.5%），患者接受度高。

item.title: 2026-09-29 心脏电生理日报（66 篇）
item.description:
共 66 篇。在日报页面阅读完整解读 →

房颤与消融（37）

  • Twelve-month mortality and associated factors among older adults with non-valvular atrial fibrillation admitted to a geriatric short-stay unit in Guadeloupe: the FAGU cohort
    Aging Clinical and Experimental Research · 2026-09-29
    在瓜德罗普老年短住病房住院的220例高龄非瓣膜性房颤患者中，12个月全因死亡率高达55.9%，营养不良、日常生活能力下降和多病共存是独立相关因素。
  • Decreases in Left Atrial Strain With Mavacamten Therapy and Associations With Atrial Fibrillation.
    Am J Cardiol · 2026-09-29
    在65例梗阻性肥厚型心肌病患者中，玛伐凯泰治疗24周后左房应变三项指标均显著恶化，且左房应变可预测房颤发生。
  • Dapagliflozin Among Patients Undergoing Atrial Fibrillation Ablation and Recurrent Arrhythmia: A Reconstructed Time-To-Event and Bayesian Meta-analysis.
    Am J Ther · 2026-09-29
  • Case Report: Radiological-Pathological Correlation of Ectopic Pancreatic Tissue as Anterior Mediastinal Mass
    Case Rep Radiol · 2026-09-29
    49岁女性因胸痛、新发房颤伴快速心室率及非持续性室速就诊，发现前纵隔大肿块，经手术活检证实为异位胰腺组织，属极罕见病例。
  • Atrial Fibrillation Ablation Effectiveness End Points, Safety End Points, and Trial Design: Academic Research Consortium Initiative Endorsed by the Heart Rhythm Society.
    Circ Arrhythm Electrophysiol · 2026-09-29
    AFA-ARC国际倡议提出房颤消融关键临床试验的修订版有效性、安全性终点及试验设计与报告表，以支持监管决策。
  • Optimal duration of anticoagulation after successful catheter ablation for atrial fibrillation: insights from recent randomized trials
    Commun Med (Lond) · 2026-09-29
    ALONE-AF和OCEAN试验提示，房颤消融成功后对无复发且卒中风险中低危患者可考虑个体化停用口服抗凝，但现有证据因事件率低而把握度不足。
  • Severe Hypercapnia and Hemodynamic Instability During Carbon Dioxide Insufflation During Robot-Assisted Thoracic Surgery
    Cureus · 2026-09-29
    68岁肥胖男性在机器人辅助胸腔镜手术中因CO2充气建立人工气胸出现严重高碳酸血症（PaCO2 110 mmHg）并诱发房颤和低血压，停止充气后37分钟内高碳酸血症改善。
  • Oxidative Stress and Postoperative Atrial Fibrillation: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
    Curr Probl Cardiol · 2026-09-29
    心脏术后房颤患者心房组织氧化应激标志物显著升高，而术前血液标志物无统计学关联，提示采样部位影响关联强度。
  • Antithrombotic Therapy in Patients with Chronic Coronary Disease on Anticoagulation: Evidence from Contemporary Trials
    Curr Vasc Pharmacol · 2026-09-29
    对于合并房颤等需长期抗凝的慢性冠脉病患者，PCI术后6-12个月后或稳定型未血运重建者，全剂量口服抗凝药单药治疗在缺血事件上不劣于联合抗血小板治疗，且显著减少出血。
  • THE EFFECT OF HIGH INTENSITY INTERVAL TRAINING AFTER CATHETER ABLATION OF ATRIAL FIBRILLATION: SYSTEMATIC REVIEW
    Egyptian Journal of Physical Therapy and Rehabilitation · 2026-09-29
  • Association of the EHRA/HRS/APHRS/LHRS definition of atrial cardiomyopathy with incident atrial fibrillation, heart failure, and stroke.
    Europace · 2026-09-29
  • Unintended right atrial lesions after monopolar biphasic lattice-tip pulsed-field ablation: a case series
    European Heart Journal - Case Reports · 2026-09-29
    单极双相 lattice-tip 脉冲场消融行肺静脉隔离后，4 例患者出现累及右房后壁、房间隔或上腔静脉的意外右房损伤。
  • Prevalence and associated factors of frailty in hospitalized elderly patients with heart failure.
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-09-29
    住院老年心衰患者衰弱患病率高达78.5%，其中82.1%为轻中度衰弱；共病、营养状况差、躯体功能受损和LVEF降低与衰弱严重程度独立相关。
  • GDF-15 and arrhythmogenesis: From cardiac stress signaling to risk stratification
    Gene Reports · 2026-09-29
    GDF-15与房颤心房纤维化及结构重构相关，可独立预测房颤复发和血栓栓塞事件，并提升ABC-AF风险评分，但检测方法不一致和观察性证据限制其常规临床应用。
  • New-Onset Atrial Fibrillation (NOAF) in Critically Ill Non-Cardiac ICU Patients: Incidence, Risk Factors, and Outcome Impact
    International Journal of Drug Delivery Technology · 2026-09-29
    非心脏ICU危重患者新发房颤发生率约15%，与脓毒症、APACHE II评分及机械通气独立相关，并显著增加住院死亡率。
  • SurpSAM : Saliency‐ and Uncertainty‐Guided Reinforcement Prompting for Automatic Left Atrial Segmentation
    International Journal of Imaging Systems and Technology · 2026-09-29
    SurpSAM在仅一个标注样本下实现左心房CT分割，MM-WHS和ImageCAS-STACOM数据集Dice分别为76.55%和83.53%，优于现有单样本分割方法。
  • Temporal Association Between Exercise and Arrhythmia Episodes in Endurance Athletes With Paroxysmal Atrial Fibrillation.
    J Am Heart Assoc · 2026-09-29
    在47例耐力运动员阵发性房颤患者中，植入式心电监测显示运动期间及运动后即刻房颤事件率并未高于非运动相关时段，提示运动并非房颤发作的即时触发因素。
  • Echocardiographic Left Atrial Volumetric-mechanical Coupling Index for Prediction of Atrial Fibrillation after STEMI.
    J Am Soc Echocardiogr · 2026-09-29
    在STEMI患者中，基于LAVI与a'速度计算的新指标LACI-vm可独立预测出院后新发房颤，AUC达0.857，并改善风险分层。
  • Thromboembolic and Mortality Risk in Patients with Postoperative Atrial Fibrillation After Coronary Artery Bypass Graft—The TRIP-AF Study
    J Clin Med · 2026-09-29
    孤立CABG术后约1/3患者发生术后房颤，其与全因死亡和非致死性卒中的复合终点相关，但多因素校正后并非独立预测因子，房颤复发和CHA2DS2-VASc评分才是长期预后的关键。
  • Perceived Social Support in Atrial Fibrillation Care: Implications for Nurse-Led Education and Follow-Up.
    J Clin Nurs · 2026-09-29
    芬兰房颤患者感知社会支持总体偏低且不均衡，消融治疗与支持较低相关，而计划随访与较高情感支持相关。
  • Identifying the electrically unstable NSTEMI patient: Comparative performance of four scores for short-term risk stratification of major cardiac arrhythmias
    J Electrocardiol · 2026-09-29
    在485例NSTEMI患者中，11.3%发生主要心律失常，整合心衰、AKI、RBBB和血钠的模型预测心律失常的AUC为0.733，优于传统ACS评分，而GRACE 2.0对院内死亡预测最稳定。
  • First Latin American retrospective registry of cardiac ablation in pediatric and congenital heart disease patients. A LAHRS registry.
    J Interv Card Electrophysiol · 2026-09-29
    拉丁美洲首个儿童及先天性心脏病患者导管消融回顾性注册研究显示，1778例手术急性成功率93%，并发症率1.8%，复发率8.5%，证实消融在该人群安全有效。
  • Efficacy and Safety of Novel Oral Anticoagulants in Elderly Patients with Non-Valvular Atrial Fibrillation: A Retrospective Cohort Study
    J Vis Exp · 2026-09-29
    在80岁及以上非瓣膜性房颤患者中，华法林与四种低剂量DOAC方案的6个月栓塞及ISTH出血事件均无显著差异，但近半数DOAC用药剂量低于说明书推荐。
  • Effects of Rhythm Control versus Rate Control on Atrial Fibrillation and Frailty Development in Older Patients: Protocol for the Cardioversion of Atrial Fibrillation and Frailty in the Elderly (CAFFE) Study, an Observational, Prospective Cohort Study.
    JMIR Res Protoc · 2026-09-29
    CAFFE研究方案旨在评估节律控制是否比心率控制更能延缓老年房颤患者衰弱与失能的进展，目前仍在入组中，结果预计2027年发布。
  • Evaluation of Clinical SYNTAX Score in Predicting New-Onset Atrial Fibrillation and Long-Term Prognosis in Patients Hospitalized with Non-ST Segment Elevation Myocardial Infarction
    Journal of Cardiovascular Development and Disease · 2026-09-29
    在979例NSTEMI患者中，临床SYNTAX评分（CSS）较解剖SYNTAX评分（SS）更好地预测院内新发房颤（AUC 0.724 vs 0.644）及长期死亡和MACE，CSS≥17.77提示高风险。
  • Transient changes in P-wave terminal force after electrical cardioversion of persistent atrial fibrillation
    Journal of Electrocardiology · 2026-09-29
    持续性房颤电复律后，P波终末电势在1个月时短暂增大，3个月恢复，不改变分类，与左房大小无关。
  • Semaglutide in Atrial Arrhythmias: State of the Art and Future Perspectives
    Journal of Personalized Medicine · 2026-09-29
    本综述指出，司美格鲁肽等GLP-1受体激动剂在血糖控制之外可能具有上游抗心律失常作用，有望成为房颤综合管理的新策略，但现有证据仍限于综述层面，尚缺乏硬终点RCT支持。
  • Hypertension, Atrial Fibrillation, and Orthostatic Hypotension in Older Adults: Blood Pressure Assessment and Treatment Decisions—A Narrative Review
    Medicina · 2026-09-29
    在合并高血压、房颤和体位性低血压的老年人中，血压评估需兼顾节律相关变异和体位性变化，体位性低血压不应自动导致降压治疗降阶，而应重新评估血压谱、症状和药物。
  • Evaluación morfométrica de la función biauricular en pacientes con fibrilación auricular revertidos a ritmo sinusal
    Multimed · 2026-09-29
    药物或电复律恢复窦性心律后，房颤患者双心房直径、左房面积及容积均无显著变化，双心房功能保持稳定。
  • Population Mortality Involving Co-Reported Intracerebral Hemorrhage and Atrial Fibrillation or Flutter in the United States, 1999–2025: Trends, Demographic Disparities, and Forecasts to 2040
    Neuroepidemiology · 2026-09-29
    1999-2025年美国ICH合并AF的年龄调整死亡率从0.4升至0.7/10万后趋稳，男性、黑人、非都市区及西部/南部负担更高，2040年绝对死亡数将增长。
  • Multiple Accessory Pathways in Children: Electrophysiological Features and Catheter Ablation Outcomes.
    Pacing Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-09-29
    儿童多旁路（MAPs）占旁路相关心律失常患儿的5.0%，急性消融成功率高（患者93.5%、旁路95.5%）且无并发症，但复发率19.4%，需系统术后复查与长期随访。
  • Long-Term Outcomes of AV Node Ablation Plus CRT Compared to AF Catheter Ablation in Patients With AF and HFrEF
    Pacing Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-09-29
    在HFrEF合并AF患者中，AVNA+CRT与AF消融相比，2年和5年全因死亡率均更高，2年心衰住院和心脏移植/LVAD植入也更多。
  • Pulmonary Vein Stenosis Following Radiofrequency Catheter Ablation Presenting With Massive Pleural Effusion: A Case Report
    Respirol Case Rep · 2026-09-29
    58岁女性房颤射频消融后5个月出现大量胸腔积液，3D-CT确诊左下肺静脉重度狭窄，球囊扩张后积液吸收。
  • Relationship between Positional Obstructive Sleep Apnea and Excessive Daytime Sleepiness in Patients with Atrial Fibrillation.
    Sleep Biol Rhythms · 2026-09-29
    在222例OSA患者中，体位性OSA（POSA）与日间过度嗜睡（EDS）呈负相关，且该关联因POSA定义和是否合并房颤而不同，房颤患者中cPOSA者EDS风险更低。
  • Wolff-Parkinson-White Pattern: Recognition of Ventricular Pre-Excitation and Risk Stratification
    Transformative Medicine · 2026-09-29
    一例45岁男性因意识改变入院，心电图偶然发现无症状性WPW模式，强调需区分WPW模式与综合征并进行风险分层。
  • Substrate-Dependent Pro- and Antiarrhythmic Action of Omecamtiv Mecarbil at the Ventricular and Atrial Level: Insights from a Langendorff-Perfused Rabbit Heart Model.
    Cardiovasc Toxicol · 2026-09-28
    在Langendorff灌流兔心中，omecamtiv mecarbil在心室水平缩短复极、增加离散度而致心律失常，在异丙肾上腺素/乙酰胆碱诱导的房颤模型中却抑制房颤，呈现基质依赖性电生理作用。
  • Gut microbiota-activated PLCγ2 monocytes drive atrial fibrillation.
    Nat Commun · 2026-09-28
    房颤患者单核细胞PLCγ2上调，肠道菌群通过膜囊泡激活Syk/PLCG2促进单核细胞心房募集并诱导内皮间质转化，驱动房颤。

室性心律失常（6）

  • Supraventricular Tachycardia Associated with Cardiac Hemangioma on the Anterior Mitral Valve Leaflet: A Case Report
    Asploro Journal of Biomedical and Clinical Case Reports · 2026-09-29
    65岁女性二尖瓣前叶血管瘤患者表现为窄QRS波心动过速，手术切除后心律失常完全消失且无复发。
  • Quantitative imaging analysis in hypertrophic cardiomyopathy: phenotypic differentiation to prognostic stratification.
    Eur Heart J Imaging Methods Pract · 2026-09-29
    影像组学可提取心肌纹理、形状和信号异质性等定量特征，在肥厚型心肌病的表型鉴别、无对比剂识别纤维化及预后预测方面展现潜力，但证据受限于回顾性小样本研究且缺乏外部验证。
  • Delayed cardiac conduction disease in a young adult following childhood Chagas infection.
    Ir Med J · 2026-09-29
    一名30余岁玻利维亚男性在儿童期未治疗克氏锥虫感染后数十年出现2:1房室传导阻滞，提示恰加斯心脏病可迟发传导异常。
  • Integration of an echocardiographic motion-management system into photon-based stereotactic arrhythmia radioablation planning
    Phys Imaging Radiat Oncol · 2026-09-29
    在光子立体定向心律失常放射消融计划中，将超声探头置于主束外（心尖或胸骨旁）可保护探头（D0.035cm³<1Gy），靶区剂量学无显著差异，但适形指数略降，胸骨旁位置略优。
  • Clinical readiness and methodological rigor of AI models for ventricular arrhythmia and sudden cardiac death prediction: A systematic review with PROBAST+AI appraisal.
    Rev Port Cardiol · 2026-09-29
    AI模型预测室性心律失常和心源性猝死呈现较高区分度，但方法学质量有限，54%研究存在高偏倚风险，临床转化受限。
  • Correction to: Electrocardiogram Signal Classification for Diagnosis Sudden Cardiac Death Using 2D CNN and LSTM
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-09-29
    原文因数据准备错误导致全部报告结果失效，包括2D-CNN诊断心脏性猝死96.67%的准确率，读者不应再引用其结论。

器械治疗（9）

  • The Regionalization of High-Volume Cardiac Pacing: A Prospective Cohort Study on Safety, Feasibility, and the Learning Curve in a Geriatric Population.
    Clin Cardiol · 2026-09-29
    在拉脱维亚地区医院，经结构化导师指导，高容量起搏器植入项目安全可行，学习曲线显示并发症率从8.7%降至3.4%，无死亡。
  • Subcutaneous and Extravascular Implantable Cardioverter-Defibrillators: A Clinical Framework for Breast Surgery, Pregnancy, Lactation, Radiation Therapy, and Breast Imaging.
    Europace · 2026-09-29
    针对接受皮下或血管外ICD的女性患者，本文提出涵盖乳房手术、妊娠、哺乳、放疗及乳腺影像的临床管理框架，强调个体化切口规划与多学科协作。
  • Leadless pacemaker in atrioventricular block patients with specific indications: a systematic review.
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-09-29
    在房室传导阻滞患者中，无导线起搏器与传统起搏器的不良事件风险无显著差异（RR=1.41，95%CI 0.43-4.60），单臂汇总并发症率较低。
  • Atrial leadless pacemaker implantation in the setting of an active infection.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-09-29
  • Leadless Atrial Pacemaker Implantation at a Nonstandard Site After Unsuccessful Conventional Atrial Placement.
    J Arrhythm · 2026-09-29
    常规右心耳起搏失败后，将心房无导线起搏器改植于高位右房间隔，6个月随访电学参数稳定。
  • 5G Cloud-Enabled Telemedicine for Remote Management of Heart Failure Patients With Implantable Cardioverter-Defibrillators: A Multicenter Open-Label Randomized Controlled Trial
    MedComm (2020) · 2026-09-29
    5G云远程管理ICD/CRT-D患者可显著缩短临床事件至干预时间（4.2 vs 11.5天，P<0.001），并改善12个月生活质量。
  • A compartmentalized SCN model explains temperature resistance through interregional phase differences.
    PLoS Comput Biol · 2026-09-29
    分区化SCN模型显示，背侧与腹侧SCN亚区间的内在相位异质性使整体相位净位移衰减，从而解释视交叉上核抵抗温度重置而外周钟可被温度倒相重置。
  • Lead-to-Vein Ratio and Long-Term Vascular Safety After Transvenous Pacing in Children Weighing ≤15 Kg.
    Pacing Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-09-29
    在体重≤15 kg儿童中，经静脉起搏后影像学静脉异常发生率为17%，多无症状，导线-静脉比值>0.55与风险增加相关。
  • Conduction system pacing versus biventricular pacing for cardiac resynchronization therapy: an updated systematic review and meta‑analysis
    Scientific Reports · 2026-09-29
    在CRT中，CSP较BiVP显著降低全因死亡或心衰住院风险（RR 0.47），改善QRS时限和NYHA分级，但LVEF和LVESV改善仅见于特定亚组（严格LBBP和His-CRT）。

心力衰竭与代谢（2）

  • Incremental Value of 24-Hour Ambulatory Electrocardiogram–Derived Heart Rate Variability in Machine-Learning Prognostic Models for Heart Failure
    International Heart Journal · 2026-09-29
    在353例心衰患者中，基于24小时动态心电图的心率变异性指标加入机器学习预后模型后，AUC未显著提高，但阈值分类性能与校准斜率更优。
  • Challenges in Identifying Heart Failure Diagnoses from the Electronic Health Record.
    J Card Fail Intersect · 2026-09-29
    8名临床医生复核528份病历验证心衰诊断，双人复核部分一致性仅中等（κ=0.62），主要障碍在于通用定义难以套用真实世界数据及EHR互操作性与可用性不足。

影像与标测（2）

  • Biventricular Arrhythmogenic Cardiomyopathy: Diagnostic Insights from Cardiovascular Magnetic Resonance.
    CASE (Phila) · 2026-09-29
    本文为影像与标测教学病例：双心室致心律失常性心肌病（ACM）可表现为胸痛，对出现室性心律失常者应怀疑ACM，CMR在诊断与危险分层中起关键作用。
  • Affordable and Efficient Anatomy Mapping for LBBAP in Dextrocardia With Complete Heart Block
    Pacing Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-09-29
    一例77岁右位心合并完全性房室传导阻滞女性患者，采用简化解剖标测成像与改良导管技术成功实现选择性左束支起搏。

遗传与基础（6）

  • The Deubiquitinase UCHL1 Drives Susceptibility to Atrial Fibrillation by Stabilizing CaMKII-δ
    Adv Sci (Weinh) · 2026-09-29
    去泛素化酶UCHL1通过稳定CaMKII-δ增强RyR2磷酸化与钙处理异常，驱动房颤易感性；抑制UCHL1可减少房颤诱发。
  • Associations between Atrial Fibrillation and Bone Mineral Density at Different Sites: A Mendelian Randomization Study
    Current Science · 2026-09-29
    孟德尔随机化研究显示，股骨颈和桡骨骨密度升高与房颤风险增加存在因果关联，而全身骨密度无显著影响。
  • Electrolyte disturbances after allogeneic hematopoietic cell transplantation in patients receiving calcineurin inhibitors: incidence and severity.
    Front Pharmacol · 2026-09-29
    异基因造血干细胞移植后接受钙调磷酸酶抑制剂的患者电解质紊乱极为常见，低钙血症86.6%、低镁血症85.6%、低钠血症75.7%、低钾血症62.6%，多为轻中度但可相互关联。
  • PITX2 missense coding variant expression in mice reveals direct function in atrial fibrillation.
    J Clin Invest · 2026-09-29
    小鼠Pitx2Pro41Ser变异导致起搏诱发AF近完全外显，AAV递送Pitx2可逆转AF易感性，揭示PITX2功能缺失直接致AF。
  • Macrophage Immunometabolism in Epicardial Adipose Tissue and Obesity-Related Atrial Fibrillation.
    J Inflamm Res · 2026-09-29
    肥胖相关AF中，EAT巨噬细胞的免疫代谢重编程通过mTOR-HIF-1α、NLRP3等通路促进心房纤维化与电重构，靶向该过程或可阻断AF基质形成。
  • Neurocardiac crosstalk in inherited cardiac arrhythmias and cardiomyopathy.
    J Physiol · 2026-09-29
    遗传性心律失常与心肌病中，自主神经系统功能障碍与心肌细胞病变共同参与疾病表达，影响不完全外显和表型变异，为风险分层和治疗提供新方向。

其他（4）

  • Assumption-bounded reduced electro-thermal modeling of lesion formation in radiofrequency cardiac ablation: power-time allocation, thermal latency, perfusion, and temperature limitation.
    Comput Methods Biomech Biomed Engin · 2026-09-29
    二维电热模型显示，等能量下不同射频消融方案峰值温度不同，温度限制器可降低功率，灌注效应排序稳定，但损伤轮廓存在回流敏感性，模型仅支持方案筛选。
  • An interpretable multi-scale hybrid attention network (MSHAN) for explainable ECG arrhythmia classification.
    Front Artif Intell · 2026-09-29
    MSHAN可解释深度学习模型在MIT-BIH心律失常数据库的跨患者测试集上实现96.25%总体准确率、平均AUC 0.980，SHAP可视化有助于心内科医生理解模型决策。
  • Extracted and coded characteristics of 55 studies on explainable AI for ECG-based arrhythmia detection
    Mendeley Data · 2026-09-29
    该数据集编码了55项可解释AI用于心电图心律失常检测的研究特征，但摘要未报告任何临床或统计结果。
  • A Prediction Score for Cardiovascular Implantable Electronic Device Infection in Non-Staphylococcus aureus Bacteremia
    Pacing Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-09-29
    在非金黄色葡萄球菌菌血症的CIED患者中，21%发生明确装置感染，四变量预测评分（GPC菌血症、持续性菌血症、较长阳性时间、不明感染源）区分度优异（AUC 0.940），但需外部验证。

item.title: 2026-09-28 心脏电生理日报（62 篇）
item.description:
共 62 篇。在日报页面阅读完整解读 →

房颤与消融（27）

  • Explainable machine learning model based on cardiac CT angiography for predicting functional improvement after atrial fibrillation ablation: a multicenter study
    BMC Medical Imaging · 2026-09-28
    基于心脏CT血管造影形态学与放射组学特征构建的可解释机器学习模型，在预测房颤合并心衰患者消融后功能改善方面表现良好，多中心验证AUC达0.803-0.845。
  • Point-of-care ultrasound for left ventricular function in patients with atrial fibrillation in the emergency department.
    CJEM · 2026-09-28
    在急诊快速房颤/房扑患者中，仅38%接受了POCUS左室功能评估；急诊医生与心脏科医生判断严重左室功能减低的一致性仅为fair（κ=0.34），而急诊POCUS专家为moderate（κ=0.63）。
  • Substrate-Dependent Pro- and Antiarrhythmic Action of Omecamtiv Mecarbil at the Ventricular and Atrial Level: Insights from a Langendorff-Perfused Rabbit Heart Model
    Cardiovasc Toxicol · 2026-09-28
    在Langendorff灌流兔心中，omecamtiv mecarbil在心室水平缩短APD90和QT间期、增加复极离散度和室性心律失常，在健康心房促AF，但在IsoACh诱导的AF模型中抑制AF，呈现基质依赖性电生理作用。
  • Atrial Fibrillation in Tribal and Non-tribal Populations: A Comparative Analysis From Eastern India
    Cureus · 2026-09-28
    印度东部部落房颤患者首诊房颤比例更高、心室率更快、左室射血分数更低，而非部落患者心代谢紊乱和血栓栓塞风险更高。
  • Non-alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease/Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease and the Risk of Incident Atrial Fibrillation: An Updated Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Cohort Studies
    Cureus · 2026-09-28
    在超过1500万人的18项队列研究中，NAFLD/MASLD与房颤发生风险轻度增加相关（RR 1.23），但异质性极高。
  • Echocardiographic Framework for Left Atrial Appendage Morphology Assessment and Thromboembolic Risk Stratification in Atrial Fibrillation
    Diagnostics (Basel) · 2026-09-28
    基于深度学习框架分析房颤患者左心耳形态，形态分类准确率91-94%，血栓检测AUC 0.935，菜花型和仙人掌型血栓栓塞风险最高。
  • Exploratory Signal Detection of Arrhythmia Reports for Empagliflozin, Sitagliptin, and Linagliptin in the Korea Adverse Event Reporting System
    Drug Targets and Therapeutics · 2026-09-28
    韩国不良事件报告系统分析显示，恩格列净、西格列汀和利格列汀在房颤、房扑和室颤方面均未出现阳性报告信号。
  • Trends in the incidence of atrial fibrillation and the prescription of oral anticoagulants in adults with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease in UK primary care (2010–2022): a cohort study
    EClinicalMedicine · 2026-09-28
    英国COPD患者房颤发病率从2010年13.8/1000人年升至2022年19.3/1000人年，但仅66.3%在诊断后一年内启动口服抗凝，严重COPD及非白人患者使用率更低。
  • Cardiometabolic therapy for rhythm control: a case report of refractory atrial fibrillation resolving after initiation of semaglutide for obesity
    Eur Heart J Case Rep · 2026-09-28
    一例肥胖合并持续性房颤、四次PVI后仍反复发作的患者，在启动司美格鲁肽减重后房颤发作即刻停止且随访未复发。
  • γ-Butyrobetaine, L-Carnitine and Acylcarnitines and their association with incident atrial fibrillation among men and women with suspected chronic coronary syndrome
    European Heart Journal Open · 2026-09-28
    在疑似慢性冠脉综合征患者中，血清γBB、L-肉碱和棕榈酰肉碱水平升高与房颤新发风险增加相关，且女性中关联更强。
  • Supplemental Material for: Population Mortality Involving Co-Reported Intracerebral Hemorrhage and Atrial Fibrillation or Flutter in the United States, 1999–2025: Trends, Demographic Disparities, and Forecasts to 2040
    Figshare · 2026-09-28
    1999-2025年美国ICD-10共报告脑出血与房颤/房扑的死亡人数为52,967例，年龄调整死亡率从0.4升至2021年的0.7/10万后趋稳，存在性别、种族和地理差异，预测至2040年基本稳定。
  • Development of an efficient deep learning model for arrhythmia detection from consumer smartwatches
    Front Artif Intell · 2026-09-28
    在Pulsewatch试验的真实智能手表PPG+加速度数据中，随机森林对NSR、AF、PAC/PVC三分类的总体准确率最高（91.22%），CNN-BiLSTM对心律失常类的敏感性最高（宏召回87.37%）。
  • Attenuating cardiac sympathetic tone via cryoneurolytic stellate ganglion ablation.
    Heart Rhythm · 2026-09-28
    在猪模型中，星状神经节冷冻神经消融可持久减弱心脏交感反应至少1个月，且效应局限于消融部位，提示其可能成为难治性室性心律失常的中等时长交感调控疗法。
  • Direct atrial fibrillation termination during pulsed field ablation: Association with intracardiac cycle length.
    Indian Pacing Electrophysiol J · 2026-09-28
    在持续性房颤患者接受脉冲场消融肺静脉隔离时，19.4%出现直接房颤终止，且终止组上肺静脉（尤其右上肺静脉）的心内心动过速周期长度显著延长。
  • Transient changes in P-wave terminal force after electrical cardioversion of persistent atrial fibrillation
    J Electrocardiol · 2026-09-28
    持续性房颤电复律后，V1导联P波终末力（PWTFV1）在1个月时出现短暂性增大，3个月恢复基线，但变化幅度小且不改变分类，与左房大小无关。
  • Effects of Dual-Energy Lattice-Tip Catheter Ablation of Ventricular Arrhythmias on Cardiac Implantable Electronic Device Performance
    JACC Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-09-28
    Sphere-9双能量网格头导管行室性心律失常消融后，右室导线感知、阻抗及阈值出现小幅但持续变化，左室导线起搏阻抗降低，严重CIED交互罕见。
  • Acute Regional Atrial Metabolic Inflexibility in Atrial Fibrillation: Evidence From Human Vein of Marshall Arteriovenous Samplings
    JACC Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-09-28
  • Temporal dynamics of left atrial reverse remodeling predicts atrial fibrillation ablation outcome: A 3-year longitudinal study
    Journal of Geriatric Cardiology : JGC · 2026-09-28
  • Medication Errors Associated with Direct Oral Anticoagulant Therapy: A Systematic Review
    MAHESA Malahayati Health Student Journal · 2026-09-28
    系统综述显示DOAC用药错误常见，处方剂量不当（过高、过低或不依从）最常见，部分研究中超过30%患者接受不适当剂量，利伐沙班和阿哌沙班最常涉及。
  • Exercise blood-pressure responses for atrial fibrillation risk stratification: a systematic review
    Open Science Framework · 2026-09-28
    本系统综述纳入17项研究，旨在评估运动血压反应（异常升高、钝化、延迟恢复及负荷指数化指标）与房颤发生或复发风险的关系，但摘要未报告具体效应量。
  • Multiple Accessory Pathways in Children: Electrophysiological Features and Catheter Ablation Outcomes
    Pacing Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-09-28
    儿童多旁路患者占旁路相关心律失常消融病例的5.0%，急性成功率93.5%、无并发症，但复发率19.4%，需系统术后再评估与长期随访。
  • Medication Adherence Patterns for Patients with Atrial Fibrillation: A Mixed Methods Study to Understand Patient and Clinician Perspectives.
    Patient Prefer Adherence · 2026-09-28
    在非瓣膜性房颤口服抗凝患者中，31.5%报告不依从，医患均认为加强沟通与共同决策是改善依从性的关键。
  • Left atrial appendage isolation and thrombotic and thromboembolic outcomes in atrial fibrillation: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
    Thromb Res · 2026-09-28
    左心耳电隔离（LAAI）可能与临床卒中或TIA累积风险升高相关（RR=4.96），但预测区间极宽且敏感性分析不稳定，证据确定性低。
  • Spatiotemporal Organization of Atrial Fibrillation via EGM and ECG: A Meta-Analysis
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-09-28
    本研究通过心内电图与体表心电图分析，发现心房颤动复发百分比与体表样本熵呈显著负相关（r=-0.38，P<0.001），提示无创监测可辅助消融靶点定位。
  • Evaluation of a Hybrid RR–P-Wave Approach for Automatic Atrial Fibrillation Detection in ECG Signals
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-09-28
    在86条PhysioNet心电记录中，RR间期法总体性能优于加入P波形态与RR突变检测的混合法，后者虽将房颤检出敏感度从80.0%提至83.3%，但精确率由77.4%降至64.1%，配对检验未见显著差异。
  • Proposal of an Automated System for the Langendorff Isolated Heart Perfusion Method
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-09-28
    自动化Langendorff离体心脏灌流平台在台架验证中稳定了流体温度（中位数37°C，IQR 0.10°C）和冠脉流量（中位数23.5 mL/min），温度控制显著优于手动方法（p=4.15×10⁻⁷）。
  • Fibrosis burden and spatial pattern affect left atrial appendage stasis in multi-beat multi-physics simulations
    bioRxiv (Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory) · 2026-09-28
    在共同左心房解剖的多搏动多物理模拟中，纤维化负荷主要决定整体左心房血流动力学，而左心耳淤滞还取决于纤维化的空间分布。

室性心律失常（15）

  • Cardiac segmentation for ventricular tachycardia radioablation and radiotherapy patients with cardiac implants
    ArXiv · 2026-09-28
    在ICD患者及接受VT-SBRT的患者中，补充ICD图像训练的分割模型能改善心脏亚结构分割，且不显著降低无ICD患者的性能。
  • Trends in pediatric sudden cardiac death-related mortality in the United States from 1999 to 2020: a nationwide CDC WONDER analysis
    Archives of Medical Science - Atherosclerotic Diseases · 2026-09-28
    美国1999-2020年0-14岁儿童SCD相关死亡率从2.8/10万降至2.0/10万，但性别、种族、地区和城乡差异持续存在。
  • Complete Heart Block in Young Patient With Systemic Lupus Erythematosus: A Case Report
    Cureus · 2026-09-28
    33岁女性SLE患者被诊断为无症状性完全性心脏传导阻滞，提示SLE患者需基线心电图筛查以发现可能致猝死的沉默性传导障碍。
  • Increased Premature Ventricular Contraction Burden During Exercise Stress Testing with Surgical Face Masks: A Retrospective Cohort Study
    Gaziantep Islam Science and Technology University · 2026-09-28
    运动负荷试验中佩戴外科口罩与室性早搏负荷增加相关（0.91% vs 0.52%，P<0.001），71%患者负荷增加，44%增加>0.3%。
  • Challenges in pregnancy of a patient with cardiac sarcoidosis on implantable cardioverter defibrillator: a case report
    International Journal of Reproduction Contraception Obstetrics and Gynecology · 2026-09-28
    一例24岁孕产妇合并心脏结节病并植入ICD，经多学科管理后孕36周安全分娩活女婴。
  • Delayed cardiac conduction disease in a young adult following childhood Chagas infection
    Ir Med J · 2026-09-28
    一名30余岁玻利维亚男性，儿童期未治疗克氏锥虫感染，数十年后出现间歇性二度房室阻滞，提示恰加斯心脏病可迟发传导异常。
  • Four Distinct Morphologies of Bundle Branch Reentrant Ventricular Tachycardia Eliminated by Right Bundle Branch Ablation
    JACC Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-09-28
  • Endocardial 'point-by-point' pulse field ablation as a 'bailout' strategy for recurrent ventricular tachycardia originating from a left ventricular aneurysm leading to electrical storm.
    Kardiol Pol · 2026-09-28
  • Development of a prospective clinical workflow for proton beam therapy of ventricular tachycardia.
    Strahlenther Onkol · 2026-09-28
    本研究建立质子束治疗难治性室性心动过速的前瞻性临床前工作流程，涵盖电解剖标测到CT靶区转移、治疗计划及光束门控，技术可行但需临床验证。
  • Association Between Earthquake Exposure and Tachyarrhythmias: A Systematic Review
    The International Journal of Medical Science and Health Research · 2026-09-28
    地震暴露可能与快速性心律失常事件增多相关，但不同人群、结局定义及震后时间窗的结果不一致，现有证据有限且异质性大。
  • Integrating High-Resolution Electrophysiological Mapping with Histological Remodeling in a Rabbit Model of Ventricular Tachycardia
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-09-28
    在兔室速模型中，高分辨电生理标测与组织学重构空间不一致，电压标测可能遗漏关键结构基质。
  • Frequency and Clinical Distribution of Sustained Ventricular Tachycardia in Acute ST-Elevation Myocardial Infarction: A Tertiary-Care Study from Pakistan
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-09-28
  • Anterior-Wall ST-Elevation Myocardial Infarction and Early Presentation as Clinical Markers of Sustained Ventricular Tachycardia: Findings from a Pakistani STEMI Cohort
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-09-28
  • Risk Classification for Sudden Cardiac Death Using Single-Lead ECG
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-09-28
    基于19例患者单导联ECG训练的1D-CNN模型，以5秒片段分类正常与高危，总体准确率96.69%、AUC 0.9894，提示可用于SCD风险辅助筛查。
  • A Short-Scale Transition into Ventricular Fibrillation: Recurrence Quantification and the Limits of Minute-Scale Anticipation
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-09-28
    基于复发量化分析，在心脏性猝死Holter数据库中未发现可在室颤发生前数分钟预测其转变的指标，幅度域与心率变异性域均无显著分离。

器械治疗（3）

  • Infective endocarditis of the right atrioventricular valve and transvenous pacing lead in a patient with Down syndrome.
    Cardiol Young · 2026-09-28
    一例11岁唐氏综合征、房室间隔缺损修补术后患者，发生右侧房室瓣及经静脉起搏导线感染性心内膜炎，经抗生素及手术修复后康复。
  • Potential harms to rescuers during cardiac arrest response and resuscitation: a scoping review
    Resuscitation Plus · 2026-09-28
    该范围综述纳入20项研究，发现心脏骤停应答与复苏过程中施救者受到的伤害总体罕见，致命伤害主要见于水上救援时的溺水，电击与感染风险较低且可防护。
  • Long-term mortality and shock-rate in patients surviving out-of-hospital cardiac arrest with and without early implantation of an implantable cardioverter defibrillator
    Scand Cardiovasc J · 2026-09-28
    院外心脏骤停复苏后存活患者中，早期植入ICD与5年死亡率显著降低独立相关，且ACS与原发性心律失常患者的恰当治疗累积发生率无差异。

心力衰竭与代谢（3）

  • ECG-based NSR, CHF, and ARR classification: Tradeoff between classical feature engineering and TCN-based deep features
    Biomedical Signal Processing and Control · 2026-09-28
    在MIT-BIH心电数据上，经典特征+SVM对ARR/NSR、ARR/CHF、NSR/CHF二分类准确率分别为88%、91%、100%，TCN三分类总体准确率99.4%，但计算资源需求更高。
  • Acute Sheehan Syndrome Presenting as Panhypopituitarism and Reversible Cardiac Dysfunction in a Patient With Sickle Cell Disease: A Case Report
    Cureus · 2026-09-28
    一例31岁镰状细胞病产妇在700 mL产后出血伴严重溶血后11周出现全垂体功能减退和可逆性心功能不全，经激素替代及心衰治疗后恢复。
  • Same Medicines, Different Heartbeats
    University of Auckland Data Repository · 2026-09-28
    在老年人中，使用精神兴奋剂与卒中/TIA及心律失常风险升高相关，但与心肌梗死或总体心血管疾病无显著关联。

遗传与基础（7）

  • Fatal Cannabis-Associated Cardiovascular Toxicity Following High-Potency Cannabis Use: An Integrated Clinicopathologic Investigation.
    Am J Forensic Med Pathol · 2026-09-28
    一例28岁健康男性吸食高 potency 大麻后发生室颤，复苏后死于缺氧缺血性脑病，尸检示结构正常心脏伴亚心内膜心肌损伤，遗传检测阴性，提示大麻相关心血管毒性。
  • Multimodality Imaging in Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy: From Phenotyping to Precision Clinical Management
    Diagnostics (Basel) · 2026-09-28
    多模态心血管影像（超声心动图、CMR、CT、核素显像）整合应用可提升肥厚型心肌病的表型诊断、危险分层与精准治疗规划，而非各技术相互竞争。
  • Diagnosis of familial hypercholesterolemia through population screening.
    Expert Rev Cardiovasc Ther · 2026-09-28
    家族性高胆固醇血症患病率约1/300且可治疗，成人分层多标准筛查（可结合AI）具成本效益，儿童新生儿干血斑或学校筛查同样可行。
  • Atrial fibroblast metabolic reprogramming in atrial fibrillation: a candidate mechanism within multicellular atrial cardiomyopathy
    Front Cardiovasc Med · 2026-09-28
    本文综述提出心房成纤维细胞代谢重编程可能是多细胞心房心肌病中连接代谢应激与AF的候选机制，但尚无研究直接测量人房成纤维细胞代谢，因果关系未确立。
  • Case Report: Fabry cardiomyopathy associated with a novel truncating <i>GLA</i> variant, c.837_838delinsAT, p.(Gln280Ter)
    Front Med (Lausanne) · 2026-09-28
    一例52岁女性肥厚型心肌病患者检出新型GLA截短变异c.837_838delinsAT，确诊Fabry病心肌病，经ICD和酶替代治疗管理。
  • Neurocardiac crosstalk in inherited cardiac arrhythmias and cardiomyopathy
    J Physiol · 2026-09-28
    综述指出遗传性心律失常和心肌病中自主神经系统功能障碍与心肌细胞病变共同参与，为风险分层和治疗提供新方向。
  • Preimplantation genetic testing to determine polygenic disease risk: Will we know when to stop?
    JBRA Assist Reprod · 2026-09-28
    PGT-P技术通过多基因风险评分筛选胚胎以降低多基因病风险，但专家担忧其过早应用，需谨慎并明确限制。

其他（7）

  • Electrophysiological Manifestations of Suspected Bachmann's Bundle Infarction Due to Occlusion of the Right Sinus Node Artery
    JACC Clin Electrophysiol · 2026-09-28
  • Large language model versus dual human title/abstract screening in a live systematic review (CRD420261518811)
    Open Science Framework · 2026-09-28
    在心脏淀粉样变房性心律失常直流电复律的系统评价中，拟比较大型语言模型与双人独立标题/摘要筛选，但摘要未报告任何预测或比较结果。
  • CLINICAL CHARACTERISTICS AND CLINICAL SIGNIFICANCE OF ARRHYTHMIAS IN WOMEN OF REPRODUCTIVE AGE WITH IRON DEFICIENCY ANEMIA
    SOUTH ARAL SEA MEDICAL JOURNAL · 2026-09-28
    育龄期缺铁性贫血女性常出现心悸、心动过速及心电图节律异常，贫血严重程度与铁状态同心血管表现相关，早期纠正缺铁可能减轻症状。
  • Electrocardiogram Analysis from Beat-Level Arrhythmias to WPW Ventricular Pre-Excitation and Glycemic Disorders: A Scoping Review
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-09-28
    本范围综述分析16项研究，发现心电图机器学习方法在受控数据集上性能高，但存在数据划分未按患者分离、外部验证不足等局限，且心电图可作为血糖异常的补充标志物。
  • Automation of the experimental setup for functional studies in isolated perfused hearts
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-09-28
    本项目在Langendorff离体心脏灌流平台上集成数字传感器、执行器与无线通信模块，实现流量、压力和温度的实时监测与自动控制，以减少人工干预、提高实验可重复性。
  • Architectural Rigidity versus Modern Scaling Laws in Asymmetric Medical Data for Cardiac Arrhythmia Classification
    Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research) · 2026-09-28
    在高度不平衡的心电数据中，经典ResNet50比现代缩放网络（EfficientNetV2B0、ConvNeXtTiny）更能保持少数类诊断敏感性，后者在类别支持极低时F1-score崩溃至0.00%。
  • TRACE: Expert-Aligned ECG Representation Learning with Rigorous Benchmarking and Real-World Validation in Acute Cardiac Care
    arXiv (Cornell University) · 2026-09-28
    TRACE多模态ECG模型在急性冠脉闭塞检测中较临床基线显著提升敏感性19.0%或降低假阳性率62.6%，并在心律失常分类等公开基准上表现稳健。

item.title: 2026-09-27 心脏电生理日报（43 篇）
item.description:
共 43 篇。在日报页面阅读完整解读 →

房颤与消融（21）

  • Explainable AI for Atrial Fibrillation Detection through Interactive Counterfactual Generation: A Literature Review
    2026-09-27
  • Medication-specific risk of atrial fibrillation in patients with coronary artery disease.
    Biomed Eng Lett · 2026-09-27
    在157,750例冠心病患者中，依折麦布/瑞舒伐他汀与房颤风险降低相关，而地尔硫䓬、托拉塞米、肝素钠、比索洛尔和去甲肾上腺素与风险升高相关。
  • South African Flag Sign During Atrial Fibrillation: Physician Recognition of Acute Proximal Left Anterior Descending Artery Occlusion Despite No Automated ST-Segment Elevation Myocardial Infarction Alert.
    Cureus · 2026-09-27
    58岁女性房颤合并急性胸痛，心电图呈南非国旗征但自动系统未报警，冠脉造影证实前降支近段完全闭塞，提示该征象不限于第一对角支且视觉判读至关重要。
  • Cardiometabolic therapy for rhythm control: a case report of refractory atrial fibrillation resolving after initiation of semaglutide for obesity
    European Heart Journal - Case Reports · 2026-09-27
    一例既往四次肺静脉隔离失败的肥胖持续性房颤患者，启动司美格鲁肽后房颤发作立即停止且随访未复发，提示GLP-1受体激动剂可能具有节律控制作用。
  • Cost-effectiveness of heart failure pharmacotherapy withdrawal in recovered atrial fibrillation mediated cardiomyopathy: analysis of the WITHDRAW-AF randomized clinical trial.
    Int J Cardiol · 2026-09-27
    在房颤消融后心功能恢复的房颤介导心肌病患者中，撤除心衰药物治疗相比继续用药可显著节省费用，且不损害功能状态与生活质量。
  • Clinical Vulnerability Refines Rhythm-Related Outcomes in Older Patients Undergoing Pulmonary Vein Isolation for Atrial Fibrillation: An Observational Cohort Study.
    J Arrhythm · 2026-09-27
    在PVI术后，年龄≥75岁患者同中心节律干预复发风险高于50-74岁（HR 1.35），但临床脆弱性评分≥2者风险更高（aHR 1.85），而评分0者风险与较年轻组无差异。
  • Multimodality Imaging-Guided Pulsed Field Ablation for Atrial Fibrillation in Cor Triatriatum Sinister.
    J Arrhythm · 2026-09-27
    在多脾综合征/左侧三房心患者中，多模态影像引导下使用CARTO整合的VARIPULSE脉冲场消融成功实现肺静脉隔离，无并发症，提示该策略在复杂先天性左房解剖中可行。
